jobs.title: Assembly Technician I
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ Foundry Robotics is building an AI\-native robotics manufacturing company focused on deploying advanced assembly and production capability for leading robotics companies and national\-security\-critical hardware. Basically, we’re building robots that build robots. Factory OS is building software that runs factories. Our platform spans cloud backends, on\-prem services, and edge devices deployed on the factory floor. The operators, supervisors, and managers who use our tools need interfaces that are fast, reliable, and intuitive—even when network conditions aren’t perfect and the environment is demanding. This role is 100% in\-person at our office in Emeryville. **The Role** ============ Assembly Technicians are the hands that turn designs into working machines. You will build, wire, assemble, test, and rework robots across a range of programs — prototype units one week, pilot production builds the next, and a same\-day fix on a robot that has to ship tomorrow. No two builds look exactly alike, and the work changes as the platforms evolve. ***We're hiring at three levels through this single posting*****:** Assembly Technician I, Sr. Assembly Technician, and Technician Lead. The core work is the same at every level; what changes is how independently you operate, how much you own, and how much the team leans on you to raise the bar. We'll level you based on your experience and the interview process. Whatever the level, you will own your builds end to end: quality, documentation, and the call to stop and flag something when it isn't right. **What You'll Do (all levels)** * Build and assemble electromechanical robot subassemblies and full systems to IPC\-A\-610 and J\-STD\-001 acceptance criteria, holding first\-pass yield to a high, measurable standard. * Solder, terminate, crimp, and route wiring and cable assemblies, and verify them with continuity and fault\-isolation testing before anything moves downstream. * Move fluidly between build types — prototype, engineering validation, pilot production, and field rework— without losing quality or pace. * Perform on\-robot rework and debugging, isolating and resolving mechanical and electrical issues directly on the unit. * Read and work from schematics, wiring diagrams, assembly drawings, and BOMs, and catch the discrepancies between the drawing and the hardware in front of you. * Run functional checkout and bring\-up on completed robots, documenting results and escalating anomalies with enough detail to act on. * Keep accurate, traceable build records, and keep the workspace safe, organized, ESD\-compliant, and audit\-ready. **The Levels** **Assembly Technician I** — 3–5 years of experience * Executes builds from drawings and travelers with light oversight; solid soldering, wiring, and mechanical assembly fundamentals. * Troubleshoots common electrical and mechanical faults and knows when to escalate. * Owns the quality and documentation of your own work. **Sr. Assembly Technician** — 5–9 years of experience * Everything above, fully independently: takes an unfamiliar build with incomplete documentation and figures it out. * Owns complex rework and debug, and drives process, fixturing, and documentation improvements alongside engineering. Surfaces design and process issues early enough to influence design\-for\-manufacturability decisions; mentors Technician I's. **Technician Lead** — 10\+ years of experience * Leads builds end to end across programs: sequencing, handoffs, and the quality standard for the floor. * Primary technician point of contact for design and manufacturing engineering on build readiness and DFM. * Trains the technician team and sets the standard for how work gets done. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * **Craftsmanship:** you treat error\-free, repeatable work as the baseline and take real pride in what you hand off. * **Versatility:** you are comfortable being handed an unfamiliar build with incomplete documentation and figuring it out. * **Diagnostic instinct:** you isolate opens, shorts, binding, and misalignment methodically rather than by trial and error. * **Ownership:** you finish what you start, flag problems early, and hold yourself to a standard before anyone has to ask. * **Collaboration:** you partner naturally with design and manufacturing engineers, and you give feedback that makes the next revision better. **Minimum Requirements (all levels)** * High school diploma or equivalent, with hands\-on experience in electromechanical assembly, robotics, aerospace, medical device, or comparable low\-volume, high\-mix build environments at the level listed above. * Active J\-STD\-001 certification (Requirements for Soldered Electrical and Electronic Assemblies). * Active IPC\-A\-610 certification (Acceptability of Electronic Assemblies). * Proven ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, mechanical assembly drawings, and BOMs. * Proficiency with hand and power tools (torque drivers, crimpers, strippers, heat guns) and * measurement tools (multimeter, calipers). Strong soldering skills, including fine\-pitch and through\-hole rework, and solid troubleshooting ability * across electrical and mechanical failures. * Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal hand\-holding, take verbal direction, and run with it. **Preferred Qualifications** * Associate's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering Technology, Electronics, Mechatronics, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. * IPC/WHMA\-A\-620 certification (cable and wire harness assemblies); familiarity with IPC\-7711 / 7722 rework and repair standards. * Experience with actuators, gearboxes, servo drives, sensors, or battery systems. * Experience working from an MES, ERP, or traveler\-based build tracking system; basic CAD proficiency for viewing and marking up drawings. * Prior experience in a startup or rapid\-iteration hardware environment where the build changes weekly. * ***For Technician Lead:*** prior experience leading builds or a technician team. **Benefits** * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * Paid time off, company holidays, and parental leave * 401(k) plan with company match * Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Short\-term and long\-term disability, and life insurance + *Level and placement within the range are based on experience, skills, and interview performance.* **Why Join Us?** ================ This is one of the only places where world\-class manufacturing operators, mechanical engineers, robotics researchers, and software engineers sit in the same room — building production systems together. We are committed to being deeply embedded in the U.S. industrial base. Our focus is simple: build adaptive robotic assembly systems that make American manufacturing scalable, resilient, and competitive again. If you want to run a mature, well\-defined commercial org, this may not be the role. If you want to build the commercial engine that brings AI\-driven manufacturing to every industrial and energy customer in America — this is it. Compensation packages at Foundry Robotics for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position, determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, interview performance, and relevant education or training. Foundry Robotics employees in eligible roles are also granted equity based compensation, subject to Board of Director approval. You'll also receive benefits including, but not limited to: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, and generous PTO. Foundry Robotics is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

If you're passionate about what you do and want to be part of a pioneering team building purpose\-built software for industrial equipment and commercial field service industry, we want to hear from you! Experience with AL, React Native, or TypeScript is helpful, but expertise across all three is not required. * Working knowledge of programming fundamentals, debugging, testing, source control, and API concepts. * Ability to follow defined requirements, ask effective questions, accept feedback, document work, and collaborate with team members. **Equal Opportunity Employer** RUX Software is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Data & Discovery Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** This role has two equal parts. The first is building and maintaining the data infrastructure that makes Ralco's Innovation pipeline trustworthy and queryable: designing pipelines, enforcing data quality, and doing the real, hands\-on work of entering, structuring, and validating data as it comes in from the lab, the barns, and the field. This includes building, or working with IT to build, a LIMS\-style direct\-entry system so that work happens correctly at the source rather than through repeated manual re\-entry. The second is working alongside members of the R\&D team and IT to develop models and tools that surface candidate compounds and patterns the science team can act on. This includes actively reviewing data across projects and bringing forward insights, trends, or connections for the science team to think through and possibly act on, while safeguarding the accuracy and confidentiality of Ralco's most valuable data assets. Success means the Innovation team spends less time hunting for or correcting data and more time doing science, with a shared database that grows more useful, trustworthy, and queryable over time rather than more unwieldy, and this person is known across the team both as someone who keeps the data itself in order and as someone who consistently adds something useful to the team's work. *This job description is not meant to be all\-inclusive, and duties may vary based on departmental and company needs.* **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, and continuously improve the pipeline connecting lab instruments, in\-vitro work, and barn/field data sources into the shared database * Build, or work with IT to build, a LIMS\-style direct\-entry system, owning the correct entry, tagging, organizing, and storing of it correctly in the shared database * Design and maintain the database schema and tagging conventions so the data can be queried and modeled correctly * Work with IT to design and validate permission, gated access controls that determine who can see sensitive data, testing them before any sensitive data goes live * Ensure new compound and trial data is entered with a complete, validated profile * Resolving data\-quality issues directly with the originating scientist before any correction is made, and lead periodic data audits to reconcile duplicate or conflicting records and standardize naming conventions * Build and maintain anomaly detection, compound similarity/clustering, and pattern\-flagging tools that are useful well before a full predictive model is trustworthy * Build, retrain, and validate the models used for querying the database on a documented cadence tied to data volume, tracking hit\-rate before and after each cycle and documenting the trend * Work with the R\&D team to make sure the model used for querying stays the most accurate and correct fit for the data, revisiting its underlying design when it no longer fits rather than assuming it always will * Actively review data across active research projects on an ongoing basis, bringing forward insights, trends, or connections for the science team to think through and possibly act on * Conduct regular cross\-project data reviews to help surface new angles or connections for the R\&D team on active research tracks * Run patent searches and compile literature searches on request to support hypothesis\-building, manuscript preparation, and Regulatory's IP review, maintaining a running log so the same ground is never covered twice * Produce a quarterly gap\-audit report, and a brief report after every model retraining cycle documenting what changed and what the new hit\-rate is * Follow, and help enforce, Ralco's IP protection practices for anything touching the shared database, escalating promptly any data handling or access issue that could put proprietary information at risk * Regularly meet with the R\&D and IT teams to stay closely connected to their work, translating between researcher needs and data architecture as new data types and sources come online **Key Competencies** * Data pipeline design and hands\-on database schema architecture, including LIMS\-style direct\-entry system design or integration * SQL and at least one scripting language for pipeline and data work; experience with permissioned/gated data\-access systems, familiarity with MCP architecture or similar data governance frameworks a plus * Practical, hands\-on machine learning experience, model training, validation, retraining, and performance evaluation, including anomaly detection, clustering, and similarity algorithms on structured datasets * Sound judgment handling proprietary and sensitive data * Self\-directed learning; demonstrated ability to track how AI/ML tools and techniques evolve and evaluate new approaches on one's own initiative * Comfortable working across scientific and technical teams; able to translate between researcher needs and data architecture * **Ralco Values and Purpose Alignment** + **Values:** Courageous Curiosity, Driven to Deliver, Master Your Craft, Root for the Team, Earn the Relationship + **Purpose:** Ralco creates effective natural solutions that address agriculture's greatest challenges. **Qualifications** **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Data Engineering, Bioinformatics, Computer Science, or a closely related field **Experience:** 3–6 years of experience in data science, data engineering, bioinformatics, master data management, or a closely related field **Technical:** Real experience designing data pipelines; SQL and relational database concepts; practical, hands\-on machine learning experience; experience with permissioned/gated data\-access systems. **Travel:** *Regular travel to Marshall, MN expected.* **Location:** Remote (US) **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience building or integrating a LIMS\-style direct\-entry system * Direct, hands\-on experience building a predictive model end\-to\-end: preparing training data, training and validating a model, and deploying and retraining it as new data comes in, not just coursework or theoretical exposure * Experience designing a database schema and tagging system from scratch for messy, real\-world data, deciding how to structure and label information so it stays queryable and useful as it grows, not just working within a schema someone else already built * Demonstrated self\-directed learning; concrete examples of teaching oneself a new technical or scientific domain without formal instruction * Shows curiosity about the underlying science, not just the data structure; asks why data looks the way it does * Some background or coursework in life sciences, chemistry, or animal/agricultural science * Experience running patent database searches **About Ralco** Ralco is a family\-owned agricultural health and nutrition company with a global presence, distributing products in over 40 countries. Inspired by nature and powered by science, Ralco develops innovative, natural solutions to support plant and animal health.

special projects as assigned. **Qualifications** **Required:** * Currently pursuing an associate or bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering Technology, or a related technical field. * Basic understanding of electrical and electronic principles through completed coursework. * Ability to read or develop proficiency in reading electronic schematics and technical drawings. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. * Basic computer skills and the ability to learn engineering and manufacturing software. * Effective written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. * Ability to distinguish colors as required when subjects. * Familiarity with electronic test equipment such as digital multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, or similar equipment. * Exposure to CAD, schematic capture, or PCB design software. * jobs.title: Executive Assistant - Product & Tech Strategy and Operations
jobs.description: **\*\*This role sits in our Burbank, CA offices, and this person is required to be on\-site 4 days/ week\*\*** **About the Role \& Team** Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world\-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touchpoints serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: * **Building the future of Disney’s media**: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. * **Reach, Scale \& Impact**: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. jobs.title: Founding Developer Relations Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT US** ------------ **We're building toward a world where every company can become its own AI lab.** Goaly is a stealth AI startup founded by ex\-Meta Superintelligence Labs engineers and researchers. Our mission is to dramatically lower the cost, time, and talent barriers to building proprietary AI — and make each generation of models faster and cheaper to build than the last. Backed by leading AI investors and endorsed by frontier AI researchers and builders, we're looking for an engineer who can build in public, explain hard systems clearly, and already knows how to reach the people who train models. **ABOUT THE ROLE** ------------------ Goaly's users are the people who run post\-training: the ML infra engineers and researchers who babysit SFT, RL, and fine\-tuning jobs on GPU clusters. They don't read marketing. They read benchmarks, repos, docs, and the engineer who wrote them. You will be that engineer. You will be our first Developer Relations hire and the technical voice of Goaly as we come out of stealth. Half of your week is building: running real post\-training workloads on our stack, writing the benchmark harnesses, example integrations, and docs that get a stranger from zero to a first result in thirty minutes. The other half is making sure the right ten thousand people see it: engineering posts, talks, open\-source releases, and the one\-on\-one conversations with practitioners that turn into design partners and hires. This is not a marketing role with a technical veneer, and it is not an engineering role that occasionally posts. You need to be credible in a room full of people who train models, and you need an audience in that room — or a proven ability to build one. This is a founding role. You will report to the founders and work daily with engineering and the go\-to\-market team. There is no playbook yet; you help write it. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ------------------ * **Build the signature technical artifacts.** Own a public post\-training efficiency benchmark, reproducible before/after case studies (doomed\-run kills, silent throughput regressions, dollars per eval point), and the open\-source tools we release around them. * **Write the docs that convert.** Quickstarts, reference docs, and example integrations for the stacks our users actually run (PyTorch distributed, Megatron, FSDP, TorchTitan, Ray, Slurm, Kubernetes on GPUs, W\&B, MLflow) so an engineer can get a read\-only Retroactive Kill Report on their own cluster without talking to us. * **Create technical content practitioners share.** Deep\-dive engineering posts, benchmark write\-ups, failure\-mode teardowns ("seven ways an RL run dies silently"), short demo videos, and live walkthroughs. * **Own distribution.** Run Goaly's technical presence on X, LinkedIn, GitHub, Hacker News, and the ML\-infra Discord and Slack communities. Land talks at the venues our users attend (PyTorch Conference, MLSys, Ray Summit, GTC, NeurIPS and ICML workshops, Bay Area AI infra meetups). Build relationships with the people whose posts our audience already reads. * **Be the feedback loop.** Sit with design partners, reproduce their problems on our stack, and bring engineering precise, prioritized feedback. Turn repeated questions into docs, tools, or product changes. * **Build community around the problem, not the product.** Practitioner conversations, office hours, and a newsletter or series that becomes the place to learn about post\-training efficiency. * **Amplify the founders.** Turn the founding team's Llama post\-training infra experience into content and talks, and work with the GTM team to turn attention into design\-partner pipeline and candidate pipeline. * **Measure and cut.** Track reach, repo adoption, docs funnel, inbound design\-partner requests, and hires sourced. Double down on what works and kill what doesn't. **YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE** ------------------------------------- * **A real engineering background.** 3\+ years as a software or ML engineer, and you still write code every week. You can stand up a distributed training job, read a profiler trace, and debug a CUDA OOM without asking for help. * **Hands\-on time with LLM post\-training or the infra under it.** SFT, RL, LoRA, DPO, or the stack beneath them (PyTorch distributed, Megatron, DeepSpeed, FSDP, Ray, Slurm, GPU Kubernetes). You don't need frontier scale, but you need to have felt the pain. * **A track record of explaining hard things clearly.** Blog posts, docs, conference talks, OSS READMEs, tutorials, or videos. Send links; we will read them. * **Distribution you can point to.** An audience on X, LinkedIn, YouTube, a newsletter, or GitHub; talks you've given; communities where people know your name; or a demonstrable history of building reach from zero. Reach inside the ML infra and post\-training community matters far more than raw follower count. * **Communication in both directions.** Writing that practitioners trust, and the ability to listen to a frustrated infra engineer for an hour and come back with the three things engineering should fix. * **Taste for substance.** You would rather publish one reproducible benchmark than ten hot takes. * **Comfort being the public face of something early.** No playbook, an imperfect product, shifting messaging, and your name on the output. **STRONG PLUSES** ----------------- * Prior developer relations, developer advocate, or technical evangelist experience at an ML tooling, AI infra, or developer\-platform company (Weights \& Biases, Modal, Anyscale, Together, Hugging Face, Lightning, Databricks, or similar). * Maintainer or notable contributor to a widely used ML or infra open\-source project. * Experience running a developer community: Discord or Slack, meetups, hackathons, workshops. * Fluency on video and on stage; comfortable on a podcast or a conference keynote. * Daily familiarity with the observability and profiling tools our users live in (W\&B, MLflow, Nsight, PyTorch Profiler). * Sales\-engineering or forward\-deployed engineering experience: you have gotten a customer to a result, not just watched them try. **HOW WE WORK** --------------- * **Mission first.** We choose work for its impact on the mission and take responsibility for the outcome, not just our assigned tasks. * **High agency.** We identify what is missing, form a plan, and move without waiting for perfect clarity. * **Speed with rigor.** We ship, measure, and iterate quickly while protecting correctness, safety, and reliability. * **Flexible scope.** We cross team and technical boundaries when that is the fastest way to solve the real problem. * **Low ego, high standards.** We give direct feedback, change our minds when the evidence changes, and help the whole team win. * **Continuous learning.** The stack changes quickly; we are willing to learn unfamiliar systems, methods, and domains as the work demands. **Location, visa sponsorship \& benefits** ------------------------------------------ * Hybrid in Palo Alto: 4\+ days/week in office, with roughly 20% travel for conferences and customer visits. * Visa sponsorship: H\-1B and OPT/CPT support available, with immigration counsel. * Meals \& perks: Complimentary lunch, dinner, snacks, and drinks. **A note on qualifications.** We value exceptional ability over perfect keyword matches. If the work excites you and you can show strong technical ability, clear writing, and real reach, we encourage you to apply. **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY** --------------------- We are an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates who need them during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Title: Principal Software Engineer** **Reports to: SVP, Technology** **Location: Remote or Hybrid within KS, MO, OK, TN, or TX** **Budget: $170k \- $185k DOE** **About the Role** At PaulHood we are transforming the mid\-market CPA industry with an entirely new model. Our year\-round membership model provides clients with expert tax and financial guidance, helping them feel more secure and realize their long\-term financial goals. Founded 30 years ago by Paul Hood, our company has grown rapidly and now serves over 15,000 customers nationwide. To support our continued growth, we have completely modernized our business with technology and processes more akin to a SaaS company than a CPA firm. In response to this growth, we are seeking a **Principal Software Engineer** to help build the engineering foundation that will enable our continued growth and scale. This is a highly hands\-on, Principal\-level individual contributor role designed for an experienced software engineer who is equally comfortable establishing technical direction and building solutions. You will lead the design and development of integrations and workflow automations across our technology ecosystem, establish reusable engineering standards, and help create the Quality Engineering practices that support reliable and scalable software delivery. You will join us at an important stage in our technology evolution. Rather than stepping into a mature software engineering environment with established practices, you will have the opportunity to help define how we approach integration architecture, automation, testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation, and engineering quality as the organization grows. To do this well, the ideal candidate is first and foremost a strong backend or platform software engineer with deep API and systems\-integration experience. You also bring meaningful experience with automated testing and have helped establish or improve Quality Engineering practices. You know when to build custom software, when to leverage an existing platform, and when the simplest solution is the best solution. **What You Will Do** **INTEGRATION AND AUTOMATION** * Reverse\-engineer and stabilize existing business\-critical workflow automations, regardless of the platform on which they were built. * Document workflow purpose, dependencies, credentials, failure modes, business owner, technical owner, monitoring, and recovery procedures. * Design and build integrations using APIs, webhooks, event\-driven patterns, scheduled jobs, low\-code tools, and custom services where appropriate. * Establish standards for source control, testing, CI/CD, secrets management, observability, alerting, auditability, retries, and recovery. * Create reusable connectors and patterns for common PaulHood systems and acquisition integration needs. * Define when work belongs in a workflow platform, custom code, or the data platform, based on business criticality, maintainability, complexity, security, and operating cost. **QUALITY ENGINEERING AND QA AUTOMATION** * Establish the initial Quality Assurance and quality engineering practice for the future Software Engineering department. * Define an automation\-first test strategy covering unit, API, contract, integration, end\-to\-end, regression, and appropriate non\-functional testing. * Build and maintain test automation frameworks using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, pytest, Jest, Postman/Newman, or comparable technologies. * Integrate automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines so quality is evaluated continuously rather than at the end of delivery. * Create test\-data, test\-environment, defect triage, release\-readiness, and regression practices that can scale with the engineering organization. * Define quality metrics such as automated coverage by risk area, defect escape rate, flaky\-test rate, time to detect, regression duration, and release failure patterns. * Coach software engineers to own quality. The QA practice should enable engineering quality, not become a downstream testing queue. **FUTURE AI WORKFLOW ENGINEERING** * Support future AI\-enabled workflows using LLM APIs, tool calling, MCP or comparable protocols, structured outputs, approval controls, and auditability. * Apply software quality principles to AI workflows, including evaluation, regression testing, deterministic controls where possible, monitoring, and human review for high\-impact actions. **Experience You Will Need** * 10\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience, with demonstrated technical ownership and decision\-making at a Principal, or equivalent level required. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field required. * Strong backend development skills using Python, TypeScript, or comparable technologies. * Proven experience designing and building production\-grade integrations across multiple systems. * Deep knowledge of REST APIs, webho omated testing frameworks and strategies. * Experience integrating automated tests and quality controls into CI/CD pipelines. * Experience helping establish, mature, or materially improve Quality Engineering practices, standards, or processes. * Working knowledge of identity and security concepts, including provisioning, deprovisioning, RBAC, least privilege, audit trails, and jobs.title: Senior Developer
jobs.description: **Remote Opportunity \- Canada, US or Philippines applicants** We're always looking for exceptional people. If you're passionate about what you do and want to be part of a pioneering team building purpose\-built software for industrial equipment and commercial field service industry, we want to hear from you! RUX Software is a fast\-growing Microsoft Business Central ISV serving 500\+ clients globally across equipment rental, construction, scaffolding, trenching/shoring, oilfield services, medical equipment, and related verticals. We're engineered to fit the industries we serve, and we hire people the same way. RUX Software provides ERP solutions for industrial asset management and field service organizations. Built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, our applications help customers improve visibility, efficiency, and operational scalability. **Overview** Leads the design, development, testing, release, and support of complex Business Central and cross\-platform mobile solutions. Serves as a technical leader by making sound design decisions, mentoring developers, resolving difficult technical problems, and improving engineering quality and delivery practices. **What This Position Owns** * Own the technical delivery of complex enhancements and major workstreams from estimation and solution design through release. * Make and document technical design decisions across Business Central, integrations, APIs, React Native, TypeScript, iOS, and Android. * Mentor Associate Developers and Developers through design guidance, pairing, code review, and constructive feedback. * Conduct code and solution reviews to ensure RUX development, security, testing, performance, and maintainability standards are followed. * Act as an escalation point for complex defects, production incidents, integration issues, and platform\-specific problems. * Identify technical debt, explain its business and delivery impact, and propose practical remediation plans. * Partner with the Manager, Product Engineering and Product Owner on estimates, dependencies, technical risks, and delivery options. * Maintain working knowledge of Business Central, AppSource deployment, relevant Microsoft technologies, and assigned product domains. * Provide functional and technical guidance for Business Central sales, purchasing, project, service, and related RUX workflows. * Own mobile architecture and release readiness, including build, signing, testing, store submission, rollout, and update processes for Apple App Store and Google Play distribution. * Technical ownership of mobile build, signing, release, and update processes for Apple App Store and Google Play distribution. **How Success Is Measured** * Success is measured by predictable delivery of complex work; quality, security, and maintainability of technical solutions; effective resolution of escalations and production issues; reduction of avoidable technical debt; accuracy of estimates and risk communication; release reliability; and demonstrated growth of developers through mentoring and review. **Responsibilities** * Lead technical discovery and translate product requirements into supportable solution designs and implementation plans. * Develop and review complex AL, React Native, TypeScript, integration, and API changes as required by assigned work. * Break large technical efforts into clear deliverables, identify dependencies, and communicate risks before sprint commitment. * Guide developers in debugging, testing, performance analysis, secure coding, and maintainable implementation practices. * Ensure appropriate automated tests, technical documentation, deployment notes, and rollback considerations are completed. * Coordinate with team members to clarify expected behavior, verify acceptance criteria, and resolve issues efficiently. * Lead technical response for high\-impact defects and production incidents, including root\-cause analysis and corrective actions. * Review architecture and code for consistency, reuse, scalability, platform compatibility, and long\-term supportability. * Improve development standards, reusable components, CI/CD practices, release processes, and team documentation. * Guide mobile architecture, native integrations, platform\-specific behavior, performance, security, and store\-release practices across iOS and Android. * Assist with technical planning, estimation, hiring input, onboarding, and skills development for the engineering team. * Communicate technical tradeoffs and recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. **Qualifications** * Demonstrated experience independently delivering complex production software and leading significant features or technical workstreams through design, development, testing, release, and support. * Advanced proficiency in at least one primary RUX technology area, such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and AL or React Native and TypeScript, with the ability to work effectively across integrations, APIs, source control, automated testing, and deployment processes. * Strong technical judgment, debugging, solution\-design, code\-review, mentoring, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills. * Experience with SaaS or ERP products, AppSource, Apple App Store or Google Play releases, CI/CD, security, performance, and RUX customer industries is preferred based on the assigned product area. **Equal Opportunity Employer** RUX Software is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and are committed to a workplace where employees are treated with dignity and respect.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: The Senior Software Engineer will be a key member of a small, highly collaborative engineering team responsible for designing, building, operating, and evolving LabXchange's software platform. This is a hands\-on role for an engineer who is comfortable working across the application stack, with particular strength in backend systems, software architecture, and production environments. The Senior Software Engineer will independently own major features, subsystems, and technical initiatives from design through production, contribute to architectural decisions, mentor other engineers, and help improve engineering standards and practices. We value clear communication and coordination as much as individual development speed. The right candidate will share knowledge rather than becoming a single point of failure. They can provide thoughtful technical opinions and are willing to respectfully challenge existing assumptions. The Senior Software Engineer reports to the CTO and works closely with engineering, product, operations, and other stakeholders across the organization. **Key Responsibilities** * Own major features and subsystems from design through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing support. * Design, build, and maintain backend services, APIs, database interactions, asynchronous processes, integrations, and supporting frontend functionality. * Propose and evaluate architectural approaches with the CTO, explain tradeoffs, and lead implementation of agreed decisions as product, customer, security, performance, and scalability requirements change. * Contribute to the production environment, including AWS infrastructure, containerized applications, CI/CD, performance, and operational troubleshooting. * Design for reliable operation and safe change, including observability, retries, idempotency, data migrations, recovery, and protection of sensitive information. * Review code and technical designs, including work produced through AI\-assisted development workflows. * Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and day\-to\-day collaboration. * Help establish and improve engineering practices around architecture, testing, security, code review, documentation, deployment, and development workflow. * Identify technical debt, architectural risks, operational weaknesses, and opportunities to simplify or improve existing systems. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience building and operating production software. * Strong experience developing backend applications, APIs, integrations, and data\-driven systems. * Strong experience with modern JavaScript and TypeScript development. * Experience with Node.js or comparable server\-side application frameworks. * Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including data modeling, migrations, transactions, and performance considerations. * Experience building and operating applications in AWS or a comparable cloud environment. * Experience with Docker or other containerized application environments. * Working knowledge of React or another modern frontend framework. * Solid understanding of software architecture, API design, asynchronous processing, distributed\-system fundamentals, and production failure modes. * Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, Git\-based source control, and modern software delivery practices. * Experience troubleshooting production systems using logs, metrics, monitoring, and other observability tools. * Ability to independently investigate unfamiliar systems and make sound technical decisions. * Experience performing code reviews, mentoring engineers, or providing technical guidance. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills. **Current Technology Environment** Our current technology environment includes: * TypeScript * Python * FastAPI * Node.js / Express * React * PostgreSQL / Drizzle ORM * AWS, including ECS, ALB, S3, SQS, WAF, and related services * Docker * Terraform / Infrastructure as Code * CI/CD and Git\-based development workflows * Queue\-based and asynchronous processing * Tailwind CSS / shadcn * AI\-assisted and agentic software development tools Candidates are not expected to have prior experience with every technology in our stack. We value strong engineering fundamentals, adaptability, and the ability to quickly become productive with unfamiliar technologies. **AI\-Assisted Engineering** LabXchange embraces AI\-assisted and agentic software development as a way to increase the effectiveness of our engineering team. We expect senior engineers to understand both the capabilities and limitations of AI\-assisted development. Engineers remain responsible for understanding the systems they modify, evaluating architectural decisions, reviewing generated code, validating assumptions, protecting sensitive information, and ensuring changes meet our security, testing, maintainability, and quality standards. AI should increase engineering capability without replacing communication, shared technical understanding, or engineering judgment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building software in healthcare, financial services, or another regulated or security\-sensitive environment. * Familiarity with HIPAA and systems handling PHI, PII, or other sensitive information. * Experience with healthcare interoperability or laboratory systems, including HL7, FHIR, EDI, LIS, EMR/EHR integrations, or related technologies. * Strong AWS experience, particularly ECS, RDS/PostgreSQL, S3, SQS, IAM, ALB, CloudWatch, and WAF. * Experience with Terraform or another Infrastructure as Code platform. * Experience building queue\-driven, event\-driven, or asynchronous systems. * Experience improving observability, reliability, deployment, or production operations. * Experience professionally incorporating AI coding assistants or autonomous coding agents into development workflows. * Experience working on a small engineering team with broad responsibility and significant ownership. **Role Scope** This is a senior individual\-contributor role with technical ownership and mentorship responsibilities; it does not include people management. *This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the Senior Software Engineer position at LabXchange. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, or qualifications associated with the role. Responsibilities may evolve over time to meet the changing needs of the company and its clients. LabXchange reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties as necessary to support the organization’s goals and operational requirements.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer — Smart Construction 3D
jobs.description: **Build software that changes how the physical world gets built.** At EARTHBRAIN, we're building technology that transforms construction jobsites into intelligent, connected environments. Born from Komatsu—one of the world's largest construction equipment manufacturers—and backed by Komatsu, NTT, Sony, and Nomura Research Institute, EARTHBRAIN combines the speed and ownership of a technology company with the resources and global reach of established industry leaders. Our Smart Construction platform is already deployed across more than 15,000 jobsites in Japan and used in more than 27 countries. Now we're expanding our North American engineering team—and we're looking for experienced software engineers who want to work on technical problems that go far beyond the typical web application. You'll help build 3D products that allow contractors to combine CAD files, aerial and satellite imagery, drone\-captured point clouds, terrain data, and other project information to visualize, analyze, and plan complex construction projects. Think centimeter\-level terrain precision, massive geospatial datasets, earthwork calculations, digital twins, and interactive 3D environments. And that's only where we're starting. Our longer\-term roadmap includes remote and autonomous construction, with cloud systems coordinating fleets of heavy machinery across jobsites. **Why this role is different** This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who wants meaningful technical ownership. You'll write and ship production code every day, work across the stack, solve challenging 3D and geospatial problems, and see your work used in real\-world construction environments. You'll also join an engineering organization actively redefining how software gets built with AI. We believe great engineers don't compete with AI—they learn how to direct it. Every engineer has access to modern AI development tools, including Claude Code, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini. AI agents contribute meaningfully to first\-draft code and testing, while engineers remain responsible for architecture, technical judgment, review, quality, and what ultimately ships. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description: **About Altruist** Altruist is transforming the multi\-trillion dollar wealth management industry by building an AI platform for wealth professionals. We partner with financial advisors nationwide, empowering them to grow, optimize time and resources, and deliver superior outcomes for their clients. We're looking for exceptional talent to help us achieve our mission of making financial advice better, more affordable, and accessible to all. If you're passionate about challenging the status quo and want to do the most important work of your life, we'd love to meet you! **But first, our values** **Kindness** \- Kindness doesn’t *just* equal niceness. We listen to understand. We embrace, and encourage healthy debate and diverse perspectives. We approach conflict openly, honestly, and respectfully. **Brilliance** \- Humility is the skill we’re most proud of and possessing a growth mindset is always top of mind. We take ownership in everything we touch; regularly using our unique superpowers to reach a common goal as a team. We succeed and fail as one. **Grit** \- When challenges arise, we stay laser focused on achieving our mission and finding a way forward, even when it’s hard. We are nimble and maintain a sense of urgency, swiftly adapting to change and overcoming obstacles. **The opportunity** Altruist is in the midst of an exceptional growth phase and we're excited to hire a Senior Product Manager, Enterprise to join our growing product team. As we move upmarket, the registered investment advisor (RIA) firms we work with are larger and more complex, with multiple offices, dedicated operations and compliance teams, and many advisors serving thousands of clients. You'll shape how these firms set up, onboard, and run their business on Altruist. Your work may span onboarding, firm setup, permissions, branding, and billing. You'll also help inform where we invest as our enterprise offering grows, with the goal of simple, enterprise\-grade experiences that firms, advisors, and their clients enjoy using. **Your impact** * Own the roadmap and delivery for one or more enterprise product areas. * Learn how large firms split work across roles, from operations and compliance to advisors and client service, and build products that fit how each team works. * Design workflows that support complex organizations, such as delegating tasks, making bulk changes, and letting firms manage their own settings. * Identify where internal processes create friction or won't hold up at scale, and close those gaps with product features, internal tools, or playbooks. * Ship iterative, high\-quality releases alongside engineering and design. * Partner with enterprise firms to shape the product, turning their feedback into solutions that delight many types of firms. * Help sales win enterprise firms by leading product discovery and showing how Altruist fits the way each firm works. **What you bring** * **Experience** \- 5\+ years of experience as a Product Manager building B2B2C or multi\-sided software, with a track record of shipping complex, high\-visibility products. * + Designing products where the buyer, daily user, and end customer are different people. + Building for enterprise customers with complex organizations while keeping the product simple to use. + Leading discovery with customers and internal teams to find the problems most worth solving. + Breaking large, ambiguous problems into smaller releases with measurable impact. * **Technical aptitude** \- You're comfortable discussing architecture and data models with engineers and understand how integrations connect a firm's systems. You know how to track key user journeys and use the data to guide decisions. * **Ownership** \- You own outcomes, not just delivery, and stay with a product after launch until it works for the firms using it. * **Superb communication** \- You create clarity across teams, influence without formal authority, and explain complex tradeoffs in plain language to firms and internal partners alike. * **Adaptability** \- You thrive in fast\-moving environments and bring structure and momentum when the path forward isn't clear. * **Judgment** \- You make sound decisions with incomplete information, push back when something isn't right for the customer, and stay open to other perspectives. * **Creative problem solving** \- You have strong product and design instincts and can make complex, rules\-heavy problems feel simple. You hold a high bar for experiences that are both enterprise\-grade and delightful to use. **Bonus points if you bring** * Experience in fintech, wealth management, or another regulated industry. * Familiarity with how RIAs operate, including firm structures, advisor transitions, or custodial relationships. * Experience building onboarding, activation, or implementation experiences for enterprise customers. * Experience owning platform capabilities such as team management, roles and permissions, admin tools, or multi\-level structures like offices and sub\-organizations. Los Angeles, CA salary range $180,000 \- $230,000 USD **What we bring** Attracting and retaining top\-tier talent is a priority. We are proud of the culture we’ve built and are cognizant of the ever\-changing professional landscape. Our dynamic offering of perks and benefits are tailored for you to feel your best while doing your best. * Stunning, amenity\-filled office spaces in Culver City, CA, San Francisco, CA, and Dallas, TX. Our offices are intentionally designed for comfort, collaboration, and productivity. * Competitive total compensation. * Premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance plans (HMO and PPO). * 401k savings plan with a 4% match and immediate vesting. * 16 week paid parental leave after one year of employment. * Professional growth and development opportunities including an employee mobility program and an annual L\&D budget allocation for each employee. * Company perks program (includes discounts on pet insurance, fitness, cell phone plans, and travel, etc.). * Financial guidance program (includes counseling on navigating debt, tracking personal spend, saving and planning goals, home\-purchasing preparedness, etc.). * One month work from anywhere policy (with the exception of a few countries). *Total compensation includes a competitive benefits package, along with a bonus program for eligible roles. For salaried positions, a salary offer will be determined by a number of factors including experience, skill level, internal pay equity, geographic location, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs regularly to ensure* *fair, equitable, and competitive pay. At Altruist, we are committed to providing fair, equitable, and competitive compensation by leveraging market data to inform our pay bands. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically in conjunction with performance review cycles. By evaluating compensation on a regular basis, we are able to reward high performance and ensure all employees have opportunities for growth.* *Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Altruist we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*

jobs.title: AIE Sr. Software Development Compiler Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: **ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.** At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. Responsibilities: **THE ROLE:** AMD is looking for a motivated engineer to join a core team of incredibly talented industry specialists working on developing a cutting\-edge machine learning model compiler targeting AMD AIE in Ryzen AI PC and embedded FPGA devices. The compiler needs to take a model in ONNX or PyTorch and produce optimized control and executable code for AIE VLIW processor array. Additionally, the compiler needs to handle partitioning between x86/embedded processor/FPGA fabric and AIE and generate code to interface with AMD AIE specific runtime and driver. **THE PERSON:** The ideal candidate should be passionate about software development. The candidate should be able to communicate effectively and work optimally with different teams across AMD. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:*** Integrate compiler and compiled model with ML Frameworks (such as ONNX and PyTorch) * Implement model partitioning in ML Frameworks and/or MLIR * Implement runtime to distribute work to and collect results from x86 cores and AIE cores * Design and develop new groundbreaking AMD technologies * Debug and fix existing issues and research alternative, more efficient ways to accomplish the same work **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:*** Strong object\-oriented programming background, C/C\+\+ and Python * ML Compiler and Runtime technologies such as MLIR, LLVM * Compiler building skills * Code generation for a ML hardware accelerator * Machine Learning concepts and model development experience * Understanding of ONNX, PyTorch, etc. * Ability to write high quality code with a keen attention to detail * Experience with modern concurrent programming and threading APIs * Experience with software development processes and tools such as debuggers, source code control systems (GitHub) and profilers is a plus * Effective communication and problem\-solving skills **ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:*** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer/Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline Qualifications: *Benefits offered are described:* AMD benefits at a glance. *AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third\-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.* *AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. Reproduce the failure, isolate it to a block or a layer, and drive it to a validated fix with the design, IP, firmware, software or validation team that owns it. Debug at the register level over JTAG, by boot stage, and against timing reports. **System Level Integration:** Work across the whole device, covering processing subsystems, Network\-on\-Chip, memory controllers (DDR5/6, LPDDR5/6\), boot and storage (OSPI, UFS, SD/eMMC), and programmable logic. Understand the configuration levers available at each layer, explain the expected cause and effect before changing one, and prove the result by measurement. **Embedded System Development:** Build and customize embedded Linux images with the Yocto\-based Embedded Design Flow, covering BSPs, device trees, kernel and rootfs tuning, and custom recipes and layers. Generate and debug boot images across the boot chain, and write low\-level software for the on\-chip processors. **Design Validation:** Develop RTL in SystemVerilog/Verilog and prove it on hardware. Build the test designs, automation and results analysis needed to validate a feature, and debug customer designs when they do not behave as expected. **Apply AI to Engineering Workflows:** Use AI/LLM/ML tools to surface design gaps, summarize and correlate large test and log datasets, and drive productivity in debug, automation and documentation. **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE** ------------------------ * Extensive hands\-on experience with FPGA/SoC platforms in a silicon debug, applications, validation, or systems engineering role, built across multiple device generations and product cycles. * Working knowledge of end\-to\-end SoC architecture: processing subsystems, on\-chip interconnect, memory controllers (DDR5/6, LPDDR5/6\) with their scheduling, arbitration and QoS behavior, boot and storage blocks (OSPI, UFS, SD/eMMC), and programmable logic. * Excellent technical writing, with a track record of authoring and publishing customer\-facing documentation that an external audience builds from: product guides, user guides, datasheets and tutorials. * Proven functional failure debug on real hardware: reproducing intermittent and system\-level failures, isolating them across the hardware, firmware and software boundaries, and driving them to root cause using register\-level JTAG debug (xsdb or equivalent), serial console, ILA, oscilloscopes and logic analyzers. * Solid RTL fundamentals in SystemVerilog, Verilog, and/or VHDL. AMD/Xilinx FPGA experience preferred, with strong skills in Vivado or an equivalent FPGA toolchain. * Hands\-on experience with embedded Linux flows: building and customizing images with a Yocto\-based flow such as PetaLinux or the Embedded Design Flow (BSPs, device trees, kernel configuration, custom recipes and layers), Linux kernel and driver knowledge covering UIO and character drivers, interrupt routing, reserved memory and real\-time scheduling, strong C/C\+\+ for application and bare\-metal programming on embedded processors, and automation in Python, Tcl and Shell. Equivalent depth in OpenEmbedded, Buildroot, or AOSP build systems will be considered. * Working knowledge of clocking, CDC, timing closure and static timing analysis, with a proven ability to debug timing violations. * Proven experience in at least one of the following areas: performance analysis and tuning on real hardware; or boot and configuration flows on FPGA or SoC platforms, including boot image generation, platform management firmware, secure boot, bootloaders and runtime reconfiguration of programmable logic. * **Demonstrated use of AI in engineering workflows**, applying AI/LLM/ML tools to identify design gaps, summarize collected data for distribution and analysis, and drive productivity in debug, automation and documentation. * A track record of supporting customers directly, working cross\-functionally across design, software, validation and field teams, and running technical reviews. **This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.** **\#LI\-RL1** Qualifications: *Benefits offered are described:* AMD benefits at a glance. *AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services. and automated test frameworks.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Expert
jobs.description: Get paid to help build better AI. Alpheva AI is looking for experienced software engineers to participate in paid, project\-based work that helps train and evaluate the next generation of AI coding systems. This is **not a full\-time job**. You work remotely and asynchronously on projects that fit around your existing schedule. Your engineering experience becomes the signal that helps AI systems learn what good software engineering actually looks like. What you'll do Depending on the project, you may: * **Build:** Solve realistic software engineering problems and produce high\-quality implementations. * **Evaluate:** Review AI\-generated code, pull requests, architectures, tests, and debugging approaches. * **Debug:** Diagnose failures in real or realistic software repositories and explain what went wrong. * **Review:** Assess whether an AI agent's implementation is correct, maintainable, secure, and production\-ready. * **Demonstrate:** Complete software engineering workflows in real development environments so AI systems can learn how experienced engineers actually work. * **Create evaluations:** Develop challenging engineering tasks and criteria for measuring AI coding agents. * **Compare solutions:** Assess multiple AI\-generated solutions and identify meaningful differences in correctness, quality, and engineering judgment. Projects may involve repository navigation, implementation, testing, debugging, code review, system design, and other software engineering workflows. Who we're looking for We're looking for **experienced working software engineers**, not necessarily AI researchers. You should have: * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience * Strong programming and debugging skills * Experience working in production codebases * Ability to understand unfamiliar repositories and systems * Strong code review and technical judgment * Experience writing and reviewing tests * Ability to clearly explain why a solution is correct or incorrect Experience with any of the following is valuable: * Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, Java, C\+\+, Rust, or similar * Backend or distributed systems * APIs and microservices * Databases and data systems * Cloud infrastructure * DevOps / CI/CD * Security * Frontend engineering * Mobile development * Machine learning infrastructure * Agentic AI or coding agents **You do not need prior experience working in AI.** What matters most is that you know how to do software engineering well. What the work looks like You might be asked to: Fix a bug in an unfamiliar repository.Review an AI\-generated pull request and identify the issues.Implement a feature and write the appropriate tests.Compare two AI\-generated implementations and determine which actually works.Debug a failing application and explain the root cause.Evaluate whether an AI coding agent successfully completed an engineering task.Work through a multi\-step software engineering task in a real development environment. The goal is not simply to determine whether code *looks* good. The goal is to capture the judgment an experienced engineer uses to determine whether software **actually works**. Compensation **Paid project\-based work.** Rates vary based on your experience, specialization, and project requirements. Your applicable rate and project scope will be shown before you commit to a project. Some projects are short assignments. Others may involve recurring work over a longer period. There is **no fixed schedule and no minimum commitment**. Work arrangement * Remote * Asynchronous * Project\-based * Flexible hours * Work around your existing job or commitments * Paid for qualifying project work Why Alpheva AI coding systems are becoming remarkably capable at generating code. But writing a plausible\-looking patch is not the same as being a good software engineer. AI needs to learn how experienced engineers: * Understand unfamiliar systems * Make architectural tradeoffs * Debug failures * Write reliable tests * Review code * Handle edge cases * Reason about security and performance * Decide when an implementation is actually production\-ready That's where you come in. **Your engineering judgment helps shape how AI learns to build software.** How it works **1\. Apply** Tell us about your engineering background, experience, and areas of expertise. **2\. Get qualified** Complete a short, paid software engineering assessment designed around the type of work you'll perform. **3\. Get matched** When your experience matches an active project, we'll share the scope, requirements, and compensation. **4\. Do the work** Complete projects remotely and asynchronously. **5\. Get paid** Receive the agreed rate for your completed work. Important You are not required to share confidential information, proprietary source code, trade secrets, or materials belonging to your employer. Projects are designed so that your professional expertise can be applied without exposing confidential employer information. Help teach AI how great engineers actually work. **Apply to become an Alpheva Software Engineering Expert. check out \- https://alpheva.ai/experts/** Pay: From $300,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Principal Product Designer, AI/ML Services
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS AI Services is seeking a Principal UX Designer to lead some of the most strategic and complex design initiatives across our AI/ML portfolio, including Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. This is an individual contributor role for a designer who operates beyond the boundaries of a single product or feature area. You will tackle large\-scale, highly ambiguous customer problems that span services, workflows, and organizations, establish experience vision and strategy where the path forward is not yet defined, and influence product direction across AWS AI Services. This is a particularly exciting moment to work in this space. Generative AI and agents are changing not only what developers can build, but how software itself is built, evaluated, deployed, and operated. Many of the interaction models for these technologies are still emerging. You will have the opportunity to work on capabilities at the frontier of AI development and help define patterns that do not yet have established answers. You will work at the intersection of AI platform strategy, developer experience, and emerging interaction models, translating sophisticated technical capabilities into experiences that help builders move from experimentation to production. You’ll partner with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Applied Science, Research, and UX to identify systemic customer problems, create alignment around a future\-state vision, and turn that vision into shipped experiences. This is hands\-on design role. You’ll move fluidly between strategy and execution, framing problems, conducting and using customer research, mapping complex systems and workflows, prototyping new interaction models, defining end\-to\-end experiences, and working directly with engineering teams to ship them. Key job responsibilities Lead strategic, portfolio\-level design initiatives. Take on some of the most consequential and ambiguous customer problems across Bedrock, AgentCore, and the broader AWS AI/ML portfolio. Many of these challenges will cross product and organizational boundaries, requiring you to see the larger system, define a clear experience vision, and bring multiple teams together around a path forward. Define the future of AI developer experiences. Help shape how builders create, evaluate, deploy, govern, and operate generative AI applications and agents on AWS. In a space where many interaction patterns are still being invented, you’ll have the opportunity to establish new models for how developers work with AI and influence experiences that span the console, APIs, SDKs, and CLI. Shape the technology, not just the interface. Great developer experiences often begin well below the UI. You’ll go deep into the architecture, APIs, data models, and developer workflows behind the products you design, working directly with senior engineers and technical leaders to make them more intuitive. That may mean influencing the structure of an API, challenging an abstraction that exposes too much underlying complexity, or rethinking terminology and defaults before they become difficult to change. You should be comfortable engaging Engineering at this level and advocating for a different technical solution when a technically valid one creates a poor customer experience. Bring clarity to ambiguous problems. You’ll often begin with an emerging technology, an unmet customer need, or a broad strategic opportunity rather than a defined set of requirements. Use customer insight, systems thinking, prototyping, and strong product judgment to make the problem concrete, explore what is possible, and help teams converge on the right direction. Set the quality bar through hands\-on craft. This is a Principal role where you will continue to design and ship. Take on complex experiences yourself, explore alternatives and tradeoffs, prototype rapidly, validate ideas with customers, and carry the work from early concept through detailed execution. Move quickly while maintaining a high bar for interaction design, visual craft, and the details that make technical products easier to understand and use. Create coherence across the portfolio. Look beyond individual products to identify where customers encounter fragmentation across AWS AI Services. Establish shared interaction models, frameworks, and patterns that solve those problems systematically and help Bedrock, AgentCore, and adjacent services feel like a connected builder experience. Influence across organizational boundaries. Many of the problems you’ll own cannot be solved by one team. Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Science, and UX, bring customer evidence and design thinking into strategic decisions, and create alignment when teams have different technical constraints, priorities, or points of view. Raise the design bar beyond your own work. Your impact as a Principal designer should extend beyond the experiences you personally ship. Provide thoughtful critique and direction, develop approaches that other teams can reuse, mentor designers tackling complex technical problems, and help elevate the quality of design across the broader organization. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 8\+ years of design experience * Have an available online portfolio * Experience with best practices for User Interface Design, Information Architecture, and Interaction Design * Experience in life cycle design projects from design strategy through execution * Experience in a fast\-paced, high\-tech company, or experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround * Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams including Marketing, Product Management, Customer Service, Operations, Legal, Finance, and Senior Leadership * Experience providing training and mentorship * 3\+ years designing and shipping developer\-facing AI/ML products. You understand the end\-to\-end agent development lifecycle, including model hosting, deployment, observability, evaluation. You design across APIs, SDKs, CLIs, and console experiences, with the technical depth to understand developer workflows and influence the underlying interfaces and abstractions. * Ability to design in code\-based prototypes and work comfortably with code **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience providing and effectively communicating strategic and tactical recommendations based on data * Experience designing and prototyping with tools such as Sketch, Photoshop, Illustrator, Axure, Keynote, and InVision * Experience designing products for AWS or another major cloud platform, with an understanding of the needs of enterprise cloud customers. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Fraud Prevention
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Are you passionate about building highly scalable distributed systems that protect millions of customers? Do you want to work at the intersection of big data, real\-time intelligence, and fraud prevention? The AWS Payments \& Fraud Prevention team is looking for a talented SDE to help us stay one step ahead of bad actors. You'll design and build systems that process millions of events per second, develop machine learning\-powered detection pipelines, and directly contribute to keeping AWS safe. Whether it's architecting a new real\-time detection engine, optimizing our graph\-based fraud network analysis, or hardening our registration fraud defenses — your work will have immediate, measurable impact at AWS scale. Key job responsibilities * Design, implement, and operate highly scalable distributed systems that process millions of events per second with low\-latency requirements. * Build real\-time fraud detection pipelines using Apache Flink for stream processing, aggregations, and anomaly detection. * Develop graph\-based intelligence solutions on AWS Neptune to uncover hidden relationships and identify fraud rings. * Write high\-quality, production\-ready code for services that must be available 24/7 with zero tolerance for downtime. * Own the full lifecycle of your solutions — from design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and operational excellence. * Collaborate with applied scientists to integrate machine learning models into real\-time decisioning systems. * Work in a fast\-paced, agile environment where you're solving complex problems with direct, measurable impact on AWS security. * Learn from others, mentor teammates, and contribute to a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement. About the team The AWS Payments \& Fraud Prevention team protects AWS and its customers from fraud, abuse, and account compromise at global scale. We build highly scalable, real\-time systems that ingest billions of signals daily, process petabytes of data, and make split\-second decisions to stop bad actors — from account registration through the entire customer lifecycle. Our stack includes Apache Flink for stream processing, AWS Neptune for graph\-based intelligence, and machine learning models for adaptive detection. jobs.title: Product Manager III, Amazon Fuse
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Would you like to be part of a team that is creating new ways for customers to discover and engage with Amazon? The Fuse team builds products that deliver Amazon subscriptions bundled with partner products, creating new entry points for customers who haven't yet experienced what Amazon has to offer. Our products also enable partners to distribute their services directly on Amazon, turning routine transactions into gateways for discovery, engagement, and long\-term customer relationships. We are seeking a Product Manager to drive planning, execution, and delivery of customer experiences across the Fuse product portfolio. In this role, you will partner with engineering, business development, account managers, design, and third\-party partners to accelerate execution of member\-facing experiences. You will own end\-to\-end product delivery across onboarding, engagement, experimentation, and partner integrations, translating strategy into shipped results. The team has performed well and is growing, making this a compelling time to join and shape what comes next. Key job responsibilities * Own the execution strategy for member onboarding and benefit engagement experiences in partnership with Prime and Prime Video, including defining member segments, personalization signals, and build\-or\-buy decisions. * Lead early\-stage experiments with internal Amazon partners, coordinating cross\-functional delivery across engineering, design, business development, and operations, then synthesizing results into actionable recommendations for leadership. * Drive product and technical proliferation of integration frameworks across new and existing partner launches, ensuring scalability and clear documentation for low\-friction adoption. * Produce quarterly business reviews, product retrospectives, and leadership review documents, using data\-informed analysis to distinguish between output metrics like adoption and outcome metrics like retention and business impact. * Collaborate across engineering, design, finance, marketing, and legal to align priorities, make transparent trade\-offs, and deliver customer experiences that balance growth with operational health. A day in the life You start your morning reviewing onboarding and engagement metrics to spot trends that inform your next set of priorities. By mid\-morning, you are in a design review with engineers, debating trade\-offs on a partner integration prototype.
