jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **What the Role Is** The Data team at Babylist powers decision\-making across the entire business — from product growth to operations to AI. This is a senior individual contributor role on the Data Engineering team, sitting at the intersection of platform thinking and AI\-native tooling. You'll own the architecture and systems that make data engineering itself more scalable — not just the pipelines, but the harnesses and agentic scaffolding that generate, test, and maintain them. You'll work cross\-functionally with analysts, data scientists, and product teams to keep Babylist's data infrastructure reliable and ahead of where the business is going. **Who You Are** * Experienced building production AI/LLM systems — RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, tool integrations (e.g., MCP servers) that real users depend on, not just prototypes * Platform\-minded — you see repetitive data engineering work as a system design problem and build the scaffolding to automate it * Deeply fluent in Python and production\-grade data engineering, with 7\+ years building systems that hold up at scale * Proficient with Airflow and dbt — you understand data modeling and ETL principles, not just the tooling * Comfortable in AWS — you've provisioned and managed cloud data resources across EC2, S3, Lambda, and EKS * Familiar with Snowflake or comparable modern cloud data warehouses * Able to work cross\-functionally with analysts and data scientists — translating their needs into infrastructure that actually serves them * You naturally reach for AI in your work — at Babylist, every team uses AI daily. You're already using it to move faster and improve your output, and you stay curious about what's coming next. * **You're genuinely excited about what AI can do \-** not just as a concept, but as something you want to get your hands on. At Babylist, every team uses AI daily, and we're looking for people who lean in. **How You Will Make An Impact** * Build and scale data pipelines for ingestion into Snowflake — with a focus on reliability and performance across a $750M\+ e\-commerce business * Design and ship the agentic systems that perform data engineering work — pipeline generation, testing, and maintenance as automated systems, not one\-off builds * Develop and maintain ML pipelines that help data scientists operationalize models and integrate them with our data infrastructure * Implement and improve data monitoring across complex, multi\-system user journeys * Collaborate with Analytics Engineers on data modeling and the reliability of shared data assets * Partner with product, analyst, and ML teams to deliver end\-to\-end data solutions — from ingestion to advanced analytics and AI **Why This Role** * You're building the meta\-layer — not just pipelines, but the systems that build pipelines; it's a rare scope for a data engineering role * The data infrastructure is solid; you're extending and automating something that works, not inheriting a mess * AI is core to the mandate here, not a future aspiration — agentic data engineering is a real part of the roadmap, not a stretch goal * You'll have direct influence on how a 9M\+ user platform scales its data systems through a pre\-IPO growth moment. **About Compensation** We use a market\-based approach to compensation. The starting salary range for this role is: **$186,086\.000 \- $223,270 \+ target 15% annual bonus** Your starting salary will be based on your location, experience, and qualifications, with increases over time tied to performance, role growth, and internal pay equity. **Who We Are** Babylist is the leading platform for expecting and new families. More than 10 million people shop with Babylist every year, making it the go\-to destination for seamless purchasing, guidance, and expert recommendations. As a modern, AI\-forward tech company, Babylist has expanded from a universal registry into a full ecosystem — the Babylist Shop, Babylist Health, Babylist Money, NYC and LA showrooms, branded content, and more — generating $750M in revenue in 2025\. Building the generational brand in baby, Babylist is reshaping the $235B kids and baby market and helping parents feel confident, connected, and cared for at every step. **Our Ways of Working** Babylist is remote\-first with team members across the U.S. and Canada who move fast, think smart, and use AI as part of how they work every day — not as an experiment, as an expectation. We come together twice a year to build the relationships behind the work, and we hire people who are genuinely excited about what's possible and prove it through how they show up. **Why You Will Love Working At Babylist** **Our Culture** * We work with focus and intention, then step away to recharge * We believe in exceptional management, and we invest in the tools and the time to connect with colleagues * We build products that positively impact millions of people's lives * AI is part of how we work, not a side experiment. You'll have leading tools like Claude and ChatGPT from day one, with no waiting on access, so the busywork gets handled and your judgment goes where it counts **Growth \& Development** * Competitive pay and meaningful opportunities for career advancement * We believe technology and data can solve hard problems * We're committed to career progression and performance\-based advancement **Benefits** * Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance * Retirement savings plan with company matching and flexible spending accounts * Generous paid parental leave and PTO * Winter Wonder Week: the whole company takes a paid week off at the end of the year, whether or not you celebrate anything, so everyone's out at once and comes back refreshed * Remote work stipend to set up your office * Perks for physical, mental, and emotional health, parenting, childcare, and financial planning ### **Important Notices** **Recorded Interviews.** Babylist uses an interview recording tool to record and transcribe interviews for evaluation purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. By participating in an interview, you consent to this recording and transcription. **Interview Integrity.** AI is part of how we work at Babylist — we expect you to use it too. Your application and interviews should still reflect you and your own thinking. We'll tell you when AI is encouraged. Misrepresentation at any stage may result in removal from consideration for this and future roles. **How We Review Applications** We use AI throughout our hiring process to help review, screen, and assess applications. These tools support our team's review; they do not replace it, and every hiring decision is made by a person. **Connections at Babylist.** If you have a family member or close personal relationship with a current Babylist employee, please let your recruiter know. This helps us keep our process fair and transparent for everyone. **Protect Yourself from Scams.** All official outreach comes from the Babylist Talent Team via @babylist.com email addresses only. We will never ask for payment or personal financial information. If you receive outreach via WhatsApp, Telegram, or a non\-Babylist email — it's not us. Verify open roles at babylist.com/careers.

jobs.description: **How to apply:** Please complete your application on our hiring platform at https://app.intervuze.com/interview/upload/2dcab9b2\-a69b\-4378\-bb2c\-bdaf971bca60?utm\_source\=indeed\&utm\_medium\=web\&utm\_campaign\=indeed\_web **About us** Bake More Pies is a full\-service digital agency in Tampa. We do branding, marketing, technology, video production through BMP Studio, and a fast\-growing AI practice. Our AI Division builds real software for real businesses. That means voice and chat agents that sit on client websites, reporting platforms that pull data from a dozen sources every month, document automation that reads thousands of invoices, and computer vision on cellular cameras in the field. We also sell our own SaaS product. The team is small, so the work you ship is the work clients use. **The role** We're hiring a full\-stack engineer who can take a client's messy problem, turn it into a Laravel app with AI at its core, put it into production, and keep it running. You'll own several client systems at once, from the first architecture sketch to the monthly support call. In your first six months you will likely: * Take over a live property\-marketing reporting platform that pulls from CRMs, analytics, call tracking, and listing sites, then emails branded PDF reports to more than 150 properties every month. * Finish a computer vision system that reads fill levels from cellular cameras through FTP and alerts operations staff. * Improve an invoice\-matching pipeline that uses an LLM to read about 1,500 vendor invoices a month and match them to accounts. * Add features to a production quoting tool for a hurricane\-protection manufacturer. * Clean up and extend an ERP and CRM built on our internal Laravel platform. * Contribute to our voice and chat AI product, which runs on a real\-time speech model through a Node.js WebSocket layer. You'll work daily with AI coding agents, and we expect you to be good at directing them and better at checking what they produce. **What you'll do** * Build features in Laravel, Livewire, and Filament, starting from user stories with clear acceptance criteria. * Integrate LLMs into production workflows: extraction, summaries, retrieval over a knowledge base, and real\-time voice. * Connect outside systems through REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks, FTP, and scrapers for sites that have no API. * Deploy and operate apps on Laravel Cloud and Forge, including queues, scheduled jobs, workers, DNS, and mail. * Write tests first for bug fixes, and keep the suite green before every merge. * Review AI\-generated code with care, and use automated review tools as a second check, not the only one. * Give written estimates before you start, track your time daily, and flag overruns the same day. * Keep docs current: a README, a runbook, and a short status note on every open task. * Handle secrets and client data safely: keys in environment config, least\-privilege access, and rotation when something leaks. * Demo work to clients, run QA sessions with them, and explain technical tradeoffs in plain language. * Join our daily scrum and help shape architecture with the VP of AI. **What you need** * 3\+ years building and shipping PHP applications in production, with at least 2 years on Laravel (version 10 or later). * Hands\-on work with Livewire or Filament, plus Tailwind and Alpine.js. * At least one shipped feature that calls a hosted LLM API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or similar), with error handling, retries, and cost controls. * Solid MySQL skills: schema design, migrations, and data backfills you can verify. * Experience with queues and scheduled jobs (Redis, Horizon, or similar). * Comfort with OAuth, webhooks, and third\-party APIs, including ones with poor documentation. * A testing habit with PHPUnit or Pest. * Experience deploying and debugging a Laravel app on your own (Laravel Cloud, Forge, or a VPS). * Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, and a clear method for reviewing their output. * Clear written and spoken communication with non\-technical clients. * Ability to work in our Tampa office on hybrid days. **Nice to have** * Node.js and WebSockets, especially real\-time audio or streaming APIs. * Python, OCR, or computer vision experience. * Retrieval\-augmented generation and vector search (Postgres with pgvector, or a hosted file search). * Experience with business systems such as QuickBooks Online, a CRM, Airtable, or a contact center platform. * Web scraping that holds up against JavaScript\-heavy sites and logins. * IoT, cellular devices, or 3D CAD for simple hardware enclosures. * Agency or consulting background with several clients at once. * Interest in leading client AI audits and discovery sessions. **Hiring process** A 30\-minute phone screen, a 60\-minute technical conversation, a short paid exercise, and a client demo role\-play. We aim to make a decision within three weeks of your first call. **When you apply, include a short note about an AI feature you shipped: what it did, what broke, and how you fixed it. Links to code or a live demo help.** Bake More Pies is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status. Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Tampa, FL 33607

jobs.title: Global IT Software Engineer Senior Director & Tech Area Lead - Legal
jobs.description: **Locations**: Boston \| London Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. What You'll Do In today’s rapidly evolving legal and regulatory landscape, Legal has never been more strategic — or more technically complex. BCG is at a pivotal moment: transforming how we manage contracts, conflicts, and compliance, and how we apply agentic AI, data, and automation to reduce risk and unlock capacity at scale. We are committed to becoming a benchmark for excellence in professional services — not just in what we say, but in how we show up, what we measure, and how we continuously innovate. Realising this vision demands leadership — someone who combines deep technical legal\-technology expertise with the ability to drive cross\-functional transformation, influence senior stakeholders, and translate strategic ambition into measurable outcomes. As the Technical Area Lead (TAL) for Legal, you will be BCG’s foremost technical authority on legal technology. You will define how the Legal function technically operates, set the standards and architecture for how legal capability is built and delivered, and act as the connective tissue between legal strategy and technical execution across the firm — ensuring alignment across platforms, teams, and stakeholders. You will lead with both breadth — spanning contract lifecycle management, conflict clearance, legal knowledge management, eDiscovery \& litigation support, matter allocation \& management, insurance, corporate elections, and agentic AI — and depth, setting the technical direction that underpins major legal technology programs. You will oversee key decisions — including short\-term delivery trade\-offs vs. long\-term capability build, platform and vendor selection, SDLC best\-practices, and the establishment and regular review of technology and AI\-quality observability and health metrics — while providing clarity and direction where priorities, ownership, or approaches are not well defined. From a people\-management perspective, you will lead legal technology chapter leads and specialists across Software Engineering \& AI, SaaS Engineering, Quality Assurance, Data, and L2 Operations, managing external vendor relationships where relevant. You will work closely with the Legal Portfolio to ensure alignment between legal technology capability and BCG’s risk, compliance, and commercial priorities. **In partnership with the Legal Portfolio** * Create and deliver on the portfolio’s vision, strategy, and outcomes. * Provide technical oversight and alignment across key legal platforms (e.g. contract lifecycle management, conflicts clearing, matter management, knowledge management) to deliver on the BCG legal technology strategy and execute against agreed direction, ensuring they operate cohesively across the ecosystem. * Continuously monitor and evaluate emerging trends in legal technology, agentic AI, and automation to identify opportunities. * Ensure that all legal technology programmes and chapter initiatives deliver on the portfolio’s risk, compliance, and commercial ambitions. * Regularly assess the portfolio’s strategic approach against BCG’s global priorities and adjust in response to changing regulatory conditions and technological innovation. * Foster close collaboration between Legal, Tech, Data, and business functions to ensure legal technology solutions are commercially aligned, technically sound, and aligned with enterprise and architectural principles. * Act as a point of escalation when work spans multiple teams or systems, ensuring alignment and timely resolution of issues. **Align and guide legal technology in line with BCG’s product and IT standards** * Ensure adherence to firm\-wide standards, including alignment with BCG’s Architectural roadmap and enterprise architecture principles, while adapting them to meet the Legal Portfolio’s needs and providing guidance where standards, ownership, or approaches are unclear. * Partner with enterprise architecture, data, risk, security, and compliance governance teams to ensure all legal technology activity complies with relevant standards, guidelines, and regulatory  o set technical direction and evaluate trade\-offs even where delivery is executed by your engineering teams. * Strong command of the legal technology landscape — including contract lifecycle management, conflicts clearing, matter management, knowledge management, and emerging agentic AI platforms — with the ability to connect and align these systems effectively. * Extensive background and demonstrable outcomes from delivering custom development programmes leveraging major cloud providers, serverless technologies, and * Familiarity with agile methodologies and ways of working (Scrum, agile delivery, iterative development), with the ability to apply a servant leadership mindset and provide direction across multiple teams and dependencies. Who You'll Work With * BCG Legal Leadership team and General Counsel. * Technology leadership and enterprise architects. * Legal Portfolio chapter leads — driving capability development, platforms, and delivery. * Legal Portfolio Lead — translating business priorities into legal technology requirements and stakeholder alignment. * Portfolio and technical leaders across Risk, Compliance, Data, and Information Security. Additional info At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development. For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices. We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork. \*\*\* For US locations only \*\*\* In the US, we have a compensation transparency approach. Total compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, retirement contribution, and a market leading benefits package described below. The base salary range for this role in Boston is $195,000 \- $242,500\. This is an estimated range, however, specific base salaries within the range depend on various factors such as experience and skill set. It is not common for new BCG employees to be hired at the high\-end of the salary range. BCG regularly reviews its ranges to ensure market competitiveness. In addition to your base salary, your total compensation will include a bonus of up to 45% and a generous retirement contribution that starts at 10%. Senior Directors are also eligible for a Firm Performance Bonus. All of our plans provide best in class coverage: Zero dollar ($0\) health insurance premiums for BCG employees, spouses, and children Low $10 (USD) copays for trips to the doctor, urgent care visits and prescriptions for generic drugs Dental coverage, including up to $5,000 in orthodontia benefits Vision insurance with coverage for both glasses and contact lenses annually Reimbursement for gym memberships and other fitness activities Fully vested Profit Sharing Retirement Fund contributions made annually, whether you contribute or not, plus the option for employees to make personal contributions to a 401(k) plan Paid Parental Leave and other family benefits such as elective egg freezing, surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement Generous paid time off including 12 holidays per year, an annual office closure between Christmas and New Years, and 15 vacation days per year (earned at 1\.25 days per month) Paid sick time on an as needed basis Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** **Sr. Manufacturing Quality Engineer** **Location:** Waltham, MA (Boston Dynamics HQ) **Department:** Prototype Operations **About Boston Dynamics** Boston Dynamics is a global leader in robotics innovation, renowned for developing highly advanced, dynamic robots that excel in mobility, dexterity, and intelligence. Our cutting\-edge robots, including the iconic Atlas, Spot, and Stretch, are pushing the boundaries of automation and redefining how machines interact with the world. At Boston Dynamics, we blend advanced mechanical design, state\-of\-the\-art control systems, and AI\-driven perception to create robots capable of performing in unstructured, real\-world environments. We are looking for a talented Sr. Manufacturing Quality Engineer to support the Atlas program by driving quality directly on the manufacturing floor and managing root cause corrective action projects. This role is key to transforming next\-generation humanoid robots from early prototypes into high\-performing systems with scalable, reliable processes. **About the Role** As a Sr. Manufacturing Quality Engineer \- Atlas, you will serve as the primary quality lead on the manufacturing floor, providing real\-time technical triage and hands\-on support for build and repair operations. You will take ownership of non\-conformances, lead complex root cause corrective action (8D) projects, and manage cross\-functional teams to permanently resolve systemic defects. You will collaborate daily with Atlas Supply Chain, Build, Repair, Hardware Engineering, and Reliability teams to identify failure modes immediately, implement rapid floor\-level controls, and increase first\-pass yield. This role requires a hands\-on, highly responsive mindset, a deep understanding of electromechanical systems, and the ability to triage floor issues efficiently while driving long\-term corrective action project timelines. **Responsibilities** * **Floor Support \& Triage:** Provide active, daily floor support to technicians and build leads, rapidly triaging build issues, part non\-conformances, and assembly failures in real time. * **Root Cause Management:** Drive structured Root Cause Analysis and lead end\-to\-end Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) projects for complex mechanical and electromechanical defects. * **MRB \& Non\-Conformance Ownership:** Lead the Material Review Board (MRB) process, dispositioning non\-conforming hardware quickly to minimize shop\-floor downtime while tracking defect trends. * **In\-Process Quality Controls:** Implement and enforce immediate containment actions, floor\-level quality gates, and in\-process inspection standards for active builds and repairs. * **Cross\-Functional Execution:** Coordinate with Design Engineering, Reliability, and Operations to assign ownership and track action items for closed\-loop corrective action projects. * **Process Standardization:** Partner with Build and Repair teams to update work instructions, SOPs, and inspection checklists based on RCCA project outcomes to prevent issue recurrence. * **Metrics \& Trend Analysis:** Track, analyze, and present manufacturing floor defect Pareto charts, first\-pass yield (FPY) loss drivers, and CAPA resolution cycle times. * **Escalation \& Communication:** Act as the direct conduit between the manufacturing floor and engineering teams to escalate critical build blockers and technical design flaws. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; Master’s degree is a plus or comparable industry experience. * At least 3–6 years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality engineering, with strong experience in direct shop\-floor support. * Advanced proficiency in root cause analysis methodologies (8D, 5 Whys, Fishbone, DMAIC) applied to electromechanical systems. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience triaging non\-conformances, managing MRB workflows, and issuing line containment actions in a fast\-paced environment. * Strong ability to read engineering drawings, assembly specs, and GD\&T to assess non\-conforming conditions on the floor. * Experience developing and deploying floor\-level control plans, containment protocols, and inspection standard operating procedures. * Excellent project management skills, with a track record of driving cross\-functional teams to close out root cause corrective action projects on schedule. Comfortable working directly on the production floor alongside build technicians and shop personnel. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Strong knowledge of non\-conformance tracking tools, MES/QMS platforms, and quality metrics dashboards (e.g., FPY, Scrap, CAPA cycle time). * Experience supporting robotics, complex actuators, or high\-density electromechanical assemblies. * Six Sigma Green/Black Belt certification. * Familiarity with PLM systems for engineering change order (ECO) implementation resulting from corrective actions. Experience using statistical analysis software such as Minitab, JMP or similar to analyze manufacturing data to monitor processes \& aid root cause analysis. * The pay range for this position is between $90,000 to $105,000\. Base pay will depend on multiple individualized factors including, but not limited to internal equity, job related knowledge, skills and experience. This range represents a good faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Boston Dynamics offers a generous Benefits package including medical, dental vision, 401(k), paid time off and a annual bonus structure. Additional details regarding these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer for employment.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I, Core Objects
jobs.description: At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew. We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work\-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization. To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success. Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one\-of\-a\-kind vibrancy into our culture. If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** Core data objects are at the base of Braze's product offering and power our industry\-leading customer engagement tool. The Core Objects team owns our customers' most valuable data structures — the foundation that enables them to use Braze most effectively and implement their most innovative strategies. The team extensively integrates AI into its daily workflow, leveraging agentic tools to navigate our large Ruby monolith, create proof of concepts, and transition quickly and safely from an ask to a working solution. AI has been used across all stages of product delivery, fundamentally enhancing the team's ability to deliver high\-quality results more efficiently. We're looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer to help us tackle significant engineering challenges, such as: extending our high\-scale ingestion pipeline to ingest new and advanced data objects, optimizing performance and cost, and owning a complex backend system that enables our entire product offering. You'll take on a variety of challenges as we set out to build new exciting projects in extending and building our Core Objects systems and features. **WHO YOU ARE** * 5\+ years of full\-stack development experience * Experienced technical leader * Strong understanding of design, data structures, and algorithms * A self\-starter with great communication and organizational skills and will have worked in a team environment before Bonus points: * Professional experience building software at scale * Professional experience with one or more of Ruby, Ruby on Rails, React, Go, SQL, and NoSQL databases, distributed systems, API design/monitoring/best practices * Experience with agile processes * Passionate about customer experience For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $128,842 and $232,200/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $144,000 and $258,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company. \#LI\-Hybrid **WHAT WE OFFER** *Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at* *here**. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.* From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work\-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as: * Competitive compensation that may include equity * Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans * Flexible paid time off * Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability * Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave * Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend * A curated in\-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation * Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company\-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching * Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze * Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work® **ABOUT BRAZE** Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout th s and World Report, a 2025 America's Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore. The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo. **BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER** At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization. Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you. We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we'd love to meet you **OUR AI\-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS** At Braze, we're committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI\-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process. This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision\-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process. Depending on where you are located, you may have certain rights available to you in relation to Braze's use of AI: * To opt out of AI\-assisted review of your application, please click the "Learn More" at the end of the application form below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application. * To exercise other types of rights, such as rights to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to request a manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision, please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com. Please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com with any questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out this page. **Notice Regarding Automated Employment Decision Tool (NYC Local Law 144\)** Our use of AI during the application review process may include the use of automated employment decision tools. Pursuant to New York City Local Law 144, for roles based in New York City, or if you reside in New York City, you have the right to request an alternative selection process or a reasonable accommodation instead of AI\-assisted review. To opt out of AI\-assisted review of your application, please click the "Learn More" button below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application. jobs.description: At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. Broadridge is seeking an early\-career Full Stack Developer to help build secure, scalable, and intuitive business applications. This role is ideal for a recent graduate with practical experience in JavaScript, React, Stencil.js, Java, and Spring Boot who is eager to grow in an agile engineering environment. The successful candidate will contribute across the software development lifecycle (SDLC), from requirements refinement and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support. The role requires a practical understanding of artificial intelligence (AI), including how to apply AI responsibly to improve engineering outcomes. Over time, the developer will work productively in a human\-and\-agent delivery model alongside AI agents and engineering teammates **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, debug, and maintain full\-stack software features using JavaScript, React, Stencil.js, Java, and Spring Boot. * Build accessible, reusable user\-interface components and integrate them with secure, reliable backend services and APIs * Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. * Translate user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical designs into high\-quality, maintainable code. * Write and maintain unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests; investigate defects and contribute to continuous quality improvements. * Collaborate with product owners, designers, quality engineers, architects, and senior developers to deliver customer\-focused outcomes. * Follow established engineering standards for source control, peer review, documentation, security, performance, observability, and release management * Support application troubleshooting and production issue resolution, escalating risks and blockers promptly. **AI and Agent\-Enabled Engineering** * Demonstrate a working understanding of generative AI concepts, including prompting, context management, model limitations, hallucinations, bias, privacy, and secure use of AI\-enabled tools. * Use approved AI\-assisted development tools to support research, code generation, test creation, documentation, debugging, and refactoring, while management * Identify suitable tasks for AI agents, provide clear context and guardrails, review agent outputs, and integrate validated results into the engineering workflow. * Work effectively in a team of human engineers and AI agents by communicating task context, documenting decisions, and escalating uncertainty or potential risk. * Protect confidential information, customer data, intellectual property, credentials, and proprietary source code when using AI\-enabled tools; follow all Broadridge AI, security, and data\-handling policies * Share practical learnings and propose responsible, measurable improvements to AI\-enabled software delivery practices. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered. * 1–3 years of relevant software\-development experience, including internships, co\-op assignments, academic projects, jobs.title: Warehouse Assoc
jobs.description: JOB SUMMARY Non\-Exempt The purpose of this position is to manage the Warehouse Operations: shipping/receiving, storing, and issuing materials, equipment and/or other items from stockroom, warehouse, or storage yard. Responsible for the safe receipt, storage, retrieval and timely dispatch of goods. **USE:** Energy and Sustainability ONLY ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Prepares documents and shipping orders. Packs, seals, and labels materials for shipping using most cost effective method of shipping via US Mail, UPS, Fed Ex or other carriers. Examines contents and compares with records to verify accuracy of outgoing shipments. Determines shipping method for materials, using knowledge of shipping procedures, routes and rates. Records shipment data, such as weight, charges, space availability, and damages and discrepancies, for reporting, accounting and record\-keeping purposes. Contacts carrier representative to make arrangements and to issue instructions for shipping and delivery of materials. Confers and corresponds with required representative to rectify problems, such as damages, shortages, and nonconformance specifications. Requisitions and stores shipping materials and supplies to maintain inventory of stock. Keeps records on the use and/or damage of stock or stock handling equipment. Receives all material and compare to packing list. Examines and inspects received items for breakage, reporting any damage to purchasing agent. Marks, packs and unpacks items to be stocked on shelves in warehouse according to corporate standards. Layout and builds control panels according to designs provided by engineering. Wires panels according to designs and appropriate regulatory standards in a neat and workmanlike manner. Marks all project shelves with job number, job name and PM assigned to the project. The area where material is placed needs to be clearly marked so that it is not accidentally removed for another project. Any material that is transferred to or from any stock location must be properly documented within the accounting system, and/or a packing list prepared for shipment to the customer. SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES Issues or distributes materials, products, parts, and supplies to customers or coworkers, based on information from incoming requisitions. Other duties may be assigned. No formal supervisory responsibilities in this position. May provide informal assistance such as technical guidance, and/or training to coworkers. May coordinate and assign tasks to co\-workers within a work unit and/or project. QUALIFICATIONS To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. * Physical requirements to include stooping, standing, climbing and frequent lifting of a minimum of 50 lbs. • A comprehensive understanding of a range of processes, procedures, systems, and concepts within own job function is required. • Ability to evaluate and communicates unusual and/or complex content in a concise and logical way. • In\-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc. • Advanced organizational skills with an inquisitive mindset. • Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate advanced figures such as percentages, discounts, and markups EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE High School diploma or GED (General Education Degree) Minimum of 3 years related work experience in warehouse, shipping and receiving. CERTIFICATES and/or LICENSES None COMMUNICATION SKILLS A valid driver's license with a good driving record for applicable vehicles, without restrictions, or limiting conditions. (Corrective lenses permitted) Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong organizational and analytical skills. Ability to provide efficient, timely, reliable and courteous service to customers. Ability to effectively present information. Knowledge of the structure and content of the English language including the meaning and spelling of words, rules of composition and grammar. Must be an active listener, giving full attention to what others people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times. FINANCIAL KNOWLEDGE Requires knowledge of financial terms and principles. Ability to calculate intermediate figures such as percentages, discounts, and/or commissions. Conducts basic financial analysis. Possess a working knowledge of arithmetic. REASONING ABILITY Ability to comprehend, analyze, and interpret documents. Ability to solve problems involving several options in situations. Requires intermediate analytical and quantitative skills. Must possess critical thinking skills using logic and reasoning to identify strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions and approaches to problems. Must possess problem solving skills and be able to identify problems and review related information to develop and evaluate options and offer/implement solutions. OTHER SKILLS and ABILITIES Must be well organized with a strong attention to detail and accuracy. Able to meet deadlines with multiple tasks and projects in fast paced, changing environment Ability to work closely with customers, subcontractors, engineers, designers, project managers, sales, shipping and receiving and panel shop to help Operations facilitate on\-time and on\-budget projects SCOPE OF RESPONSIBILITY Knowledge of computer hardware and software including applications. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Word. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and capable of adapting learning to incorporate new technology. Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics software helpful. Must be able to type 55\-65 wpm and be able to use a 10\-key Decisions made with general understanding of procedures and company policies to achieve set results and deadlines. Errors in judgment may cause short\-term impact to co\-workers and supervisor. CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the Warehouse Associate position is \[$26\.44 per hour] and the maximum salary for the Warehouse Associate position is \[$ 44\.71 per hour]. The compensation that is offered to a successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience. This role will provide the following benefits: 401(K), Dental insurance, Health insurance, Life insurance, and Vision insurance. **Equal Employment Opportunity:** CBRE is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We have a long\-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law. **Candidate Accommodations:** CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. CBRE provides reasonable accommodations in job application procedures for individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at recruitingaccommodations@cbre.com or via telephone at \+1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and \+1 866 388 4346 (Canada).

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Billing
jobs.description: **The Role** ------------ Comfy lets people build creative workflows that combine open\-source models running on our GPUs with paid APIs from model providers. Every run has a cost. Customers need to understand what they’re spending, and we need to charge accurately as models, prices, and products change. You’ll own the engineering behind that: how we meter usage, collect payments, manage credits and subscriptions, and protect against financial abuse. You’ll make billing dependable for customers and give the team the tools to launch new pricing models with confidence. Our billing stack uses Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Temporal, Stripe, and Metronome, alongside Python and Kubernetes across the broader platform. You’ll evolve an existing system, work across service boundaries, and take changes from design through production. **What you’ll do** * **Capture usage reliably.** Build metering for GPU compute and partner model APIs. Handle delayed events, retries, and partial failures so every billable event is recorded once and attributed to the right workspace. * **Own the payment lifecycle.** Improve checkout, subscriptions, credit top\-ups, plan and seat changes, prorations, refunds, and failed\-payment recovery. Keep Stripe, Metronome, and our application state consistent when events arrive late or systems fail halfway through. * **Reconcile charges, payments, and credits.** Build automated checks across usage records, invoices, payments, and credit balances. Detect discrepancies, give operators an audit trail, and recover safely when a payment succeeds but credits never arrive. Own production reliability and turn incidents into lasting improvements. * **Make new pricing easier to ship.** Build reusable pricing and entitlement systems for individual creators, teams, and enterprise customers. Make changes safe for existing subscribers as we introduce new models, products, and plans. * **Limit financial abuse.** Improve spend controls and detection of suspicious usage, payment fraud, and credit abuse. Work with Support and Finance on disputes and recovery while keeping checkout and legitimate usage smooth. * **Give customers and teammates clear answers.** Partner with product and frontend engineers on billing experiences, and build tools that let Support, Sales, and Finance investigate charges and resolve issues safely. **You might be a good fit if you** * Have built and operated billing or payments systems in production, with meaningful ownership of usage metering, credits, or consumption\-based pricing. * Have integrated Stripe directly and worked through subscription changes, invoices, webhooks, and payment failures beyond the happy path. * Can reason carefully about money across distributed systems: idempotency, concurrent updates, reconciliation, rounding, and recovery after partial failure. You can explain how you found and prevented a real billing error. * Are a strong backend engineer with experience in relational data modeling and reliable APIs. You can learn our stack and work across services to solve a customer problem. * Care about the experience behind the numbers. You can explain technical tradeoffs to Finance, Product, and Support and use their feedback to build better systems. * Take ownership from problem definition through rollout and operation. The most powerful workflow engine for visual AI. Unlike tools that hide everything behind a prompt box, Comfy lets you connect models, processing steps, and outputs on a canvas where every decision is visible and every step is inspectable. It gives you the building blocks to create workflows nobody's imagined yet, and share them with everyone. What started as an open\-source project in 2023 now has 4 million users, 60,000\+ community\-built nodes, and 150,000\+ daily downloads. It's used by artists, filmmakers, game studios, designers, researchers, and VFX houses, including teams at OpenAI, Netflix, Amazon Studios, Ubisoft, EA, and Tencent. We're a small, intense team in San Francisco. Our team comes from Stability AI and Google, and many contributed to the ComfyUI ecosystem long before working here. Low ego, high ownership. We work hard and demand a lot of each other, but we have fun. Everyone here is building something meaningful that will end up being our life's work. If this mission excites you and you view yourself as top\-tier talent, your future latent self is waiting for you at Comfy. Check out our Github (https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI) and blog (https://blog.comfy.org). We recently raised $30M at a $500M valuation. The round was led by Craft, with participation from Pace Capital, Chemistry, TruArrow, and others. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

jobs.title: Director, Data Scientist - Global Payment Network
jobs.description: Director, Data Scientist \- Global Payment Network Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast\-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data\-driven decision\-making. As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives. **Team Description** The Global Payment Network Data Solutions and Modeling team builds the machine learning and AI agents to drive foundational, scalable intelligence capabilities that power smarter business decisions and unlock new value across the payments ecosystem. We create models and AI tools to support fraud/risk, merchant acceptance, merchant intelligence and monitoring. **Role Description** **In this role, you will:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love * Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data * Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation * Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals **The Ideal Candidate is:** * A leader. jobs.title: Data Architect
jobs.description: Overview: **Data Architect** **Arlington, VA** Are you ready to enhance your skills and build your career in a rapidly evolving business climate? Are you looking for a career where professional development is embedded in your employer’s core culture? If so, Chenega Military, Intelligence \& Operations Support (MIOS) could be the place for you! Join our team of professionals who support large\-scale government operations by leveraging cutting\-edge technology and take your career to the next level! We deliver essential technology services to our customers in support of their missions to sustain the national security and economic interests of our nation. SecuriGence is seeking an experienced **Data Architect** to support the SAGE Team’s architecture and modernization efforts within the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) Information Technology Directorate (ITD) environment. The SAGE Team provides architectural support for on premises and multi\-cloud enterprises operating across Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure environments, including Impact Level 4 (IL4\) and Impact Level 6 (IL6\) as well as SAP workloads. The environment currently includes relational database platforms, Microsoft SQL Server, and AWS Relational Database Service (RDS). The **Data Architect** will lead the development and execution of a modern data architecture strategy that improves scalability, resiliency, security, automation, interoperability, and operational efficiency for both structured and unstructured data assets across the DARPA environment. A central focus of the role is guiding the transition from infrastructure\-as\-a\-service (IaaS)\-based database deployments to secure, containerized and platform\-oriented data solutions where operationally appropriate while also rationalizing and organizing disparate data sources (including legacy databases, file shares, and ad hoc research data stores) into governed, cataloged, and analytically usable forms. Help us solve problems with Innovation Through Intelligence. Responsibilities: * Develop and maintain the target\-state data architecture, roadmap, standards, and reference patterns for DARPA ITD multi\-cloud environments. * Assess existing relational database platforms, including Microsoft SQL Server and AWS RDS as well as other data stores such as shared file systems and ad hoc research repositories, and develop modernization recommendations for performance, availability, security, lifecycle management, and cost optimization. * Design secure, scalable, highly available, and resilient data solutions supporting AWS, Azure, IL4, and IL6 environments. * Lead architecture decisions related to database modernization, containerized database platforms, managed database services, data replication, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, and cross\-environment data integration including patterns for integrating data from legacy file shares and heterogeneous research data sources into enterprise data platforms. * Define architectural patterns for transitioning appropriate database workloads from traditional IaaS deployments to container\-based solutions, including Kubernetes\-based platforms. * Establish data architecture standards for database provisioning, configuration management, schema management, data lifecycle management, encryption, auditing, logging, monitoring, and operational support. * Partners with cloud architects, cybersecurity personnel, infrastructure engineers, application teams, DevSecOps engineers, and program stakeholders to align data solutions with enterprise architecture and mission requirements. * Ensure data platform designs support applicable DoW cybersecurity, risk\-management, security\-control, identity, access\-control, logging, and continuous\-monitoring requirements. * Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, and repeatable deployment patterns for database and data\-platform services. * Evaluate commercial cloud\-native, open\-source, and government\-approved data technologies; prepare technical recommendations, trade studies, decision papers, and implementation plans. * Support architecture reviews, technical design reviews, modernization of working groups, and senior\-leader briefings. * Develop technical documentation, including data models, logical and physical data architectures, interface specifications, operating procedures, reference architectures, and migration plans. * Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers and administrators supporting database and data\-platform operations. * Other duties as assigned. Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related technical field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered. * 10\+ years of progressive experience in data architecture, database engineering, database administration, cloud architecture, or related technical roles. * 5\+ years of experience designing, implementing, and supporti architecture principles, including logical and physical data modeling, metadata management, data governance, data integration, data quality, retention, and lifecycle management. * Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, backup, restoration, replication, encryption, database auditing, and performance monitoring. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Ability to produce clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, migration roadmaps, and decision\-ready recommendations. * Advanced knowledge of multi\-cloud data architecture, with demonstrated skill in designing and implementing secure, scalable, and resilient data solutions across AWS and Azure, including for IL4 and IL6 environments. * Expertise in database modernization strategies, including the ability to lead migrations from IaaS\-hosted databases (e.g., SQL Server) to managed cloud\-native services (e.g., AWS RDS) and containerized platforms like Kubernetes. * Proven ability to develop and implement data governance frameworks, covering data modeling, metadata management, data quality, and lifecycle management to consolidate and organize disparate data sources into analytically usable forms. * Skill in applying DevSecOps principles to data platforms, including the use of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and automation to manage and deploy database services securely and efficiently. * Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to create clear technical documentation, present complex architectural decisions to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and mentor engineering teams **How you’ll grow** At Chenega MIOS, our professional development plan focuses on helping our team members at every level of their careers to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer opportunities to help sharpen skills in addition to hands\-on experience in the global, fast\-changing business world. From on\-the\-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their careers. **Benefits** At Chenega MIOS, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our team members and offer them a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Chenega MIOS can mean for you. **Chenega MIOS’s culture** Our positive and supportive culture encourages our team members to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well\-being programs and continuously look for new ways to maintain a culture where we excel and lead healthy, happy lives. **Corporate citizenship** Chenega MIOS is led by a purpose to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our team members, and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill\-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. Learn more about Chenega’s impact on the world. Chenega MIOS News\- https://chenegamios.com/news/ **Tips from your Talent Acquisition Team** We want job seekers exploring opportunities at Chenega MIOS to feel prepared and confident. To help you with your research, we suggest you review the following links: Chenega MIOS web site \- www.chenegamios.com Glassdoor \- https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working\-at\-Chenega\-MIOS\-EI\_IE369514\.11,23\.htm LinkedIn \- https://www.linkedin.com/company/1472684/ Facebook \- https://www.facebook.com/chenegamios/ Teleworking Permitted?: false Estimated Salary/Wage: USD $192,700\.00/Yr. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Fulfillment Technology
jobs.description: At Chewy, taking care of pets and the people who love them through the highs, the lows, and the everyday is what drives us. Grounded in that purpose and focused on our mission to be the most trusted and convenient destination for pet parents and partners everywhere, we work every day to help people feel more confident, supported, and capable in caring for the animals they love—showing up with the products, services, care, and guidance they need, whenever they need it. **Bringing that to life takes exceptional leaders.** Leadership at Chewy is guided by our Operating Principles, which define how we lead, make decisions, develop talent, serve our customers, and grow our business. We value leaders who think strategically, stay close to the customer, and aren't afraid to roll up their sleeves alongside their teams. They solve complex challenges, build high\-performing organizations, and partner closely with senior leaders to shape the future of Chewy. If you're energized by building, leading, and making a meaningful impact, this leadership opportunity may be the right fit for you. **Our Opportunity** Chewy is looking for a **Principal Software Engineer** to join our **Fulfillment Technology \& Science team.** Our fulfillment systems power critical, high\-volume operations across Chewy's warehouse network. You will set and execute the technical direction for the next evolution of our warehouse management system (WMS). You will design the architecture and bring it to life through production\-quality code, reusable patterns, and technical foundations that engineering teams can rapidly build upon. You will advance the platform using modern cloud\-first technologies while enabling more advanced analytics, optimization, machine learning, and AI\-assisted decision\-making. You will be both a technology visionary and a hands\-on technical force multiplier. You will define a practical modernization strategy around existing custom and packaged solutions, remain directly engaged in implementation, and establish the architecture and standards needed to evolve the platform safely. You will create a flexible integration architecture that connects the WMS with intelligent decisioning systems, robotics, warehouse control systems, and other packaged platforms without compromising the reliability or continuity of warehouse operations. You will also design and build rich, intuitive mobile experiences for warehouse associates, ensuring workflows are fast, accessible, resilient, and effective in demanding operational environments. You will actively embrace and champion AI coding tools and AI\-enabled software development frameworks to improve design quality, implementation speed, testing, documentation, and maintainability. This is a rare opportunity to shape a critical fulfillment platform, establish modern engineering practices, and build the technology foundation that will power the next generation of Chewy fulfillment. **What You'll Do** * Own and execute the incremental modernization of Chewy's core fulfillment technology. Design the target architecture and prove it through production code, reference implementations, and reusable engineering patterns. * Architect highly available, low\-latency systems across cloud and edge environments, partnering with infrastructure and networking teams to maintain warehouse operations through failures and disruptions. * Design and build rich mobile experiences for warehouse associates with a focus on usability, performance, accessibility, offline resilience, device manageability, and rapid task execution. * Establish a robust workflow framework for fulfillment operations that can adapt to evolving business needs, including explicit state management, validation, exception handling, retries, recovery, observability, and consistent execution across channels and sites. * Design extensible integration patterns across custom and packaged solutions, machine learning and optimization models, robotics, and warehouse control systems, with clear ownership, guardrails, fallback behaviors, and auditable data flows. * Define patterns that capture the history of operational events, decisions, workflow transitions, and system changes so critical processes can be traced, explained, reconciled, and improved. * Provide bold, decisive technical leadership across teams. Resolve ambiguity, challenge assumptions, lead critical design and code reviews, and mentor engineers to raise the technical bar. **What You'll Need** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Master's degree preferred. * 12\+ years of software engineering experience designing and incrementally modernizing large\-scale, business\-critical systems. * Demonstrated experience applying AI\-assisted software development tools and workflows to accelerate the delivery of significant engineering initiatives. * Expert hands\-on programming ability in modern languages, with Java/Kotlin preferred and recent experience writing production code. * Deep AWS expertise across cloud and edge architecture, compute, networking, security, observability, infrastructure automation, and production operations. * Deep expertise designing and building high\-throughput, low\-latency, event\-driven distributed systems using Kafka or comparable streaming technologies, including concurrency, idempotency, asynchronous processing, retry and replay patterns, and tradeoffs among availability, latency, correctness, and throughput. * Deep understanding of distributed data storage technologies, including relational and NoSQL databases, key\-value stores, caching layers, and object storage. Experience selecting and designing resilient solutions for high\-volume transactional and event workloads using partitioning, replication, durability, and recovery patterns. * Experience architecting modern web and mobile applications, including applications that operate reliably in demanding environments. Familiarity with technologies such as React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Android/Kotlin is preferred. * Experience designing workflow\-driven or stateful operational systems that are flexible, resilient, and observable. * Experience integrating custom software, packaged platforms, data products, and decisioning models through well\-defined APIs, events, and data contracts. * Experience designing auditable systems, including access controls, change traceability, event history, reconciliation, and retention. * Demonstrated ability to set technical direction, influence across teams, mentor engineers, and champion modern engineering practices, including AI\-assisted and specification\-driven development. **Bonus Qualifications** * Experience with fulfillment, warehousing, supply chain, or other high\-throughput physical operations. * Experience with warehouse management systems, warehouse control systems, robotics, material handling automation, industrial controls, or related vendor integrations. * Experience building applications for mobile or industrial devices and managing software across a distributed device fleet. The base salary range for this role is $181,000 \- $300,000\.00\.* The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, education, and work location. In addition, this position is eligible for 401k and a new hire and annual equity grant. C08\+ positions may also be eligible for annual bonus. We offer different types of insurance and benefits, such as medical/Rx, vision, dental, life, disability, hospital indemnity, critical illness, and accident. We offer parental leave, family services benefits, backup dependent care, flexible spending accounts, telemedicine, pet adoption reimbursement, employee assistance program, and many discounts including 10% off pet insurance and 20% off at Chewy.com. Exempt salary team members have unlimited PTO, subject to manager approval. Team members will receive six paid holidays per year. Team members may be eligible for paid sick and family leave in compliance with applicable state and local regulations. Chewy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, citizenship, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, results of genetic testing, veteran status, as well as any other legally\-protected characteristic. If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar law, and you need an accommodation during the application process or to perform these job requirements, or if you need a religious accommodation, please contact CAAR@chewy.com.

jobs.title: Manager, Data Science- Merchandising Category Analytics
jobs.description: Manager, Data Science – Merchandising Category Analytics Global Data \& Analytics \| Alimentation Couche\-Tard Location: Charlotte, NC JOIN OUR TEAM! At Circle K, our mission is simple: to make our customers’ lives a little easier every day. You may have already stopped for coffee, refueling your car, or eating something on the go. Then, you know what Circle K is. Since the opening of a first store in Laval, Québec, our parent company, Alimentation Couche\-Tard has never ceased to grow. We have grown into a successful global company with over 17,300 stores in 29 countries, serving almost 8\.5 million customers every day. In total, more than 146,000 people work in our stores and offices. We make journeys easier by offering fast and friendly service. We care about our people and our communities, and we look for ways to uplift people first. Wherever your journey’s going, we can help you get there. Are you ready to grow your career? Let's grow together! ### **The Role** We are seeking an innovative, dynamic Data Science Manager to lead Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI initiatives for Merchandising Category Analytics. As a key leader within the Global Data \& Analytics team, you will partner with Merchandising, Category Intelligence \& Enablement (CIE), and Technology teams to translate strategic priorities into scalable, data\-driven solutions that improve decisions and business performance. The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise, commercial acumen, product thinking, and strong people leadership. You will lead a high\-performing team of data scientists, analysts, and machine learning engineers, taking solutions from opportunity identification through deployment, adoption, and measurable value realization. ### **What you’ll do** Strategy and Business Partnership* **Shape the Data Science and AI portfolio**: Develop and execute initiatives aligned with merchandising and enterprise priorities. * **Partner with business leaders**: Work with Merchandising and CIE leaders to identify high\-value opportunities, define business problems, and translate needs into analytics and AI solutions. * **Influence decisions**: Present actionable insights and recommendations to senior leaders to shape business strategy and strengthen value realization. Solution Delivery and Innovation* **Lead solution development:** Guide the design and deployment of scalable solutions across pricing, assortment, promotions, forecasting, experimentation, optimization, customer insights, and category performance. * **Advance AI and ML innovation**: Evaluate and apply emerging capabilities, including generative AI and AI agents, to improve merchandising decisions and productivity. * **Ensure end\-to\-end delivery**: Lead initiatives from data discovery and experimentation through production deployment, adoption, governance, and value realization. * **Scale capabilities**: Establish reusable methodologies, frameworks, and MLOps practices that enable solutions to scale across categories and business areas. Leadership, Governance, and Value* **Measure business value**: Define success metrics and demonstrate the measurable impact of Data Science, ML, and AI investments. * **Lead and develop talent**: Coach and develop data scientists and analysts while fostering technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. * **Collaborate across Data \& Analytics and Technology**: Partner with CIE, Data Engineering, Data Products, and Technology teams to deliver scalable, governed solutions aligned with enterprise standards. * **Champion responsible AI**: Promote strong practices for model governance, explainability, data quality, privacy, and responsible AI adoption. ### **What you’ll need** Education and Experience* Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline; an advanced business degree is an asset. * At least eight years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, or a related field, including three or more years in leadership roles delivering large\-scale initiatives. Technical Expertise* Strong knowledge of exploratory and descriptive analytics, hypothesis testing, A/B testing, experiment design, and Agile development practices. * Proficiency in Python, SQL, and R, with hands\-on experience using cloud data platforms such as Azure, Snowflake, or Databricks. * Working knowledge of data engineering workflows, including ETL, batch and real\-time processing, model deployment, MLOps, and version control. Leadership and Business Capabilities* Strong commercial mindset and demonstrated ability to translate data, analytics, and AI/ML insights into clear decisions, strategies, and business outcomes. * Proven experience in talent acquisition, team development, coaching, and mentoring. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to audiences at all levels and influence senior leaders across geographies. * Demonstrated success collaborating with cross\-functional partners, including Data Engineering, Architecture, and Data Cloud Platform teams. * Ability to prioritize multiple initiatives, communicate timelines clearly, and drive work proactively to completion. * Adaptability, curiosity, and a commitment to continuous learning across business and technology domains. ### **Success in This Role** Success will be measured by the ability to connect merchandising strategy with Data Science, ML, and AI capabilities; deliver scalable solutions with measurable business impact; and build a high\-performing data science organization. **Circle K is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** **The Company complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (the ADA) and all state and local disability laws. jobs.title: Leader, Strategy & Planning Operations
jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 10/10/2026This remote role is open to candidates in the United States, no relocation is available. Meet the Team Global Specialist Sales is standing up a formal Incubation organization to give Cisco's newest platforms and solutions a dedicated path from “0 to 1” — through customer proof points, GTM readiness, and eventual graduation into mainstream Portfolio or Hyper\-Specialist coverage. Incubation is home to products including AI Defense, Cisco Cloud Control, Agentic Security, Multicloud Fabric, and other new product introductions (NPIs) as they come online. The Incubation Sales Vice President is building out a central team—including Sales, GSI/Partnerships, Distinguished Solutions Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Sales Planning\& Operations (SP)—to lead each product’s transition through defined stage gates based on product\-market fit, operational readiness, and alignment with Core. Your Impact As the Incubation SP Leader, you are the day\-to\-day operating partner to the Incubation Vice President and leadership team. You are responsible for building the “seller\-facing plumbing” required to turn strategy into an executable go\-to\-market and sales operating model. This is a foundational role that requires defining processes from scratch, navigating a fast\-changing product roadmap, and ensuring each Incubation product can scale from initial customer acquisition to a repeatable, successful motion. Key Responsibilities * Strategy\& Operating Partnership: Serve as a strategic sparring partner to the Incubation VP on GTM strategy, resourcing, and portfolio prioritization. Lead the SP operating cadence, including QBRs, forecast reviews, and leadership reporting. * Go\-to\-Market Execution: Define GTM strategy and sales plays tailored to the product maturity curve. Build sales readiness for new products, including process design, tools, customer intake, and cross\-functional onboarding. * Governance: Support the stage\-gate/graduation framework that governs a product’s path from Incubation to Core or Hyper\-Specialist coverage, using data\-driven criteria to assess readiness. * Compensation, Coverage\& Metrics: Determine comp plans and territory/coverage models in partnership with Finance.
