jobs.description: Salary $76,983\.71 \- $134,721\.60 Annually Location PUBLIC SAFETY HQ, 12099 GOVERNMENT CENTER PKWY, FAIRFAX (EJ28\), VA Job Type FT Salary W BN Job Number 26\-01432 Department Police Opening Date 10/03/2026 Closing Date 10/16/2026 11:59 PM Eastern Pay Grade S26 Posting Type Open to General Public **Job Announcement** -------------------- Maintains network environment by responding to service calls and installing, configuring, and supporting LAN servers, virtual and physical, and networked PCs. Performs network administration, such as daily maintenance of servers, backup/recovery of user data and server system, and troubleshooting problems that arise regarding communication to the file server. Provides first\-line problem diagnosis and troubleshooting for complex network or data communications. Provides help desk problem resolution assistance; provides system organization, system documentation and training. Performs related work as required. Manages users accounts, security groups, and has a working knowledge of Active Directory. Provides quotes for hardware or software upon request and manages purchases of new hardware and software. Provides leadership and supervision to the hardware management team. Seeks consultation and maintaining relationships with the Department of Information Technology. Provides project management and asset management skills and oversight. Works under general supervision. **Illustrative Duties** ----------------------- *(The illustrative duties listed in this specification are representative of the class but are not an all\-inclusive list. A complete list of position duties and unique physical requirements can be found in the position job description.)* Provides support functions for assigned agencies; Facilitates the installation of cabling and services; Reviews, evaluates, and approves work order requests; Analyzes and prioritizes agency requirements and designs, implements, and programs software changes accordingly; Responds to customer service requests; Evaluates systems problems, performs diagnostics on suspected problems, and recommends or implements solutions; Assists the help desk in problem determination and solution; Oversees network/telecommunications projects related to new construction, agency relocations, and similar actions; Coordinates activities with planners, engineers, vendors, and agency management; Reviews time frames and cost estimates of requirements and alternatives; Schedules vendors and appropriate staff; Evaluates projects for cost effectiveness and current and future usability; Assists in the planning of distributed local area networks; Administers local area networks; Plans and implements system security; Installs, configures; Establishes backup and recovery procedures; Installs, repairs, configures, maintains, troubleshoots, and upgrades PC's, LANs, and related equipment and software; Performs site inspections to ensure adequate cabling, power and facilities; Evaluates capacity, availability, and performance of existing facilities; Evaluates the need for and implements migration from one network operating system to another. performance. * Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions for high\-severity incidents during the problem process. **Observability \& Monitoring*** Serve as a subject matter expert for jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Business Operations
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco, CA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- Acceleration **Compensation** ---------------- * $224K – $300K • Offers Equity *To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US\-based job postings. Our compensation package includes base salary, equity for all full time roles, benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans.* *This range reflects a good\-faith estimate based on the applicable pay scale, the range previously established for this role, the compensation of individuals currently in equivalent positions, and/or the budgeted amount for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, qualifications, and other factors.* *We welcome compensation discussions if this range doesn't meet your requirements. Outstanding candidates may be eligible for adjusted terms, plus meaningful equity that ensures you benefit directly from the company's long\-term performance.* *Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.* **About Fluidstack** ==================== We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built \- but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them \- with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization\-scale infrastructure for AI. **We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!** **How We Operate** ================== * **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role. * **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible. * **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins. * **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward. * **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world. **The Decision Team** --------------------- **Examples of key problems the team is working on** * **Automate the delivery of gigawatts.** Every process that takes AI infrastructure from land to live compute becomes software: schedules, decisions, and todos generated from a live knowledge graph instead of chased by hand. * **Forward\-deploy beside the experts.** Product teams sit with quality managers, sourcing leads, and deployment engineers on factory floors and sites, and turn their judgment into systems that reach every unit. * **Deliver every supercomputer faster than the last.** Dozens of concurrent projects feed one graph, so every lesson learned at one site becomes a preventive check at all of them. **Role Scope** -------------- * **Build the hiring machine as software.** Hiring is the company's biggest bottleneck. Every role, seat, and interview loop already lives in one graph, and you take it the rest of the way: the recruiting system synced both directions, interviewer supply and load visible to every hiring manager, and onboarding generated the moment an offer is signed, so day one starts with the job instead of the checklist. * **Build the cash view the company runs on:** today no system derives near term spend, so finance forecasts by hand and misses what construction already committed. You turn purchase orders, contract terms, and build milestones into an order schedule, a cash demand curve by month, and a payment schedule that recompute as procurement and construction move. * **Build one capital pipeline** from approved budget to released capital to spent dollar, gated on build milestones the delivery system already verifies, with the proof chain behind every financing drawdown assembled automatically, so releasing nine figures takes a day of judgment and funding follows construction within days. * **Parse every MSA, change order, and side letter** into obligations, prices, deadlines, penalties, and SLAs, so a delivery lead gets what we owe a customer at a site with the clause attached, a change order arrives with its legal and finance checks done, and the corpus of executed deals prices the next negotiation. * **Embed forward\-deployed** with finance, treasury, accounting, legal, and people teams through a close, a drawdown, a negotiation, and a hiring loop, and turn their approvals, contract terms, screens, and reconciliations into structured data and generated work, including a continuous close where capitalization and depreciation post as events the moment they happen. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly,** **tell us where you would****.** * You've shipped production code in Go, Python, or TypeScript, and you pick up whatever language the problem demands. * You've built real features on LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open\-weight models), MCP servers, and agentic frameworks. * You work daily with AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor, and you get agents doing useful work autonomously alongside you. * You identify problems, design the solution, and ship it without waiting for direction or approval. * You've moved fast under deadline while leaving foundations that other engineers extended after you moved on. * You've earned credibility with experts outside engineering: finance leads, lawyers, recruiters, or auditors, and driven adoption of your software inside their real deadlines, like a working close calendar or an offer that has to go out today. * Your product taste shows in what you've shipped: a controller, a recruiter, or a lawyer calls your interface obvious, and the workflow matches how their work actually happens. * **Bonus:** ERP and fixed asset accounting. FP\&A, cash forecasting, and capital planning. Structured finance or treasury operations. Contract lifecycle systems. ATS and HRIS integrations (Ashby, Greenhouse, Rippling, Workday). LLM extraction over legal and financial documents. **Benefits:** ------------- * Competitive total compensation package (cash \+ equity) * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Retirement plan * Generous PTO policy We are committed to pay equity and transparency. jobs.title: AV Project Engineer
jobs.description: **Why Join Ford AV?** For over 50 years, Ford AV has helped shape how people experience spaces—through sound, video, and innovation. We work with leading businesses, universities, and public institutions across the U.S. to bring technology to life. At Ford AV, you’ll find: * Real opportunities to grow your skills and your career * Hands\-on training and industry certifications * A steady, supportive team environment * Competitive pay, full benefits, and 401(k) match **Description** The Project Engineer designs and oversees sound, video, lighting, and acoustical systems, ensuring alignment with customer specifications and profitability goals. Responsibilities include creating technical drawings, testing system performance, and simplifying complex technical concepts for clients and teams. Collaboration with Project Managers, Job Superintendents, and cross\-functional teams is essential to ensure quality design, installation, and customer satisfaction. * Design audio, video, lighting, and acoustic systems aligned with customer specifications, installation requirements, and profitability goals. * Prepare submittal drawings and engineering data, including designs for custom enclosures, consoles, and installation instructions. * Test and evaluate system performance to ensure quality and alignment with design standards. * Simplify and communicate technical details for customers, sales teams, and Installation Technicians. * Document customer and vendor interactions, including dates, names, and concise summaries. * Collaborate with Project Managers and Job Superintendents to prioritize quality control and provide clear installation guidance. * Foster a positive, team\-oriented work environment by collaborating across divisions and profit centers. **Qualifications** * Proficiency in CAD/AutoCAD. * Programming experience (e.g., C, C\#, Crestron, Extron, AMX). * Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts clearly. * Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office, typing, and 10\-key proficiency. * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience (new graduates are welcome to apply). **Preferred** * Experience designing and installing professional audio, video, network, and lighting systems (required for senior\-level positions). * Certifications such as Biamp Tesira Forte, Q\-SYS Level 1, Dante, CTS, or similar. **Apply Today** Start your AV career with a team that values your skills and supports your growth. Apply at: www.fordav.com/careers **Drug\-Free Workplace** Ford is committed to maintaining a drug\-free workplace and, therefore, all employees are subject to drug testing. Moreover, pre\-employment, random, reasonable suspicion and/or post\-accident drug testing may be conducted in accordance with company policy and all applicable laws to ensure a safe and healthy work environment. All applicants for this position tentatively selected for employment at Ford are subject to pre\-employment drug testing and a final offer of employment is contingent upon a negative drug test result. **EOE/AA/M/F/D/V. Physical Requirements** This position encompasses a combination of office and field responsibilities, necessitating both physical and mental capabilities to effectively fulfill the job requirements. The employee should be prepared for a dynamic work environment that may involve extended periods of sitting while operating office equipment, as well as occasional standing, walking, reaching, and lifting objects weighing up to 20 pounds. Field duties may require climbing ladders, working in various weather conditions, including exposure to heat, cold, or environmental elements. The employee should possess adequate manual dexterity, eyesight, and proficiency in using standard office tools such as computers, printers, and telephones for tasks involving reading, writing, interpreting, and managing paperwork. Effective communication skills and the ability to adapt to changing work settings are essential. This role may also involve occasional travel, including overnight stays, requiring flexibility in working hours and commitments. Safety protocols must be followed at all times to ensure a secure work environment. Pay: $71,500\.00 \- $93,500\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee discount * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Referral program * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * As required by the position, I confirm that I have worked with CAD/AutoCAD software to create technical drawings or submittals, and I confirm that this experience reflects on my resume. * As required for this position, I confirm that I have the education/experience designing or commissioning audio, video, or lighting systems, and I confirm that this experience reflects on my resume. * I am willing and able to travel up to 25% of the time, including overnight travel. Work Location: In person

We work with leading businesses, universities, and public institutions across the U.S. to bring technology to life. At Ford AV, you’ll find: * Real opportunities to grow your skills and your career * Hands\-on training and industry certifications * A steady, supportive team environment * Competitive pay, full benefits, and 401(k) match **Description** The Project Engineer designs and oversees sound, video, lighting, and acoustical systems, ensuring alignment with customer specifications and profitability goals. Responsibilities include creating technical drawings, testing system performance, and simplifying complex technical concepts for clients and teams. Collaboration with Project Managers, Job Superintendents, and cross\-functional teams is essential to ensure quality design, installation, and customer satisfaction. * Design audio, video, lighting, and acoustic systems aligned with customer specifications, installation requirements, and profitability goals. * Prepare submittal drawings and engineering data, including designs for custom enclosures, consoles, and installation instructions. * Test and evaluate system performance to ensure quality and alignment with design standards. * Simplify and communicate technical details for customers, sales teams, and Installation Technicians. * Document customer and vendor interactions, including dates, names, and concise summaries. * Collaborate with Project Managers and Job Superintendents to prioritize quality control and provide clear installation guidance. * Foster a positive, team\-oriented work environment by collaborating across divisions and profit centers. **Qualifications** * Proficiency in CAD/AutoCAD. * Programming experience (e.g., C, C\#, Crestron, Extron, AMX). * Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts clearly. * Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office, typing, and 10\-key proficiency. * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience (new graduates are welcome to apply). **Preferred** * Experience designing and installing professional audio, video, network, and lighting systems (required for senior\-level positions). * Certifications such as Biamp Tesira Forte, Q\-SYS Level 1, Dante, CTS, or similar. **Apply Today** Start your AV career with a team that values your skills and supports your growth. Apply at: www.fordav.com/careers **Drug\-Free Workplace** Ford is committed to maintaining a drug\-free workplace and, therefore, all employees are subject to drug testing. Moreover, pre\-employment, random, reasonable suspicion and/or post\-accident drug testing may be conducted in accordance with company policy and all applicable laws to ensure a safe and healthy work environment. All applicants for this position tentatively selected for employment at Ford are subject to pre\-employment drug testing and a final offer of employment is contingent upon a negative drug test result. **EOE/AA/M/F/D/V. Physical Requirements** This position encompasses a combination of office and field responsibilities, necessitating both physical and mental capabilities to effectively fulfill the job requirements. The employee should be prepared for a dynamic work environment that may involve extended periods of sitting while operating office equipment, as well as occasional standing, walking, reaching, and lifting objects weighing up to 20 pounds. Field duties may require climbing ladders, working in various weather conditions, including exposure to heat, cold, or environmental elements. The employee should possess adequate manual dexterity, eyesight, and proficiency in using standard office tools such as computers, printers, and telephones for tasks involving reading, writing, interpreting, and managing paperwork. Effective communication skills and the ability to adapt to changing work settings are essential. This role may also involve occasional travel, including overnight stays, requiring flexibility in working hours and commitments. Safety protocols must be followed at all times to ensure a secure work environment. Pay: $71,500\.00 \- $93,500\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee discount * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Referral program * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * As required by the position, I confirm that I have worked with CAD/AutoCAD software to create technical drawings or submittals, and I confirm that this experience reflects on my resume. * As required for this position, I confirm that I have the education/experience designing or commissioning audio, video, or lighting systems, and I confirm that this experience reflects on my resume. * I am willing and able to travel up to 25% of the time, including overnight travel. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Technician II
jobs.description: ### **Description** Join Franklin Electric on our mission to empower communities with sustainable water management solutions, where your expertise will play a vital role in shaping a better future for generations to come. **Plays a key role in prototype development by assembling, modifying, testing, and troubleshooting new product designs. Conducts performance testing, records and analyzes data, and ensures the reliability of test equipment and laboratory operations. Supports regulatory compliance and product certification processes to help bring innovative products to market.** Franklin Electric is a diverse team of innovators making a positive global impact since 1944\. We offer innovative water solutions, ensuring access, treatment, and efficient management of this vital resource. Our commitment to excellence is reflected in our innovative products, industry leading quality products, exceptional customer service, employee development, and passion for social responsibility. Join us to create a better future while growing professionally in a supportive environment!### **MOVE FORWARD WITH US** **What you will be doing:*** Assist product engineers by preparing and conducting experiments, collecting data, and calculating or recording results. * Aid in designing and implementing product testing infrastructure * Test, repair, monitor, and maintain equipment, systems, test fixtures, and/or assemblies. * Assist with the design of various electronic circuits, assemblies, and software. * Assemble and test PCB assemblies incorporating thru hole and surface mount components. * Identify and order necessary parts to support product development. * Prepare and manage records for regulatory compliance and certification. * Analyze and troubleshoot returned materials and electronic components. * Assist investigation of electronic components for Root Cause Failure Analysis. * Contribute to product development by providing design input and participating in design reviews. * Work with internal and external customers to supply specifications, improve products, and monitor Field Trial units. * Follow industry and company safety guidelines. * Operate and troubleshoot products with a heavy focus on variable frequency drives (VFDs). * Perform other related duties as required or assigned. **Who we want:*** **Hard\-working winners**. Confident, competitive, and results\-oriented professionals who create a track record of success. * **Dedicated achievers.** People who thrive in a fast\-paced environment and will stop at nothing to ensure a project is complete and meets regulations and expectations. ### **Skills Knowledge and Expertise** **What you need:*** Read and understand documents such as policy manuals, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. * Able to read and interpret complex circuits schematics. * Write technical reports and test procedures. * Work with general guidelines and standardized procedures/instructions. * Able to operate, troubleshoot, and make technical decisions with minimal supervision. * Use standard assembly techniques using soldering iron and standard hand tools. * Use complex machines and electronic test equipment (such as oscilloscope, digital volt meter, function generator). * Effectively communicate information and respond to questions in person\-to\-person and small group situations with customers, clients, the general public, and other employees of the organization. * Identify and learn new technologies related to job duties. * Maintain confidentiality and use discretion with business information **Education and Experience*** Associate’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, design technology, or a related field or equivalent experience (required). * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, design technology, or a related field or equivalent experience (preferred). * 5\+ years of relevant education or experience in electronics, electrical engineering technology, or a related field (required). **Computer Skills*** **Intermediate:** Alphanumeric data entry, spreadsheet * **Basic:** Microsoft Office suite, Python, National Instruments FlexLogger, LabVIEW. Don’t feel like you check all the boxes in the job description? Here at Franklin Electric, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive culture which includes embracing candidates from a variety of different backgrounds and industries. We highly encourage you to apply so we can connect on this and future opportunities.### **COMPANY VALUES \& BENEFITS** FE provides many opportunities to learn and grow through development opportunities such as training, certifications, mentorship, leadership programs, tuition reimbursement, one\-on\-one coaching and more! We offer competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and amenities such as:* Hybrid remote work arrangements * Generous paid time off \& holidays * Paid parental leave \& on\-site motherhood rooms * On site café \& complimentary beverage stations * Indoor fitness facility \& outdoor walking paths * 401(k) with matching \& service contributions * Health, dental, vision, life insurance * Short \& long\-term disability * Fertility \& adoption support * Undergraduate \& graduate tuition reimbursement * Professional development assistance * Health \& wellness programs ### **About Franklin Electric** Franklin Electric is a global leader in water and energy systems, committed to continuous improvement and innovation to meet the diverse needs of our customers. Our founders in 1944 named the company after America’s pioneer electrical engineer, Benjamin Franklin, which lives on today in our culture to drive us to push boundaries and create meaningful change. We offer a comprehensive range of pumps, motors, drives, and controls for residential, commercial, agricultural, industrial, and municipal applications. More than just a workplace, Franklin Electric is a vibrant and inclusive community of forward\-thinkers, united by our mission to drive positive impact worldwide. Our culture fosters career growth and personal development, with a focus on promoting from within and nurturing talent. Our recent awards in “America's Most Responsible Companies”, “Most Trusted Companies” by Newsweek, “America’s Climate Leaders” and “Indiana’s Best Places to Work” attest, we're dedicated to upholding the highest standards of corporate responsibility. At Franklin Electric, we believe that everyone deserves to be treated fairly and respectfully, and that our diversity of thought, culture and experience makes us a stronger company. Our commitment to social responsibility is evident in programs like the Franklin Women's Network and our philanthropic efforts through the Franklin Wells for the World Foundation. Through these endeavors, we've provided clean water to over 284,000 people in 12 countries, addressing the global water crisis head\-on, Locally in our communities, the Franklin Electric Charitable and Educational Foundation (FECEF) supports causes close to our hearts, such as United Way, Boys \& Girls Club, and Big Brothers Big Sisters. Our dedication to excellence extends beyond our products and services, shaping a brighter future for both our employees and the communities we serve. Join us in driving meaningful change and making a difference with Franklin Electric.

jobs.title: Integration and Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Integration and Automation Engineer** **About us:** At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy\-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI\-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud\-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high\-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company. **Position Overview:** Fullbay runs on a growing portfolio of business applications, and the Integration \& Automation Engineer makes them work as one system. You'll design, build, and operate the integrations, data pipelines, and automations that connect Rillet, Salesforce, Masset, Slack, and the Snowflake data warehouse, so data moves reliably, manual work disappears, and reporting can be trusted. This is a core technical seat inside IT and Security, and an early one. You'll set the standards for how integrations get built, monitored, documented, and secured, all while supporting two parallel product platforms during the migration. The work also lays the foundation for how AI agents access Fullbay's data, which makes this a chance to shape both how the company runs today and how it uses AI tomorrow. **The Right Wrench for the Job** In a heavy\-duty shop, the best technicians know that a truck doesn't run on one good part. It runs because the fuel system, the electrical harness, and the ECM all talk to each other without anyone thinking about it. When one connection fails, the whole rig sits in the bay. That's the work this role owns: the connections nobody notices until they break. You're the right fit if you take pride in integrations that run quietly, fail loudly, and can be picked up by someone else without a phone call. You're comfortable moving from an API doc to a Snowflake model to a runbook in the same afternoon, you treat credentials and service accounts with the care they deserve, and you're curious about how AI agents will tap into company data in the years ahead. This isn't the role for someone who needs a dedicated integration team, an established architecture, and a backlog that's already been scoped. If you do your best work when the standards are already written and someone else decides how things connect, this isn't your shop. But if you're energized by building the plumbing from scratch, enjoy partnering with Finance, RevOps, and IT to turn manual pain into reliable automation, and want to help define how Fullbay's data works for both people and agents, we'd like to talk. **Primary Duties \& Responsibilities:** * API Integration Development: Design, build, and maintain integrations between Fullbay's business applications (e.g., Rillet, Salesforce, Masset, Slack, Snowflake) to enable reliable, automated data flow across systems. * Data Pipelines: Build and maintain data pipelines feeding Fullbay's Snowflake data warehouse, supporting both organizational reporting and AI agent consumption of Fullbay data. * Process Automation: Identify manual, repetitive, or error\-prone processes across business applications and design automations that remove them, in partnership with the business owners affected. * Monitoring \& Error Handling: Build monitoring, logging, and alerting for integration jobs so failures are caught and resolved before they affect the business, rather than discovered downstream. * Vendor API Management: Manage API credentials and authentication for integrated systems, track vendor API changes and deprecations, and coordinate directly with vendors on integration issues. * Dual\-Platform Awareness: Account for Fullbay's two parallel product platforms (legacy and current systems) when building integrations that touch product data, since both remain in active use during the migration period. * Documentation: Document integration architecture, data flows, credentials ownership, and runbooks so integrations are maintainable by others, not just their original builder. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work with business stakeholders (e.g., Finance on Rillet, RevOps on Salesforce) and other IT \& Security team members to gather integration requirements and prioritize work. * Security \& Access Governance: Apply least\-privilege principles to service accounts and API keys, and support security review of integrations as Fullbay's governance program matures. * Adheres to all confidentiality and compliance regulations. * Performs other duties as assigned. **Minimum Education \& Work Experience:** * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience building integrations or automations between SaaS/business applications required. * Practical experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and modern authentication protocols (OAuth2, API keys) required. * Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language commonly used for integration work required. * Experience working with a cloud data warehouse platform (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) required. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field required; equivalent hands\-on experience will be considered in place of a degree. **Key Skills and Qualifications:** * Comfort working independently in a fully remote environment, with no dedicated integration team to lean on and while helping define the processes as they're built. * Experience with Snowflake specifically, including data modeling for a warehouse serving both reporting and application/agent consumption, strongly preferred. * Preferred: experience integrating financial/accounting systems (e.g., Rillet, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Sage Intacct). * Preferred: experience with the Salesforce API and data model. * Preferred: experience with AWS services relevant to integration work (e.g., Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge). * Preferred: familiarity with iPaaS/automation platforms (e.g., Workato, Zapier, Tray.io, n8n). * Preferred: exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) or other emerging patterns for AI agent access to business data and systems. * Preferred: experience at a small or scaling company (under \~500 employees) where integration processes and standards were still being built. * Strong written communication skills, with a track record of documenting technical work clearly for others to maintain. * Security\-conscious approach to credential, secret, and API key management. **Physical Demands and Work Environment:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions * Regularly required to sit at a desk in front of a computer and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls (including a computer keyboard and operating a telephone), lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. * Frequently requires the use of hands and arms for reaching, as well as the ability to walk and communicate effectively through speaking and listening. * Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus. * Type on a computer keyboard and look at a computer monitor, and operate a cell phone or a computer\-based phone.

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer II
jobs.description: At GAF, we cover more than just buildings. We cover each other. Under this roof, you will have the tools and resources you need to grow and develop in your career. You will experience our incredible culture and will be empowered to support your teammates, your customers, and especially your community. Under this roof, we define the future while leading the present through our deep well of experience and our responsibility to the future to drive improvements and innovation in our products. We are GAF. And under this roof, we protect what matters most. **Job Summary** The Reliability Engineer II position builds upon foundational reliability engineering responsibilities, taking greater ownership of specific reliability and maintenance programs. This role independently leads initiatives to optimize machine operating time, improve uptime and reliability, and reduce the failure rate of equipment and machinery. The Engineer II will also focus on optimizing equipment maintainability, extending equipment life, and introducing engineering solutions that improve operator effectiveness and expedite maintenance services. Beyond technical functions, this individual performs more advanced engineering and specialist functions within the maintenance department, working collaboratively to establish partnerships with Maintenance and Operations counterparts and engage in cross\-functional, customer\-focused activities to achieve long\-term reliability goals and reduce overall operational costs. **Essential Duties** * Promotes a safe and clean work environment where safety is the highest priority and embedded in our culture. * Manage a Failure Reporting, Analysis, and corrective Action System (FRACAS) process, including weekly downtime reporting and monthly FRACAS meetings with action plans for high downtime assets affecting OEE. * Manage the preventive and predictive maintenance programs, including PM Optimization reviews, criticality assessments, predictive routes, NDT, and precision maintenance best practices. * Manage the lubrication process to improve OEE of critical assets. * Develop action plans for improving machine lubrication practices. * Manage lubrication sampling program, including developing and tracking plans for out\-of\-spec asset lubrication. * Manage machine lubrication technician position and audit program performance. * Develop annual and 5\-year workforce development plans. * Maintain and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for the department. * Audit maintenance practices and implement changes to improve performance. * Develop, maintain, and document workflows for maintenance processes (e.g., work request, work orders, planning, scheduling, purchase req's, work order completion). * Perform other job duties as assigned **Qualifications Required** * Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering * 2\+ years demonstrated industrial manufacturing experience, preferably in a continuous manufacturing process. * 2\+ years of plant maintenance experience * 2\+years of experience in maintenance and reliability improvement * Able to be certified in Level 1 Thermography, Vibration Analysis 1 and Machinery Lubrication Technician 1 within 2 years of employment * Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office and/or Google Suite. * Knowledge of rotating equipment, hydraulics, pneumatics, bearings, lubrication. * Knowledge of vibration analysis, thermal imaging, Oil Analysis, Non\-destructive testing, and laser alignment * Ability to read and jobs.description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. This is a 0 to 1 team and we are hiring for a foundational engineering role. That means you bring technical leadership through ambiguity, helping figure out what to build, making the foundational design decisions, and keeping delivery moving while the picture is still forming. You own the full lifecycle of what ships and stand behind it. #### **What you'll bring** * Proven ability to influence as a Staff owning product or platform systems end to end across multiple engineering and product teams. * High agency, i.e finds the owner, clarifies the path, makes the call, and keeps pushing until the work lands. * Force multiplier and raise the people and the codebase around them * Deep full\-stack expertise, including strong proficiency in **Go, Ruby** and **Node**. * Depth in at least one of analytics and metrics platforms, graph data systems, CDC and warehouse integration. * Hands\-on experience building production AI\-powered tool orchestration. * Experience operating multi\-tenant systems across SaaS and self\-managed deployment. * Direct communicator who builds alignment across teams. * Bias to write things down and make reasoning legible. **What you'll own** * Architect how GitLab and third\-party data is ingested, modeled, and synced into the knowledge graph as a near\-real\-time graph of the development ecosystem. * Lead integration with external systems for business context (Jira, observability tools, Zendesk, ServiceNow), indexed into the graph. * Architect the Data Marketplace so customers consume GitLab data through Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery with no engineering dependencies. * Publish GitLab observability as OpenTelemetry and broker the data\-sharing APIs. * Define operational readiness for everything the team ships across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self\-Managed. * Translate an ambiguous 0 to 1 problem space into concrete, iterable roadmaps in partnership with Product, Design, and the graph backend team. * Resolve cross\-team dependencies across graph backend, AI Platform, and Infrastructure without escalating everything upward. * Mentor senior and intermediate engineers through design reviews, pairing, and code review. * Create organizational leverage through speed. You identify systemic bottlenecks, simplify processes, and design systems that dramatically improve execution velocity. #### **About the team** Data Products work across three surfaces: **Dashboard and Reporting Framework** * + Builds AI\-native dashboard components so customers and internal teams can see engineering health and GitLab's impact across DORA, VSA, AI Impact, SDLC trends, security, and quality, and launch their own custom dashboards on the same framework. **Internal Ingestion** * + Ingests third\-party data into the GitLab and power tools like Knowledge Graph, building connectors so that signals from systems like Jira, Zendesk, ServiceNow, and observability tools become one queryable, near\-real\-time graph of the developer ecosystem. **External Ingestion** * + External makes GitLab and Knowledge Graph data consumable outside the product, through marketplace listings, data\-sharing APIs and SDKs, and co\-branded partner products. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Generative AI, Ads Safety
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience with software development, applied ML, autonomous systems, and large\-scale systems design. * 3 years of experience with end\-to\-end machine learning (e.g., model building, model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, and debugging). * 3 years of experience with one or more of the following machine learning specializations: Multi\-Modal LLMs, Computer Vision, NLP, Reinforcement Learning. * 1 year of experience with GenAI techniques (e.g., Agentic Workflows, RAG, ICL, or RSI). ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field. * 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms. * 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross\-functional, or cross\-business projects. * 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role. * Experience developing accessible technologies. **About the job** ----------------- Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. The ML Accelerator (MLA) team within Ads Content Safety organization makes tangible impact on user trust and Google's ads ecosystem. This ML team designs, builds, and deploys robust, automated, and highly responsive ML solutions for our next\-generation multi\-modal content understanding systems. You will advocate for ML excellence as you contribute to our boldest architectural shifts. By utilizing cutting\-edge GenAI techniques (Agentic Workflows, RAG, ICL, RSI), you will drastically slash policy enforcement latency from days to minutes and remove human bottlenecks from the ML lifecycle. You will design and build Multi\-Modal LLM teacher models for video understanding for ads at scale. Your work will directly empower our policy enforcement, safeguard billions in revenue, and establish a new industry standard for high\-velocity, autonomous AI systems. Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting\-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi\-billion dollar global business. Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return\-on\-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state\-of\-the\-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Write and test product or system development code. * Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies. * Engineer a sophisticated toolkit for the automated model training lifecycle, deploying AI agents to automate model evaluation and prompt optimization, effectively removing human intervention from the critical path of model development. * Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback. * Design and implement end\-to\-end (E2E) ML architectures for Ads Safety, including developing robust capabilities for automated model refreshing, high\-scale data pipelining/funneling, and proactive signal integration to improve overall detection quality. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. jobs.title: Junior Selenium QA Engineer
jobs.description: **Position:** Junior Selenium QA Engineer **Location:** Ohio, IL **Experience:** 0\-2 Years **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Work Mode:** Remote (Work From Home) We provide structured training, real\-time project exposure, interview preparation, and continuous support to help you grow successfully in your Quality Assurance and Test Automation career. **Role Overview** ----------------- We are looking for recent college graduates or early\-career professionals with **0\-2 years of experience** to join our Quality Assurance team. The ideal candidate will have an interest in **software testing, test automation, Selenium WebDriver, and quality engineering practices**. This role involves designing, developing, and executing automated and manual test cases to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of web applications. It is a great opportunity for candidates who want to build practical experience in **Selenium automation, API testing, Agile methodologies, and software quality assurance**. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Develop, maintain, and execute **automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver**. * Create and execute **manual and automated test cases** based on functional and business requirements. * Perform **functional, regression, integration, system, and smoke testing**. * Develop automation frameworks using **Selenium with Java, Python, or similar programming languages**. * Identify, document, and track software defects using tools such as **Jira** or similar defect\-management systems. * Analyze test results and provide detailed defect reports and test execution summaries. * Work closely with developers, Business Analysts, and other QA team members to understand requirements and resolve defects. * Create and maintain **test plans, test scenarios, test cases, and test data**. * Perform cross\-browser testing using browsers such as **Chrome, Firefox, and Edge**. * Use **XPath, CSS selectors, WebDriver commands, waits, alerts, frames, and browser windows** for automated testing. * Support **API testing** using tools such as Postman and validate REST API responses. * Perform basic database validation using **SQL queries**. * Participate in **Agile/Scrum ceremonies**, including daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. * Integrate automated tests with **CI/CD pipelines** using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar technologies. * Maintain automation code using **Git/GitHub** and follow coding and testing best practices. * Troubleshoot failed automation scripts and identify the root cause of test failures. * Prepare and maintain QA documentation, test reports, and release validation results. * Continuously learn and apply modern **QA, automation, and software testing practices**. **Required Skills \& Qualifications** ------------------------------------- * **0\-2 years of experience** or knowledge in Software Testing / Quality Assurance. * Basic hands\-on experience with **Selenium WebDriver**. * Understanding of **manual testing concepts and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)**. * Basic programming knowledge in **Java, Python, or similar languages**. * Understanding of **locators, XPath, CSS selectors, waits, WebDriver, and browser automation**. * Basic knowledge of **TestNG, JUnit, PyTest, or similar testing frameworks**. * Familiarity with **Page Object Model (POM)** and basic test automation framework concepts. * Understanding of **SDLC and Agile/Scrum methodologies**. * Basic experience with **Jira or similar defect\-management tools**. * Basic knowledge of **Git/GitHub** is preferred. * Basic knowledge of **SQL and database testing** is a plus. * Familiarity with **Postman and REST API testing** is a plus. * Basic understanding of **Jenkins or CI/CD concepts** is preferred. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and organizational abilities. * Strong attention to detail and ability to identify and document software defects. * Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a **remote work environment**. * Willingness to learn new testing tools, automation frameworks, and emerging QA technologies.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description: **Key Responsibilities:** * Handle all installations for The Rapid Bander® and Rapid Roper Plus® systems. * Fabricate customized apparatus components for unique system installations. * Assist sales personnel with Rapid Bander and Rapid Roper Plus® system demonstrations at customer sites and after sales support. * Work with stretch wrap systems manufacturers on custom installations that are compatible with semi\- and/or fully automated pallet wrapping lines that can include conveyors and other essential and adjunct processing line components. * Providing operator training to teach customers how to properly use, maintain, and troubleshoot equipment to ensure optimal performance and prevent issues. * Handling Service Reports \& Documentation – Writing clear, concise reports on service work performed, issues identified, and recommendations to keep customers and internal teams informed. * Maintaining Customer Relationships – Building trust by providing consistent, high\-quality service, following up on past issues, proactively addressing concerns, and staying professional and solution\-focused when dealing with frustrated customers experiencing equipment failures or downtime. * Ensure customers are correctly charged for services and parts. * Schedule and conduct Rapid Bander® system performance audits. * Work with vendors and manufacturers of equipment to purchase parts and submit warranty claims. * Solicit new customers by promoting our service capabilities, including our scheduled maintenance programs. * Expeditiously respond to the service and repair needs of customers. * Be available for immediate communication with customers, salespeople or the office. * Maintain professional appearance and communication standards with all company and customer personnel. * Follow\-up with customers to ensure their satisfaction with the services provided. * Coordinate with sales personnel and customers to schedule service calls quickly and efficiently. * Maintain accurate inventories of tools, supplies and parts. * Travel to customer locations for service calls. This may include overnight travel by vehicle or air, and occasionally on weekends as required by customers. **Required Qualifications \& Requirements:** * 3\-5 years of work experience in a hands\-on technical/maintenance role. * Familiarity with automated packaging equipment such as stretch wrap machines, box erectors, tape machines and form fill and seal equipment. * Mechanical and Fabrication Skills: * Machine Assembly, Adjustment \& Component Replacement – Ability to disassemble, replace, and align mechanical components, including belts, chains, bearings, gears, rollers, and tensioning systems, to ensure proper operation. * Using Hand \& Power Tools – Proficiency with wrenches, sockets, torque wrenches, drills, grinders, and reciprocating saws for repair and modification work. * Metal Cutting, Drilling \& Tapping – Ability to cut metal plates, drill holes, and tap threads for bolts and fasteners when modifying equipment, ensuring proper clearance for moving parts to prevent interference. * Electric Skills: * Reading Electrical Schematics \& Wiring Diagrams – Ability to interpret circuit diagrams, control panel layouts, and wiring schematics to locate and diagnose electrical issues. * Using a Multimeter for Troubleshooting – Proficiency in measuring voltage, current, resistance, and continuity to identify faults in circuits, sensors, and motors. * Understanding Relays, Contactors, and Fuses – Ability to diagnose and replace burnt contacts, faulty relays, and blown fuses in control panels. * Working with Sensors \& Switches – Troubleshooting photoelectric sensors, proximity switches, and limit switches to ensure proper machine operation. * Understanding Electrical Safety \& Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) – Knowledge of arc flash risks, PPE requirements, and safe de\-energizing procedures when working on live equipment. * Familiarity with iPad applications and basic computer skills using Microsoft Office software and email. * Strong verbal and written communication skills for internal and external communications. * Driven and dedicated with a willingness to work hard and occasionally long hours as needed. * Ability to work independently with limited supervision, ability to set and prioritize tasks, and to manage multiple projects simultaneously and effectively. * Valid Driver’s License with a good driving record. * Willingness to travel as much as 4 times per month for approximately 2\-3 nights at a time and occasionally on weekends. * Ability to work in factory or industrial environments, exposure to heat, cold, and noise, and wearing various personal protective equipment (PPE) as required. Able to lift up to 50lbs repeatedly, walk long distances, bending, reaching, kneeling, etc. as required to work on equipment in tight spaces. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience installing and maintaining stretch wrap machines from the following manufacturers: Wulftec, Lantech, Octopus, Kaufman and Orion. * Experience with installing and servicing box erectors, tape machines and form fill and seal equipment. * Experience replacing and troubleshooting VFDs, including setting parameters and diagnosing fault codes. * Ability to program and troubleshoot PLC programs/ladder logic. * Technical or University Degree * Welding ability Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Education: * Associate (Preferred) Experience: * installing and maintaining stretch wrap machines: 2 years (Preferred) * installing and servicing box erectors : 2 years (Preferred) * tape machines and form fill and seal equipment: 2 years (Preferred) * replacing and troubleshooting VFDs: 2 years (Preferred) * program and troubleshoot PLC: 3 years (Preferred) * Welding: 1 year (Preferred) * Electrical Safety \& Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) : 3 years (Preferred) * hands\-on technical/maintenance : 3 years (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Finance Engineer, Buyout
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ New York **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Go to Market **Compensation** ---------------- * $254\.6K – $381\.8K • Offers Equity • OTE 75/25 *Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in our equity plan and benefits program. Benefits include, but not limited to: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits (401k match up to 4%), and flexible PTO.* **Why Harvey** ============== At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise\-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product\-market fit and world\-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. **Role Overview** ================= Harvey's Finance Engineering team is the investment\-side counterpart to our Legal Engineering team: former investment professionals who bring real deal experience to Harvey's prospects and customers. Forward Deployed Finance Engineers lead discovery, demos, pilots, trainings, onboarding, and custom builds alongside our AEs and CSMs. They translate real investment work into Harvey solutions, serving as the trust layer across the entire customer lifecycle, from the first pilot to the most complex, custom\-built workflow. Finance Engineers work on Harvey Deals, a new product built off of Harvey's acquisition of Benchmark. Harvey Deals is where investment teams run their deals — screening, underwriting, diligence, and committee materials — built in the firm's own templates and formats, with every figure traceable back to the document it came from. Harvey works with 150\+ asset management firms and analyzes 178M\+ documents each month; the Finance Engineering team is how that capability meets the way deal teams actually work. Finance Engineers understand how investors think and work, and use that expertise to design, build, and refine solutions that hold up under live deal pressure. In doing so, they don't just drive adoption; they shape Harvey's product roadmap, ensuring every release is grounded in what investment teams actually need. It's a team built to make Harvey the platform investment teams can trust with their most important work. This role is the first Finance Engineer dedicated to buyout. You will build the buyout playbook — demo library, workflow templates, use cases — while running live pilots, and lead the buyout practice as the team grows. You may be asked to travel around 2–3\+ times per month. Travel is always for a significant business need and typically is for 1–3 days at a time. **What you'll do** ================== Forward Deployed Finance Engineers on the buyout team are former deal professionals who left the investment side to help build the future of how deals get done. Working closely with Account Executives, they engage with middle\-market and lower\-middle\-market buyout funds, sector specialists, and serial acquirers throughout the pre\-sales process and stay with them well past it — leading pilots on live opportunities, guiding sponsors through what's possible with AI, and sitting down with deal teams to build screening, underwriting, diligence, and investment committee workflows in the firm's own templates and formats. The work is the work they did on the desk: CIM and management presentation review; QoE and data pack analysis; banker and operating model interrogation; LBO and returns analysis; comps; add\-on screening; and investment committee materials. It continues post\-close into portfolio monitoring, add\-on pipeline tracking, and valuation support, so value compounds after the first deal. Along the way, Finance Engineers bring deal\-team feedback back into the product, helping shape the future of Harvey. **What you have** ================= * 3\+ years on the investment team at a buyout fund — middle\-market or lower\-middle\-market, ideally with add\-on activity — or a growth\-buyout or sector\-specialist fund, with demonstrated ownership of live deal work: screening, underwriting, diligence workstreams, modeling, and drafting investment committee materials. Investment banking or transaction advisory experience before the buyside is welcome, but principal\-side deal execution is required. * Strong command of the documents and data that drive a buyout decision — CIM and management presentation, QoE and data pack, banker and operating models, LBO, purchase agreement and financing terms — and an instinct for where the numbers and the paper disagree. * Advanced Excel and financial modeling, comfort with prompting and agentic AI workflows, and a builder's instinct for turning a repeated manual process into a repeatable automation. Python, SQL, or experience building internal tools is a plus. * Executive presence and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to establish credibility from analysts and associates through to partners and investment committee members. * Outstanding communication and presentation skills — comfortable leading a live demo, facilitating a workshop, or holding your own in a technical conversation about an underwriting assumption. * Deep curiosity about AI's potential to transform investment work, paired with a practical, solutions\-oriented mindset and bias toward action. * Track record partnering with senior stakeholders to drive results, with curiosity for testing approaches and optimizing for customer outcomes. * Customer\-facing or commercial experience (LP or investor relations, capital formation, banking coverage, business development) and/or hands\-on experience using AI tools in an investment setting are pluses. **Compensation** ================ $254,600 \- $381,800 USD OTE 75/25 ### **Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices** **here****.** \#LI\-TM1 *Harvey is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.* We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made by emailing accommodations@harvey.ai

Harvey works with 150\+ asset management firms and analyzes 178M\+ documents each month; the Finance Engineering team is how that capability meets the way deal teams actually work. Finance Engineers understand how investors think and work, and use that expertise to design, build, and refine solutions that hold up under live deal pressure. In doing so, they don't just drive adoption; they shape Harvey's product roadmap, ensuring every release is grounded in what investment teams actually need. It's a team built to make Harvey the platform investment teams can trust with their most important work. This role is the first Finance Engineer dedicated to real estate. You will build the real estate playbook — demo library, workflow templates, use cases — while running live pilots, and lead the real estate practice as the team grows. You may be asked to travel around 2–3\+ times per month. Travel is always for a significant business need and typically is for 1–3 days at a time. **What you'll do** ================== Forward Deployed Finance Engineers on the real estate team are former acquisitions and real estate credit professionals who left the deal side to help build the future of how property gets underwritten. Working closely with Account Executives, they engage with real estate private equity platforms, real estate debt funds, insurer and asset\-manager real estate arms, and developer\-investors throughout the pre\-sales process and stay with them well past it — leading pilots on live opportunities, guiding investors through what's possible with AI, and sitting down with acquisitions teams to build screening, underwriting, and investment committee workflows in the firm's own templates and formats. The work is the work they did on the desk: OM and broker package review; rent roll and T\-12 normalization; lease and estoppel abstraction; ARGUS and acquisition model builds; third\-party report review (appraisal, property condition, environmental); sale and rent comps; loan document and term sheet review; and investment committee materials. It continues post\-close into asset management reporting, loan compliance, and valuation support, so value compounds after the first deal. Along the way, Finance Engineers bring acquisitions\-team feedback back into the product, helping shape the future of Harvey. **What you have** ================= * 3\+ years on an acquisitions, asset management, or real estate credit team at a real estate private equity platform, real estate debt fund, insurer or asset\-manager real estate arm, or developer\-investor, with demonstrated ownership of live deal work: screening, underwriting, diligence workstreams, modeling, and drafting committee materials. Brokerage, valuation, or investment banking experience before the principal side is welcome, but principal\-side deal execution is required. * Strong command of the documents and data that drive a real estate investment decision — OM and broker package, rent roll and T\-12, leases and estoppels, third\-party reports, loan documents, ARGUS and Excel acquisition models — and an instinct for where the numbers and the paper disagree. * Advanced Excel and financial modeling, comfort with prompting and agentic AI workflows, and a builder's instinct for turning a repeated manual process into a repeatable automation. Python, SQL, or experience building internal tools is a plus. * Executive presence and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to establish credibility from analysts and associates through to partners and investment committee members. * Outstanding communication and presentation skills — comfortable leading a live demo, facilitating a workshop, or holding your own in a technical conversation about an underwriting assumption. * Deep curiosity about AI's potential to transform investment work, paired with a practical, solutions\-oriented mindset and bias toward action. * Track record partnering with senior stakeholders to drive results, with curiosity for testing approaches and optimizing for customer outcomes. * Customer\-facing or commercial experience (LP or investor relations, capital formation, banking or brokerage coverage, business development) and/or hands\-on experience using AI tools in an investment setting are pluses. **Compensation** ================ $254,600 \- $381,800 USD OTE 75/25 ### **Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. jobs.title: Gas Transmission Engineer
jobs.description: About Us: HBK Engineering, LLC is a fully licensed, professional engineering design firm headquartered in Chicago, IL with a staff approaching 700 individuals. HBK provides civil, environmental, structural, electrical, subsurface utility, construction support services and permitting facilitation. Since our founding in 1998, we have earned a reputation for delivering outstanding, accurate services in extremely time\-sensitive, multilayered environments. That "industry\-recognized" performance has propelled our expansion and the ability to provide engineering services in all 50 states. With 25 offices nationwide, including concentrations in the Midwest and on the Coasts, HBK brings together a dedicated team whose main focus is the design and protection of utilities and utility networks. We have successfully performed engineering work for a complete spectrum of utility infrastructure projects providing solutions and construction support from Coast to Coast in areas ranging from complex urban city centers, to rural greenfields, to limited access rights\-of\-way. In July 2020, HBK Engineering was acquired by Quanta Services. Quanta Services provides infrastructure services for electric power, pipeline, and communications industries and employees over 50,000 people. Quanta’s focus on the utility industry and HBK’s focus on constructability in our designs has made our integration into the Quanta family of companies seamless. About this Role: HBK Engineering, LLC is seeking an experienced **Gas Transmission Engineer** to support our natural gas utility infrastructure practice in Montana, with a primary focus on engineering design and delivery. In this role, you will perform and lead engineering design, technical evaluations, permitting support, and regulatory compliance for high\-pressure natural gas transmission pipelines, regulator stations, valve assemblies, and interconnect facilities. You will collaborate closely with multi\-disciplinary project teams, utility client representatives, and local/state agencies to deliver safe, reliable, and cost\-effective gas engineering solutions from initial planning through construction support. What You'll Do: * Lead and perform engineering design for natural gas transmission pipelines, gate stations, town border stations, regulator/metering facilities, and main line valve settings. * Prepare detailed engineering calculations including pipe wall thickness, hoop stress/MAOP determinations (ASME B31\.8\), cathodic protection evaluations, pressure relief sizing, and hydraulic flow modeling. * Function as project engineer for natural gas facilities such as pipelines, measurement \& regulation stations, compressor stations or gas treatment equipment * Direct and review the preparation of alignment sheets, P\&IDs, facility piping layouts, detail drawings, and Bills of Materials (BOMs). * Perform Quality Assurance / Quality Control (QA/QC) technical reviews on design packages to ensure compliance with client standards, safety codes, and industry best practices. * Act as a primary day\-to\-day engineering point of contact for gas design and operations teams. * Ensure all design packages, material specifications, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) align with utility standards. * Respond to field Requests for Information (RFIs) and engineering change orders during construction to ensure design intent is maintained. * Travel and extended hours may be required, up to 50% travel + For candidates outside the Butte area, a minimum of two days per week onsite in Butte is required during the initial training period. Once training is complete, management will evaluate and determine ongoing onsite expectations **Regulatory Compliance \& Permitting*** Ensure all project deliverables comply strictly with **DOT 49 CFR Part 192**, **ASME B31\.8**, **PHMSA** mandates, and state regulations (Montana PSC). * Support environmental, land, and agency permitting processes through coordination with the Montana Department of Transportation (MDT), Bureau of Land Management (BLM), US Forest Service (USFS), railroads, and local municipalities. * Assist with Integrity Management Program (IMP) evaluations, maximum allowable operating pressure (MAOP) re\-confirmation programs, and pipeline risk mitigation projects. * Support Project Managers with scope development, engineering fee estimations, schedule tracking, and technical risk identification. * Participate in client progress meetings, site walkdowns, and field investigations across Montana as required. What You'll Bring: * Bachelor of Science degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, or an accredited engineering discipline. * 4\+ years of relevant engineering experience in natural gas transmission, high\-pressure gas distribution, or pipeline utility design. * Familiarity with gas design standards, specifications, and regional operating considerations is a major plus. * Proficiency with design and mapping platforms such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, MicroStation, or ArcGIS. * Exposure to gas hydraulic modeling software (e.g., Synergi Gas, NextGen, WinFlow) and pipe stress analysis tools. * Proven problem\-solving capabilities and attention to detail. * Flexibility to travel periodically across Montana for site visits, field walkdowns, and client alignment meetings. What You'll Get: * Opportunity to work independently on complex engineering challenges * Collaborative work environment with interdisciplinary teams * Travel opportunities for field work and client engagement * Comprehensive benefits package * Career advancement opportunities with increased responsibilities.
