jobs.title: Global Specialist Solution Architect - Lightwell
jobs.description: **About the role:** The Red Hat Technology Sales team is looking for a Lightwell Specialist Solution Architect (SSA) to join our team. This position assumes a crucial role in providing expert deep technical sales support for the seamless execution of Go\-To\-Market (GTM) strategies related to Red Hat Lightwell. Your primary focus will be to remove the organizational, technical, and competitive blockers to adoption of Red Hat Lightwell, making Red Hat the source our customers' applications are built from. You will help customers close the vulnerability gap that sits between their own application code and the platform beneath it so that remediation stops consuming engineering capacity they would rather spend on their business. You will need to confidently articulate our value proposition to developers, build and platform engineers, application development leadership, and the security and compliance organization within the account, changing register as you move between them. This will entail hands\-on work in the customer's own build environment, technical architecture walk\-throughs, business\-value conversations framed in engineering cost, customer\-facing technical workshops, and implementation of best practices in dependency management, artifact signing, attestation, and pipeline enforcement. Adoption is ultimately a developer decision, and proving it in their build is the most persuasive conversation you will have. You will work closely with the Lightwell business unit and engineering, helping to test, document, and demonstrate cutting\-edge features, and carrying coverage gaps, ecosystem requests, and competitive intelligence back to the business unit as a defined part of the role. You will also work in close collaboration with Red Hat sales, Customer Success, Consulting Services, and partner teams to ensure a highly positive customer experience. **What you will do:** * Deploy into requested engagements as Red Hat's technical lead for trusted software supply chain, partnering with the Account Solution Architect and Account Executive to drive Red Hat Lightwell within new and existing customer accounts * Lead the technical conversation across three distinct audiences: developers and build engineers, application development and platform engineering leadership, and the security and compliance organization, adapting depth and framing to each. * Articulate and defend Red Hat's differentiating position against alternative approaches in the market. * Position the software supply chain offerings within the broader Red Hat portfolio, including hardened container images, artifact signing, attestation, SBOM generation, pipeline policy enforcement, and runtime security. * Prove the offering in the customer's environment, configuring their build to resolve against Lightwell repositories, executing their build, and troubleshooting the result alongside their engineers. * Facilitate pre, and post\-sales activities when needed, including technical deep dives, proofs of concept, “bake\-offs,” internal sprints and hackathons, and development of partner vertical\-specific solutions to drive adoption of Red Hat Lightwell. * Identify and partner with customer stakeholders, acting as an advocate within both their line\-of\-business and internal customer teams. * Advise on integration with the customer's existing artifact management, mirroring, and pipeline estate, including disconnected and air\-gapped environments. * Work closely with the Lightwell business unit and engineering teams, providing a market feedback loop on the product and solutions. * Execute community outreach and customer advocacy activities including conference speaking, blog posts, etc. * Deliver enablement and mentoring to the Red Hat Technical Sales community to raise baseline capability on software supply chain security. **What you will bring:** * 6\+ years in a combination of software engineering, build/release engineering, platform engineering, DevSecOps, or technical sales, including direct responsibility for software that carried real dependency and upgrade obligations. * Demonstrated ability to work hands\-on in a customer or production build environment. **Application development and build systems** * Working command of at least two of Maven, pip, and npm, including dependency resolution, transitive dependency behavior, lockfiles, and version constraint semantics. * Practical understanding of how enterprise builds are configured, where registry and repository settings are applied, and how enterprises currently proxy and mirror public package registries. * Hands\-on experience with enterprise artifact repositories and internal mirrors. * Ability to work directly in a customer's build environment, configuring, executing, and troubleshooting builds alongside their engineers. * Understanding of build reproducibility, disconnected and air\-gapped delivery, and multi\-language codebases. **Software supply chain security** * SLSA build integrity levels and  ompliance regimes relevant to the geography's key accounts, and with control automation as the durable answer to audit obligation. The salary range for this position is $197,860\.00 \- $316,600\.00 (inclusive of base pay \+ target incentive compensation). Actual offer will be based on your qualifications.**Pay Transparency** Red Hat determines compensation based on several factors including but not limited to job location, experience, applicable skills and training, external market value, and internal pay equity. Annual salary is one component of Red Hat’s compensation package. This position may also be eligible for bonus, commission, and/or equity. For positions with Remote\-US locations, the actual salary range for the position may differ based on location but will be commensurate with job duties and relevant work experience. **About Red Hat** Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community\-powered approach to deliver high\-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40\+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in\-office, to office\-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact. **Benefits** * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * Flexible Spending Account \- healthcare and dependent care * Health Savings Account \- high deductible medical plan * Retirement 401(k) with employer match * Paid time off and holidays * Paid parental leave plans for all new parents * Leave benefits including disability, paid family medical leave, and paid military leave * Additional benefits including employee stock purchase plan, family planning reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, transportation expense account, employee assistance program, and more! **Note:** These benefits are only applicable to full time, permanent associates at Red Hat located in the United States. **Inclusion at Red Hat** Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village. **Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)** Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law. ### **Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.** ### **Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email** **application\-assistance@redhat.com****.** **General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.**

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description: **Project Manager** Program Management \| Full\-Time, Salaried \| Reports to the Co\-CEOs **Company** Seeking.com (Reflex Media) **Location** Remote, anywhere in the USA. **Compensation** $75,000 to $105,000 base. **Travel** Occasional travel to Las Vegas for quarterly planning and major project kickoffs. **About the Role** Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas. We are hiring a Project Manager to join our Program Management team, reporting directly to the Co\-CEOs. You will work side by side with our Director of Program Management, the senior member of the team, and take full ownership of a slate of live projects across engineering, product, AI, and marketing. Your job is delivery. You take each project from intake to closeout: scope, plan, schedule, risks, dependencies, status, and the retrospective at the end. On any project you own, leadership always knows where it stands and the team always knows what happens next. Technical work runs in Jira. Marketing work runs in Monday. Documentation lives in Confluence. You work fluently across all three. **Who Should Apply** We are especially open to candidates from these backgrounds: * Project Managers at software, digital, or product companies who have run several concurrent projects and can show the numbers they moved * Technical Project Managers who have delivered engineering work and are comfortable coordinating with marketing * Agency or professional services Project Managers who have owned SOWs, scope changes, and client reporting and want to go in\-house * Marketing or Growth Operations professionals who have grown into full\-lifecycle project ownership Titles vary. A track record of shipping on time is the bar. **What You'll Find on Day One** * Operations and technical teams actively running their work in Jira, with sprints, boards, and owners in place * A backlog of legacy epics from projects abandoned as far back as seven years ago, ready to be reviewed and cleaned up * Marketing projects running in Monday, with hand\-offs to engineering that need a clear owner * A draft intake and governance framework that needs to be tested on real projects * A Director of Program Management as your senior teammate, and Co\-CEOs who read project status every week * Permission to fix what you find. If a workflow is slowing delivery, you change it. **What You'll Own** **Project Delivery, End to End** * Own a slate of concurrent projects from intake through closeout. Write the project charter for each: objective, success metric, sponsor, scope, milestones, and budget where one applies. * Break scope into a work breakdown, a realistic schedule, and a critical path. Keep baselines honest as the work evolves. * Choose the delivery approach that fits the work: predictive, Agile, or hybrid. * Run kickoffs, working sessions, and project standups for the projects you own. Facilitate sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives where a team needs them. * Close every project with a retrospective and a lessons\-learned entry in Confluence. **Scope, Change, and Risk Control** * Guard scope. Every change request gets a written impact on timeline, cost, and resources, and a named decision\-maker. * Maintain a RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) for every project. Surface each risk early with a proposed mitigation. * Map dependencies between engineering and marketing and resolve them before they become blockers. * Manage vendor and contractor deliverables against their statements of work. **Status, Reporting, and Stakeholder Communication** * Publish a weekly status for each project: health, progress against milestones, risks, and decisions needed. Short, specific, and read once. * Feed accurate project\-level data into the portfolio view the Director of Program Management presents to the Co\-CEOs. * Tailor communication to the audience. An engineer, a marketer, and a Co\-CEO each get the level of detail they need. * Escalate early when a project is at risk. Bring the problem, the options, and your recommendation. **Tool Hygiene and Process Improvement** * Keep every project you own clean in Jira and Monday: named owners, due dates, current status, and a definition of done. * Lead the cleanup of legacy epics from abandoned projects. Confirm status with the original teams, archive or close what is finished or dead, and re\-plan anything that still matters. * Apply the draft intake and governance framework on live projects and report back on what works and what needs to change. * Build templates, checklists, and runbooks so each new project starts faster than the last. **Supporting the OKR Cadence** * Link each of your projects to the Key Result it serves, so every project has a clear line to a company objective. * Support the Director of Program Management in running quarterly OKR planning and weekly check\-ins in Monday: prepare the data, collect updates, and track follow\-ups to clo  this week and improve it next week. * Written Discipline. Every meeting has an outcome. Every decision has an owner and a date. Everything lives in Confluence. * AI as Leverage. You use AI to move faster and you verify what it produces. **Cultural Fit: Who Thrives Here** Be honest with yourself about whether this is your environment: * You take ownership. When you see a stalled epic or a missing owner, you fix it. * You ask the sharp question early and save the team a week of rework. * You lead through influence. You get results from teams you do not manage. * You are a builder. Configuring a Monday board, writing a runbook, or cleaning up a Jira workflow is comfortable ground. * You believe in the brand. You understand that better execution translates directly into a better product and a better member experience. * You want direct exposure to the Co\-CEOs and a clear path to grow. **Day in the Life** * Morning scan of your projects in Jira and Monday. Flag anything at risk before standups start. * Quick sync with the Director of Program Management on priorities and hand\-offs for the day. * Run a standup for a cross\-functional launch and clear two blockers by lunch. * Review a change request from marketing, write up its impact on the engineering timeline, and get a decision from the sponsor. * Update RAID logs and send the weekly status for your active projects. * Use Claude to draft meeting notes and the action list, then verify and send. * Close out a finished project with a retrospective and a Confluence write\-up. **How We Will Measure Success in the First 12 Months** * 30 days. Fluent in Jira, Monday, and Confluence. An initial slate of projects handed over from the Director of Program Management, each with a charter, named owner, schedule, RAID log, and weekly status. * 90 days. A full slate of concurrent projects under your ownership. On\-time milestone delivery tracked and trending up. Legacy epic cleanup complete, so Jira reflects only live work. The Director of Program Management has meaningful time back for OKR and governance work. * 6 months. Stakeholders treat your status reports as the source of truth. The intake framework has been applied on live projects, with documented recommendations. Reusable templates and runbooks live in Confluence. * 12 months. A full year of projects delivered with a clear, measurable record. You are ready to take on larger, higher\-stakes initiatives on a path to Senior Project Manager.ƒGroth **Why This Role Matters** Seeking is running a brand transformation and a product transformation at the same time. Both depend on dozens of projects landing on time and in the right order. The Project Manager makes that happen, one project at a time, and gives the Program Management team the capacity to strengthen how the whole company plans. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Base salary: $75,000 to $105,000, commensurate with experience. * Full\-time, salaried, fully remote within the US. * 99% coverage of our medical base plan, dental, and vision insurance. 65% coverage for qualified dependents. 100% coverage of short\-term disability, long\-term disability, and life insurance for qualified employees. 50% 401(k) match up to 6% per month. Flexible Spending Account. Flexible paid time off. * Direct exposure to the Co\-CEOs and function heads from day one. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Reflex Media is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We strictly prohibit discrimination of any kind. Candidates are encouraged to apply for qualified positions regardless of race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristics as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Reflex Media's hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and the needs of the company. All offers of employment are contingent upon the completion of a full background and reference check. rJt6MKOLL7

jobs.description: ***Posting Type*** Remote/Hybrid ***Job Overview*** Who We Are Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI‑powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high‑stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial. The world’s largest law firms, corporations and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we’re deeply committed to expanding access to technology for academic institutions through Relativity Academic and supporting pro bono legal work through Justice for Change. What We Do At Relativity, engineers don’t just write code— they harness AI tools to architect, optimize, and deliver scalable software faster and shape the future of legal technology. They shape how industries uncover critical insights, ensure compliance, advance access to justice and continuously evolve our platform using the latest technologies, including cloud\-native architectures, AI capabilities, and modern developer tooling. Our AI powers privacy programs, identifies confidential information, and detects language indicating misconduct. We’re reimagining how legal professionals uncover truth at scale, and engineering is at the heart of that transformation. As a member of the Unstructured Storage team within the Data Intelligence Foundation, you will help manage and scale platforms hosting petabytes of data. This role involves overseeing infrastructure on the Azure stack and developing storage abstraction layers, libraries, and content\-addressable stores. Ultimately, you will empower internal developer teams to efficiently store, consume, and leverage their data. If you’re passionate about solving hard problems, designing for scale, and building tools that matter—while working in a culture that values transparency, innovation, and shared success— Relativity offers the opportunity to make a measurable difference in the marketplace. ***Job Description and Requirements*** What You’ll Do * Contribute to the design, development, and operation of distributed, scalable, secure full\-stack cloud services that process petabytes of data weekly. * Build performant, accessible user interfaces and extend backend services and data pipelines. * Consistently implement clean, testable, maintainable code to deliver customer impact. * Collaborate with a diverse group of teammates and product partners to solve problems, achieve team goals, and build AI\-powered legal data solutions at massive scale. * Actively contribute to design and code reviews, providing constructive feedback to improve quality and maintainability. Contribute to service ownership by supporting reliability efforts, including on\-call rotations and incident response. * What We’re Looking For Required * 3\+ years designing, building, and operating cloud‑native, distributed systems * Hands‑on experience with APIs, event‑driven architecture, and data platforms * Proven competency in designing and developing distributed systems, cloud architecture patterns, and data\-intensive applications. * Ability to write clean, maintainable, well‑tested code using modern tooling and CI/CD * Security‑ and reliability‑focused mindset with strong cross‑functional collaboration across engineering, product, and design. * Strong proficiency in C\# and object\-oriented programming (OOP) principles. * Familiarity with AI\-development tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor or Claude Code. * Familiarity with Agentic AI * Experience or familiarity with Agentic AI development and autonomous LLM frameworks. Preferred * Experience building core platform services, including extensible APIs, client libraries, and automated cloud infrastructure control planes. * Familiarity with performance or cost optimization. Hands\-on experience with Azure technologies, specifically across storage, compute, and networking stacks. * Why We Could Be A Great Fit * **Impactful Mission:** ***Organize Data, Discover the Truth and Act on It*** \- Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading law firms managing high\-stakes matters on our platform. * **Growth Path:** Engineers gain exposure across the stack, from distributed systems to AI\-enabled workflows, accelerating career growth. * **Engineering Culture:** Continuous delivery, strong observability, and end\-to\-end ownership. * **Inclusive Environment:** Diverse backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger. * **Community Impact:** Volunteer opportunities and company\-sponsored charitable programs. * **Compensation \& Benefits:** Competitive salary, health and retirement programs, wellness resources, discretionary time off (DTO), parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers, two annual company breaks, home office stipend, and an equity program. **Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.** This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long\-term incentives. The expected salary range for this role is between following values: $103,000 and $155,000 The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position. **Required Skills:** Engineering Principle, Hardware Integration, Innovation, Problem Solving, Process Improvements, Quality Assurance (QA), Research and Development, System Designs, Technical Documents, Troubleshooting

jobs.description: Overview: Resonetics is a global leader in advanced engineering, prototyping, product development, and micro manufacturing, driving innovation in the medical device industry. With rapid expansion across all our locations, we continue to push the boundaries of technology while fostering a dynamic, employee\-centered culture. Our commitment to excellence and continuous improvement makes Resonetics an exciting place for professionals passionate about shaping the future of micro\-manufacturing and being part of something bigger. The **Manufacturing Engineer III** will be primarily responsible for introducing and establishing new systems and technology to facilitate the Production and Manufacturing of Nitinol Tube/Wire for Resonetics. Systems will pertain to Drawing, Heat Treating, Finishing, and other manufacturing processes. The Manufacturing Engineer will act as a technical liaison between Quality and Production. This position will concentrate primarily Document creation relating to new Quoted tube products and assistance with production team on the Operation of job routers. Router and Work Instruction generation, participation with quality in customer assistance. Occasionally, will work on establishing and improving efficiencies in the manufacturing of Nitinol Tube/Wire. Additional areas of focus may include but are not limited to: setup reduction, operator training, statistical process control, tool design or selection, and performance metrics. Other daily responsibilities will include designing continuous improvement plans for current production jobs. An important aspect of this position is the hands\-on nature of this role. As productions issues are identified, it will often be the responsibility of this individual to advise and resolve production issues. Responsibilities: * Take ownership of manufacturing of products as they pass through the final stages of production readiness to ensure that quality awareness and product integrity are maintained into production. Assist with creation of Flow Charts, PFMEA’s, and Control Plans for products transferring to production. * Develop understanding of key factors in Nitinol tube production (e.g. mechanical properties, dimensional control, etc) to become a subject matter expert. * Provide technical support for assigned development products to insure a smooth progression though the production floor. * Constructively communicate with operators and other departments. * Serve as a leader and mentor in order to foster a culture of best Engineering and Safety practices. For all work and development, the individual considers and appreciates Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) as an evident part of all processes. The individual must also be a strong supporter of GMP and make it a personal goal to establish such a mind\-set. * * Introduce and set\-up manufacturing capacity for Nitinol Tube/Wire manufacturing. * Review existing process procedures for compliance to the designed process intent. Modify procedures as necessary and obtain approval from required cognizant engineers and change review board. * Develop and improve Production yields through the identification and implementation of new process controls and determine their effectiveness. * Work with manufacturing personnel to promote Lean Principles in the design and planning phase of the product. * Provide technical support for machine validation activities to insure a smooth transition into the production environment. * Thoroughly document tasks including creation of required prints, work instructions, specifications, and Engineering studies and reports. * Troubleshoot manufacturing issues and develop a plan to contain, correct, and put preventive/corrective actions in place to reduce the possibility of reoccurrence. * Determine job cost baselines and initiate cost reduction activities. * Provide assistance in job setup and process training for operators. * Weekly/monthly reporting of activities and chosen performance attributes. * Periodic Customer liaison for quality or continuation of engineering related issues. May assume project manager role for specific customer applications. * Apply statistical methods such as Design of Experiments, SPC, Capability Studies, etc Required Qualifications: * BS or MS in Engineering with a minimum (2\) years related experience, capable of working in a dynamic, fast paced environment. * Must be proficient with MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, etc) * Must be proficient in computer systems (Windows, Folder directory navigation, SharePoint, OneDrive) * Must possess solid mechanical troubleshooting abilities. (root cause analysis, Mechanical Diagnosis, Willing \& able to interview Operators and technicians about production issues) * Must demonstrate good oral and written communication skills. * Strong organizational, analytical, and planning skills with the ability to multi\-task * Must be extremely flexible regarding priority changes. * Individual must be fluent in speaking, reading and writing English. * Must have the ability to read, analyze, and interpret procedures and/or safety manuals. Preferred Qualifications: * Must be a self\-starter and able to work effectively with minimal supervision. * General Metallurgy knowledge and/or knowledge of Nitinol properties and how processing changes these properties * Experience with wire or tube drawing processes. * Experience with Process Controls: Control Plan, pFMEA, DOE, MSA, Problem solving, etc. * Experience working with SolidWorks or equivalent CAD software * Experience working in ISO\-9001/13485 or similar environment. * Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers. Physical Demands: * Lift at least 50Lbs * Reach under/into/Over machines to assess and change out tooling and fixtures * Compensation: The compensation for this role is competitive and will be based on experience and qualifications. The anticipated range is $65,000 \- $102,000/year.* **For temp, temp\-to\-hire, and regular full\-time positions, our company policy is that we are unable to provide visa or TN sponsorship. Candidates must already be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship now or in the future.**

jobs.title: Growth Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth\-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books – all in one connected platform backed by real human support. **About the role** ------------------ We're hiring a Growth Engineer to make Rho the \#1 answer for startup and business banking, both in classic search rankings and in the answers AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews give. You'll then extend that position into Rho's newer product lines: incorporation, payroll, and invoicing. For your first six months this is 100% of your focus; after that, you'll take the systems and instincts you built here to the next growth problem. This is a hands\-on building role. You ship production code and page changes yourself, you don't spec them and hand them off. You'll inherit a working agentic SEO/AEO system and make it faster, more reliable, and more autonomous, from the agents that sweep and fix pages around the clock to the runbook that lets it all run without you. You're accountable for whether Rho wins, not for pages published or dashboards built. AI citation share, rankings on priority keywords, organic signups, and funded accounts from organic are how your work gets judged. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Live in AEO/SEO dashboards: own AI visibility, citations, and sentiment across every tracked topic, and turn weekly deltas into shipped fixes. * Run the weekly operating rhythm: competitor intel refresh, a full sweep of AI\-citation position by keyword with fixes shipped to existing pages, and an easy\-read SEO/AEO scorecard reported every Friday. * Ship page changes directly to rho.co through the CMS and jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: ### **The Ultimate Electrical Engineering Career Launch: Forensic Investigation** Are you ready to apply your technical skills to high\-stakes forensic analysis? Robson Forensic is looking for an individual with a strong technical electrical engineering foundation who is driven by problem\-solving. This Laboratory and Field Investigator role offers a rare entry point into forensic engineering, supporting elite testifying experts by testing and capturing the data of complex incidents. **Job Summary:** The Laboratory and Field Investigator supports our testifying experts including mechanical, electrical and biomedical engineers and accident reconstructionists by installing, configuring and trouble\-shooting vehicle mounted data acquisition equipment and sensors as well as handling test setup and teardown. This individual will also be responsible for performing scene documentation, photography, measurements, and Event Data Recording (EDR “Black Box”) data extraction. This position combines hands\-on electrical and mechanical test setup with advanced data acquisition, instrumentation and engineering\-level analysis. This position offers a unique entry point for a new Engineer\-In\-Training (EIT). The position provides exceptional mentorship, skill development, case variety and a clear pathway toward accumulating the necessary experience satisfying the requirements for the Professional Engineering Exam. **We use a variety of software tools in our lab (listed under Qualifications below). We do not expect candidates to have deep experience with all of them, so we encourage you to apply. We value adaptable learners and are fully committed to training the right person.** ### **Responsibilities:** * Assist with documenting scenes systematically through photography, videography, written field notes, sketches, and diagrammatic evidence mapping. * Provide lab and field test equipment installation support, including assembly of test equipment, hardware fabrication support and setup of data acquisition systems. * Operate, calibrate, and maintain all laboratory and field testing equipment in accordance with calibration schedules and manufacturer requirements. * Assist with and independently conduct scene documentation, including field measurements, photography, 3D laser scanning, and drone photogrammetry. * Use hardware and software tools to monitor bus messages on vehicles in support of testing. * Set up and calibrate data acquisition systems (temperature, pressure, GNSS, accelerometer, etc.) * Maintain proficiency with lab software, such as schematic capture and PCB layout tools, circuit simulation, MATLAB, Simulink, CAD tools, and embedded development tools. * Maintain, inspect, and replenish all field investigation equipment including cameras, lighting, PPE, evidence collection kits, and scene documentation tools * Perform on\-site inspections and field data collection; overnight travel will be required (approximately 10% of total time). * Other related projects as needed. ### **Qualifications:** * **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an ABET\-accredited institution * **License:** Active E.I.T. license preferred, not required. * **Computer Skills:** Proficiency in MS Office Suite, experience with any of the following is desirable: Altium, OrCAD, Eagle, KiCad, SPICE, LTspice, PSpice, MATLAB, Simulink, AutoCAD, SolidWorks, C/C\+\+, microcontroller IDEs, JTAG debuggers, and/or 3D printing. * **Additional Software a Plus:** Automotive bus communication tools (CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape, Vehicle Spy), Python for data analysis (NumPy, Pandas, Jupyter), sensor data visualization tools (OpenCV, RViz, LIDAR viewers), diagnostic tools (UDS/OBD II), requirements tools (Polarion, DOORS), ADAS simulation tools (CarMaker, dSPACE ASM, CARLA) * **Office Skills:** Excellent organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail. Able to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast\-paced environment. * **Communication Skills:** Strong written and verbal communication skills. * **Abilities:** Hands\-on experience and ability to operate mills, lathes, cutting equipment, welding equipment, and other fabrication equipment and processes is desirable. * **Work Style:** Must be able to work onsite at our lab with occasional field assignments as needed. * **Other:** A clean background screen, a valid driver’s license, and the ability to drive passenger cars and light trucks. ### **Location:** Lancaster, PA (on\-site) ### **About Us** Robson Forensic is a national leader in expert witness consulting, providing technical expertise across many fields within engineering, architecture, science, and a broad range of specialty disciplines. Our experts come from both industry and academia, and the work blends collaboration with autonomy. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

findings and simulation\-based risks to internal stakeholders and global R\&D teams to influence product roadmaps and manufacturing process specs. * System\-Level Interaction Analysis: Evaluate the thermo\-mechanical interactions between advanced packages and board/system\-level components (e.g., Motherboard, Rack, Cooling systems), mapping system\-level boundary conditions down to the package architectures, desktop form factors, or enterprise\-level hardware systems. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience in Multi\-scale modeling (from micro\-scale TSV/micro Bumps to macro\-scale and their impact on residual stress. * Experience with CAD software (NX, Solidworks, or AutoCAD) for geometry preparation and cleaning. * Excellent communication skills to collaborate effectively jobs.description: *To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.* Job Category Software Engineering Job Details **About Salesforce** Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. The Component Accessibility Team (CAT) is changing that. **We improve accessibility by focusing on the developer experience: we build AI tools that shift accessibility as far left as possible, so developers don't have to be accessibility experts to write perfectly accessible code.** We build the accessibility agent as a *product* : the knowledge, the fix tools, and the evaluation systems that let any Salesforce engineer request and receive accessible code suggestions in the flow of their work. Our tools ship into the surfaces developers already use: AI Expert Suite, DX MCP, Cursor, Claude Code, and Vibes. When a developer writes a component, we make it WCAG\-compliant before the code makes it to production. This is a business problem, not only an ethical one. By improving accessibility at Salesforce we help win deals. It unlocks the features sales needs to close public\-sector and enterprise contracts, and it protects Salesforce from a fast\-growing wave of legal and regulatory risk. Accessibility serves the 1\.3 billion people worldwide who live with disabilities, and it's increasingly a condition of doing business: ADA digital\-accessibility lawsuits have increased every year since 2018, and VPAT conformance is now a standard requirement in enterprise and public\-sector procurement. The US federal government can't buy software that fails Section 508, and the EU's European Accessibility Act extended the same bar to Europe in June 2025\. Accessible\-by\-default code is how Salesforce keeps winning deals in the public sector, including with agencies that serve millions of veterans who have disabilities. The CAT accessibility product is already running at scale. Our Prizm PR\-review presubmit is live on core and offcore and has reviewed 42,845 pull requests since late May. Engineers acted on 21% of its findings, and only 1% were ever reported incorrect. When this team gives an accessibility recommendation, it's almost always right, and it's landing in engineers' pull requests thousands of times a week. **What the Team Is Responsible For** ------------------------------------ * **Creating products that increase developer productivity** — turning accessibility from a manual, after\-the\-fact audit into an automated, in\-loop part of writing code. * **Guiding the company's web development efforts as the WCAG lead** — ensuring compliance with accessibility guidelines and best practices across Salesforce's UI. * **Owning the full detect diagnose fix verify loop:** we don't stop at finding violations. We generate the fix, prove it holds on the rendered page, and drive it to a merged pull request. * **Ensuring AI solutions for accessibility are grounded in WCAG and internal standards** — and heavily evaluated so that every suggestion the agent makes is trustworthy and high\-performing. **What You'll Build** --------------------- * **Well\-evaluated AI fix tools** — the Jest remediation tool, the functional\-test (ftest) remediation tool, and the accessibility\-guide tool that let developers request and receive accessible code suggestions based on the work in front of them. * **The agent's knowledge base** — accessibility (a11y) best practices, remediation patterns, and Salesforce engineering standards that ground every suggestion in real WCAG success criteria. * **The evaluation system** — the eval dataset and reviewer set (Aura \+ LWC) that prove, per WCAG criterion, that our AI performs before we ship it. If it isn't measured, it doesn't go out. * **The shared platform capabilities:** component identification (mapping a rendered finding back to the exact component and source file it came from) and verification (confirming a semantic fix actually holds on the rendered accessibility tree). * **Detection for the dark corners of WCAG:** first\-ever automated coverage for categories like reflow (1\.4\.10\) and focus management (2\.4\.3, 2\.4\.7\) that no static check can reach. * **Packaging and form. * **Company\-wide voice.** As the WCAG lead, this team's standards shape web development across Salesforce. **Tech Stack** -------------- JavaScript, TypeScript, LWC \& Aura, Jest, Selenium/functional tests, WCAG 2\.2 / ARIA, AI agent \& eval tooling (Claude, MCP, Cursor, LangSmith), AI Suite, DX MCP. Individual base pay rates will depend on factors including duties, work location, education, skills, qualifications and experience. Total compensation for this position will include a competitive benefits package and may include participation in company incentive compensation programs, which are based on factors to include organizational and individual performance.* **Total Rewards** At Samsung Austin Semiconductor, base pay is just one part of our total compensation package. The base compensation for this role will depend on education, experience, skills, and location. jobs.title: Staff Engineer, ML Profiling Tools
jobs.description: **Please Note:** To provide the best candidate experience amidst our high application volumes, each candidate is limited to 10 applications across all open jobs within a 6\-month period. **Advancing the World's Technology Together** Our technology solutions power the tools you use every day\-including smartphones, electric vehicles, hyperscale data centers, IoT devices, and so much more. Here, you'll have an opportunity to be part of a global leader whose innovative designs are pushing the boundaries of what's possible and powering the future. We believe innovation and growth are driven by an inclusive culture and a diverse workforce. We're dedicated to empowering people to be their true selves. Together, we're building a better tomorrow for our employees, customers, partners, and communities. The AGI (Artificial General Intelligence) Computing Lab is dedicated to solving the complex system\-level challenges posed by the growing demands of future AI/ML workloads. Our team is committed to designing and developing scalable platforms that can effectively handle the computational and memory requirements of these workloads while minimizing energy consumption and maximizing performance. To achieve this goal, we collaborate closely with both hardware and software engineers to identify and address the unique challenges posed by AI/ML workloads and to explore new computing abstractions that can provide a better balance between the hardware and software components of our systems. Additionally, we continuously conduct research and development in emerging technologies and trends across memory, computing, interconnect, and AI/ML, ensuring that our platforms are always equipped to handle the most demanding workloads of the future. By working together as a dedicated and passionate team, we aim to revolutionize the way AI/ML applications are deployed and executed, ultimately contributing to the advancement of AGI in an affordable and sustainable manner. Join us in our passion to shape the future of computing! **Location:** Daily onsite presence at our San Jose, CA office / U.S. headquarters in alignment with our Flexible Work policy. **What You'll Do** * Develop and maintain highly interactive, large\-scale and complex web\-based visual analytics tools on AI/ML workloads. * Build interactive data visualization (flame graphs, call trees, timeline charts) capable of fluidly rendering massive, multi\-dimensional infrastructure telemetry datasets. * Partner closely with compiler engineers and hardware architects to translate highly complex performance profiling metrics into clear, intuitive developer workflows. * Analyze and optimize the developer experience for machine learning performance profiling, designing intuitive tooling and workflows to help engineers diagnose and eliminate inference bottlenecks. * Communicate effectively with stakeholders, including users, partners, and management, to ensure that the systems are delivered on time and within budget. * Complete other responsibilities as assigned. **What You Bring** * Bachelor's with 10\+ years, or Master's with 8\+ years, or PhD's with 5\+ years of industry experience. * Abundant experience designing and implementing rich, interactive data visualizations and user interfaces using modern web technologies. * Strong background or interest in creating developer tools, IDE extensions, or complex diagnostic dashboards. * Proven ability to translate massive, unstructured, or multidimensional telemetry/profiling data into intuitive, human\-readable visual representations. * Strong track record of designing workflows specifically for technical users (software engineers, data scientists, or researchers), focusing on minimizing cognitive load and streamlining root\-cause diagnosis. * Hands\-on experience with, or a strong curiosity about, systems profiling and tracing tools (e.g., Perfetto, Chrome Tracing, NVIDIA Nsight Systems/Compute, PyTorch Profiler, TensorBoard, eBPF). * Baseline understanding of computing architectures (CPUs, GPUs, TPUs, interconnects/networking) and typical performance bottlenecks (memory bandwidth, compute utilization, synchronization stalls). * Bonus: Working knowledge of modern machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow) and execution paradigms (LLM inference, pipeline/tensor parallelism, kernel dispatch). * Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to think critically and creatively. * You're inclusive, adapting your style to the situation and diverse global norms of our people. * An avid learner, you approach challenges with curiosity and resilience, seeking data to help build understanding. * You're collaborative, building relationships, humbly offering support and openly welcoming approaches. * Innovative and creative, you proactively explore new ideas and adapt quickly to change. **Equal Opportunity Employment Policy** Samsung Semiconductor takes pride in being an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to fostering an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered to excel, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status. jobs.title: Power Platform and SharePoint Developer - Information Systems
jobs.description: **Grade 22: Salary starts at $89,669\.00 annually. Rate of pay depends on experience.** **Job Description** ------------------- **JOB SUMMARY** The Power Platform and SharePoint Developer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and supporting custom business applications built on the Microsoft Power Platform, focusing on both Canvas and Model\-driven apps. In addition, this position is responsible for administering and maintaining SharePoint Online environments, including site creation, configuration, and day\-to\-day management. The Developer provides technical expertise and analytical guidance to both technical teams and business stakeholders, collaborating closely to optimize business processes and user experience within the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS** * Develops and customizes PowerApps applications (Canvas and Model\-driven) to meet business requirements, ensuring optimal functionality and user experience. * Administers and maintains SharePoint environments: creates and configures site collections, manages permissions and groups, develops and maintains lists and libraries, and oversees workflow processes to support organizational needs. * Integrates PowerApps with SharePoint, Microsoft Dataverse, and other data sources (e.g., SQL, Oracle, REST \& SOAP APIs) using standard connectors and Power Automate for seamless data flow. * Works with business stakeholders to gather requirements, propose solutions, and document technical specifications for Power Platform and SharePoint projects. * Implements best practices for data integrity, security, and governance in PowerApps solutions and SharePoint administration. * Investigates, analyzes, and makes recommendations to management regarding Power Platform and SharePoint enhancements, version upgrades, and system integrations. * Provides technical and analytical guidance to other developers, team members, and end\-users regarding solution design and troubleshooting. * Follows standard software development methodologies and version control practices for solution deployment, maintenance, and updates. * Collaborates with cybersecurity teams to ensure that custom apps and SharePoint sites meet organizational and regulatory security standards. * Mentors and trains junior developers or team members on PowerApps, Power Automate, and SharePoint best practices. * Provides on\-call support as required, monitoring and resolving production issues related to PowerApps and SharePoint services. * Performs other duties as assigned. **DECISION MAKING** * This position works under limited supervision. * This position serves as a technical lead, providing guidance and mentorship to staff. **MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS FOR ALL SPECIALTIES** * Bachelor’s Degree in Management Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field from an institution accredited by a nationally recognized accrediting agency. * Six years of experience in software development or programming, including three years in each of the following: o Developing PowerApps (Canvas and Model\-driven) in an enterprise environment. o Using Power Automate (Flow) for process automation o Administering SharePoint Online (site creation, permissions, lists/libraries, workflow configuration). **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Master’s degree in management information systems, Computer Science, or a related field. * Experience with relational databases, APIs or middleware integrations, and core web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) including responsive design frameworks. * Microsoft 365 certifications (e.g., Microsoft Power Platform). * Experience developing client\-side solutions using SharePoint Framework (SPFx). * Experience with additional Power Platform components, such as Power BI or Power Virtual Agents. * Knowledge of Azure services, including Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and Azure SQL. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps) and version control systems (Git or similar) to manage and deliver high\-quality code. * Strong project management skills or leadership experience overseeing technical projects. **JOB DIMENSIONS** * Skill in Power Platform development: building, testing, and deploying PowerApps (Canvas and Model\-driven) and associated Power Automate flows. * Skill in SharePoint administration: creating and managing site collections, configuring permissions, designing lists/libraries, and enforcing governance policies. * Skill in applying secure coding best practices and ensuring compliance with cybersecurity standards. * Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a dynamic environment. * Skill in using Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365 administration portals. * Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders, contractors, consultants, and governmental agencies. * Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing with both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Ability to stay up to date with Microsoft Power platform updates and framework changes. * Ability to promote code and entire solutions from lower instances into production environments. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS** Working conditions are primarily inside an office environment with travel to various locations on an occasional basis. Physical requirements include occasional lifting/carrying of 15 pounds; visual acuity, speech and hearing; hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer keyboard and basic office equipment. Subject to sitting, standing, reaching, walking, twisting, and kneeling to perform the essential functions. May be required to work hours other than regular schedule such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

We are collaborative technologists who believe that great data and seamless systems enable researchers and employees to succeed every day. Joining our team means being part of a highly skilled, mission\-driven group that values innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement. We provide technology and expertise that help faculty and staff secure, manage, and deliver programs that truly improve lives and strengthen communities. **YOUR ROLE IN CREATING THE UNIVERSITY’S PRESENT AND FUTURE** Join the SDSU Research Foundation (SDSURF) as our newest team member, where your technical expertise will help build a better foundation for groundbreaking research and community service. In this role, you aren’t just "managing servers" or "writing code"—you are building the digital backbone that empowers San Diego State University’s R1 research mission. You will balance the essential daily work of keeping our enterprise systems running smoothly with exciting modernization initiatives that strengthen our infrastructure for the future. You’ll be one of the collaborative experts we turn to ensure our financial management, human resources, and research administration systems are secure, user\-focused, and ready to scale. Responsibilities: **THE WORK YOU WILL DO AND MANAGE** * Build and innovate: You will design, code, and document custom applications, reports, and workflows using tools like Oracle PL/SQL and APEX to meet our team's needs. * Keep the engines running: You’ll help to configure and manage the servers (like Tomcat) and Linux environments that keep our critical systems running smoothly every day. * Secure our digital doors: You will set up and manage Single Sign\-On (SSO) using Active Directory (AD/Entra) Azure Active Directory and understanding of SSL/TLS certificate request and installation, ensuring our team can safely and easily access the tools they need. * Modernize our tech: You’ll help with ERP upgrades and integrating fresh technologies. * Solve complex puzzles: You’ll dive into tricky technical issues related to system performance and data integrity, fixing bottlenecks so everything works seamlessly. Qualifications: **THE SKILLS WE NEED*** An owner: You don't wait to be told what to do; you love taking the reins to figure out, deploy, and champion new applications and servers. * A careful problem\-solver: You have a knack for troubleshooting and look at the big picture to find long\-term solutions, whether you're fixing a modern API integratio 403b retirement plan. We match 200% on the first 5% of contributions, up to 10% maximum employer matching contribution. All contributions are 100% vested. * Vacation and sick leave accruals * 14 paid holidays and 1 annual personal holiday * Hybrid in\-office/telework arrangements * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Access to campus amenities, including Love Library, Aztec Lanes bowling alley, SDSU transit center, and a variety of coffee shops and eateries. * Discounted Aztec Recreation Center gym membership and SDSU events * Wellness workshops **HOW TO APPLY AND TIPS FOR MAKING IT THROUGH OUR HIRING PROCESS** You must apply through the SDSURF Career Page. Make sure your application is complete. Including a resume and cover letter is recommended. Respond to supplemental questions thoroughly. **WHAT OUR HIRING PROCESS IS LIKE**We work as fast as we can to make hiring decisions. However, it may take several weeks for all the parties involved to review your application. We keep in touch each step of the way and inform you of the status of your application. **ADDITIONAL APPLICANT INFORMATION:*** *The salary range for this position is* **$7,371\.00 \- $10,813\.70** *depending upon qualifications and is non\-negotiable.* * Hybrid Work Philosophy: We believe that a balanced approach to work—combining the flexibility of remote work with the collaborative energy of in\-person engagement—creates the most effective and fulfilling environment for our organization. Remote work empowers individuals with autonomy, focus, and work\-life balance, while in\-office days foster connection, creativity, and shared purpose. Having at least two days in the office is essential to maintain strong interpersonal relationships, encourage spontaneous collaboration, and reinforce our shared culture. These in\-person interactions help build trust, align teams, and spark innovation in ways that are difficult to replicate remotely. By embracing a hybrid model of two days in the office and three days remote, we enable both personal productivity and collective innovation, ensuring our culture remains strong, inclusive, and adaptable. * Candidate must reside in California and live within a commutable distance from SDSU at time of hire. * Job offer is contingent upon satisfactory clearance based on background check results (including a criminal record check). * San Diego State University Research Foundation is an equal opportunity employer. Consistent with California law and federal civil rights laws, SDSU Research Foundation provides equal opportunity in employment without unlawful discrimination or preferential treatment based on race, sex, color, ethnicity, or national origin or any other categories protected by federal or state law. * Employment decisions are based on an individual’s qualifications as they relate to the job under consideration. Our commitment to equal opportunity means ensuring that every employee has equal access to resources and support. * SDSU Research Foundation complies with Titles VI and VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Title IX of the Education Amendments of 1972, the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act, the California Equity in Higher Education Act, California’s Proposition 209 (Art. I, Section 31 of the California Constitution), and other applicable state and federal anti\-discrimination laws including grant or contract terms and conditions related to funded program activities. Further the SDSU Research Foundation maintains a Nondiscrimination Policy that prohibits discriminatory preferential treatment, segregation based on race or any other protected status, and all forms of unlawful discrimination, harassment, and retaliation in all programs, policies, and practices. * SDSU Research Foundation makes all employment decisions including, but not limited to, applicant screening, hiring, promotion, demotion, compensation, benefits, disciplinary actions, and terminations on the basis of merit.

jobs.title: Developer Internship
jobs.description: **Company Description** Sanborn Head is an engineering and technical consulting firm serving a broad array of private, public, and institutional clients in the development, energy, industrial, and solid waste markets. Our multi\-disciplinary team of engineers and scientists specializes in integrating our core expertise in earth, energy, and environment to deliver innovative, yet practical solutions to our clients. We foster a collaborative, growth\-oriented culture where people work together to solve complex challenges. **Position Summary** We are seeking an aspiring civil, geotechnical, or environmental engineer to fill an Engineering Intern position in our Development Client Service Area for Summer 2027\. The Development CSA guides real estate and infrastructure projects from due diligence through design and construction, combining geotechnical and environmental expertise. The team assesses site and subsurface conditions, manages remediation and permitting needs, and develops practical, cost\-effective solutions that keep commercial, institutional, residential, and mixed\-use projects moving forward. Our ideal applicant is a current student or a recent graduate of an environmental, civil, or geotechnical engineering program. We have opportunities in our Bedford, NH; Burlington, VT; Boston, MA; and Philadelphia, PA offices. The Engineering Intern will work closely with a team of staff engineers and scientists on challenging and exciting projects. All our projects are in a variety of service areas with office and field components. This is a fast\-paced and dynamic position, with opportunities to be challenged, contribute to project outcomes, interact routinely with project managers and principals, and grow professionally. While the successful candidate will not need to have prior job experience, they must have great work ethic, a can\-do attitude and a working knowledge of industry specific software and computer skills. This opportunity will provide an atmosphere rich in learning the responsibilities of a professional engineer under the supervision of our more senior employees. **What You Will Do** * Learn the responsibilities of an engineer. * Incorporate academic knowledge into hands\-on work. * Assist in the preparation of technical reports and regulatory compliance activities. * Assist with field assessments such as groundwater and soil sampling, drilling oversight, and remediation/construction oversight. * Assist with environmental and geotechnical data collection, analysis, and interpretation. * Attend project meetings and learn how consulting projects are managed. **What You'll Learn** Our internship program is designed to provide meaningful professional development through: * Real project assignments and client\-focused work. * Technical training and mentoring from experienced professionals. * Exposure to multiple environmental practice areas. * Field experience on active project sites. * Professional skills development. * A capstone project and presentation showcasing your summer experience. **What We Are Looking For** * Willingness to learn new skills. * Flexible schedule and ability to reliably travel to project locations. * Strong attention to detail and technical understanding. * Strong organizational and communications skills. * Ability to effectively work independently and in a team environment. **Required Qualifications** * Recent degree or current enrollment in a civil, environmental, or geotechnical engineering Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program (or related discipline). * Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and an acceptable driving record. **Physical Requirements** * Requires sitting, walking and, at times, bending and prolonged standing. * Must be able to visit project sites and climb ladders and stairs as required. * The work requires both indoor and outdoor activity in temperatures ranging from moderate to extreme cold or hot and other weather conditions. * Must be able to wear and work in personal protective equipment as required. * Substantial repetitive motions of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers is required. * Close visual acuity is required to perform activities such as preparing and analyzing data and figures, transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, and extensive reading. * Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds. **Work Format and Schedule** * Full Time Temporary. * Schedule: Monday – Friday, Summer 2027\. Limited weekend and/or night work may be required. * Travel may be required. * Competitive wage. **Salary Information** * The hourly range for this position is $24 to $26\. * Specific compensation for the successful candidate will be based on factors such as experience, education, training, qualifications, and work location. **Benefits** * Medical, dental and vision insurance. * Health and wellness offerings. * 401(k) retirement and profit\-sharing plan. * Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). * Paid holidays, floating holidays, vacation, and sick time. * Paid time off for volunteering. * Company\-paid long\-term care insurance and life insurance. * Company\-paid identity protection. **How to Apply** We invite you to submit an application with a resume and cover letter, telling us why you’d be a great fit for our team. Candidates are required to possess a valid driver’s license and an acceptable driving record. We will provide reasonable accommodation consistent with applicable laws. Qualified candidates must be able, with or without reasonable accommodation, to fulfill all the obligations of the job, which include in\-person attendance at and participation in company and/or client events or worksites. **Equal Opportunity Employer Statement** Sanborn Head is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin or ancestry, disability, veteran status, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

jobs.description: Responsibilities: Sargent \& Lundy’s Consulting group is seeking a senior performance engineer with experience performing solar PV energy yield assessments on utility\-scale solar projects. Candidate will specialize in solar PV and battery energy storage performance modeling while getting the opportunity to expand their expertise across CSP, wind, geothermal, simple‑ and combined‑cycle gas, RICE, and fuel cell projects—building client\-facing experience with utilities, developers, IPPs, and data center developers on complex, high‑visibility consulting engagements. This position in Sargent \& Lundy’s Consulting group will require you to do the following:* Perform solar resource assessments considering both satellite\-based and ground\-based data * Assist in analyzing operational production and performance data and climatic data from solar projects * Conduct modeling, design review, and technical optimization across the solar, wind and battery energy storage projects. * Conduct long\-term solar PV energy production assessments using PVsyst and Excel\-based post\-processing tools. * Primarily focus on utility\-scale solar assessments but support work across all scales including residential, commercial, and industrial * Predict energy production * Assist in performing uncertainty analysis to determine probabilities of exceedance (e.g., P90, P95, P99\) * Conduct statistical uncertainty analyses, clipping adjusted degradation analysis * Participate in energy yield assessment process improvement initiatives and process validation * Collaborate on technical due diligence reports and communicate results to clients and key stakeholders including developers and financiers * Incorporate appropriate PV modeling assumptions and inputs into simulation * Communicate with clients to answer technical questions with regard to solar resource and energy yield In addition to performing PV energy yield assessments, candidate will be expected to support S\&L’s independent engineering and technical due diligence services for project financing or asset acquisition of new solar projects. Common tasks include:* Evaluating solar equipment selections / technologies * Evaluating project execution plans from EPC contractors * Reviewing project contracts including PPA, EPC, and O\&M agreements * Reviewing project CAPEX, OPEX, and performance parameters in financial models Other job duties may also include:* Preparing and reviewing engineering deliverables such as reports, studies, and calculations * Knowledge of NEC, IEEE, UL, and IEC standards related to solar design and performance * Collaborating with teammates to define project execution plans * Supporting multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring a high quality standard is met * Interfacing with clients to understand requests and confirm successful project execution * Familiarity with inverter/load ratio strategies, bifacial gain considerations, and soiling/loss estimation * Preparing proposals for new business development opportunities * Traveling occasionally to visit project locations and client offices. **This is a remote/virtual position.
