jobs.title: AI & Automation Workflow Specialist
jobs.description: Description: **AI \& Automation Workflow Specialist** **Department:** Applied AI / Innovation **Location:** Harrisburg, Lancaster or Malvern, PA **Position Summary** Join one of the most innovative, forward\-thinking law firms in the country. As a member of the Saxton \& Stump team, you’ll be joining a culture of excellence and teamwork, mixed with a strong focus on investing in our team and the community. We understand that the new legal environment requires a different type of approach to all aspects of the business, and we’ve built that into the way we recruit, the way we structure our team, and the way we value customer service. The AI \& Automation Workflow Specialist will support the firm’s Applied AI function by helping build, test, troubleshoot, maintain, and improve AI\-enabled workflows and automation solutions. This is a hands\-on technical role with meaningful attorney and end\-user interaction. The right candidate will be able to take over much of the detailed technical execution work involved in building and maintaining workflows, while also being capable of speaking directly with attorneys, documenting workflows, supporting testing, and translating feedback into practical improvements. This person does not need to be a traditional software engineer, but they must be technically fluent, detail\-oriented, curious, and comfortable working with tools such as Microsoft Power Platform, Power Automate, Microsoft 365, and AI\-enabled workflow platforms. **Key Responsibilities** **Workflow Technical Execution** * Build, test, troubleshoot, and maintain workflows using Microsoft Power Automate, Power Platform, SharePoint, Teams, Forms, Excel, and related tools. * Support the development of AI\-enabled workflows, document automation, intake processes, approval flows, task routing, and internal productivity tools. * Debug workflow errors, failed runs, logic issues, permissions problems, and integration issues. * Refine workflows based on user feedback, testing results, and operational needs. * Document workflow logic, requirements, dependencies, testing steps, known issues, and support procedures. **Requirements Gathering \& User Interaction** * Participate in attorney\-facing testing sessions, capture feedback, identify gaps, and recommend improvements. * Explain workflow functionality and technical concepts in clear, practical terms for non\-technical users. **Applied AI \& Automation Support** * Help identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve legal work, internal operations, client service, document processes, knowledge management, and administrative workflows. * Assist with pilots, proofs of concept, testing, rollout, and post\-launch support for AI and automation initiatives. * Support both internal and client\-facing AI and automation projects. * Stay current on Microsoft Power Platform, generative AI, legal technology, and workflow automation capabilities. **Project Ownership \& Support** * Take ownership of assigned workflow and automation tasks from intake through testing and implementation. * Manage day\-to\-day execution details, including issue tracking, testing coordination, documentation, and user follow\-up. * Escalate strategic, security, governance, or architecture questions when appropriate. * Help the Applied AI function scale by taking on the technical minutia required to move projects from concept to working solution. Monitor production workflows and addresses any issues quickly. Requirements: **Required Qualifications** * Experience building or supporting workflows in Microsoft Power Automate or similar automation platforms. * Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 tools, including SharePoint, Teams, Forms, Excel, and Outlook. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to communicate clearly with attorneys, executives, business users, and technical stakeholders. * Strong attention to detail and comfort managing multiple workstreams. * Willingness to learn new tools quickly and work hands\-on in emerging AI and automation platforms. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in professional services. * Experience with Power Apps, Dataverse, Copilot Studio, document automation, workflow mapping, or AI\-enabled productivity tools. * Experience creating process maps, user stories, test plans, training materials, or support documentation. * Prior experience in a business analyst, automation specialist, legal technology, product owner, solutions analyst, or technical support role. **Physical Requirements** Administrative and support staff must be able to perform the essential functions of their roles, with or without reasonable accommodation, in a professional office setting. These requirements include: * Prolonged periods of sitting or standing, depending on the nature of the role, and working on a computer or phone system. * Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing, filing, handling paperwork, and operating standard office equipment (e.g., copiers, scanners, multi\-line phones). * Ability to communicate effectively, including speaking clearly and hearing adequately in person and via phone. * Regular movement throughout the office, including walking, bending, reaching, and retrieving files or supplies. * Ability to lift and carry office materials, files, or packages up to approximately 15\-20 pounds on an occasional basis. * Ability to maintain focus and organization while managing routine tasks, interruptions, and multiple priorities. **Ideal Candidate Profile** The ideal candidate is technically capable, intellectually curious, and execution\-oriented. They enjoy building workflows, solving problems, testing details, and improving processes. They are comfortable getting into the details of automation logic and troubleshooting, but can also sit with an attorney, understand the business problem, and communicate clearly without unnecessary technical jargon. This person should be eager to grow into a broader applied AI, legal technology, automation, or product ownership role. They should be comfortable operating in ambiguity, asking good questions, taking ownership, and helping turn loosely defined ideas into reliable, usable tools. **Success in This Role Looks Like** A successful AI \& Automation Workflow Specialist will quickly become a trusted execution partner to the Director of Applied AI. They will help reduce the Director’s involvement in day\-to\-day workflow building, testing, debugging, and documentation, while providing reliable support to attorneys and staff as AI and automation tools are developed, tested, and deployed across the firm. Saxton \& Stump offers a competitive salary, as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance (which start day one of employment), a 401k plan, and the opportunity for professional growth.

jobs.title: Security Analyst
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** The Security Analyst is responsible for the daily administration, monitoring, and operational support of the District's cybersecurity program. This position assists in protecting district technology resources through security monitoring, vulnerability management, identity and access management, endpoint security, incident response, and implementation of cybersecurity best practices. Working closely with the Security Engineer, Systems Engineering, Network Services, Information Systems, and Technology Services teams, the Security Analyst helps maintain a secure, reliable, and resilient technology environment while participating in cybersecurity projects, supporting compliance initiatives, and continuously improving the District's overall security posture. **Job Responsibilities:** * Monitor enterprise security platforms for potential threats, suspicious activity, and security events. * Investigate security alerts and assist with incident response, containment, recovery, documentation, and follow\-up activities. * Assist with the administration of firewall technologies, endpoint protection platforms, email security systems, identity management solutions, and security monitoring tools. * Perform vulnerability scanning, risk analysis, remediation tracking, and validation activities. * Assist with the administration of identity and access management systems, including user access reviews, authentication technologies, and multi\-factor authentication. * Support endpoint security initiatives by monitoring compliance, assisting with security policy implementation, and coordinating remediation activities. * Maintain security logs, documentation, operational procedures, and cybersecurity records. * Assist with technology risk assessments, security reviews, and security audits. * Collaborate with Systems Engineering, Network Services, Endpoint Services, and Information Systems to implement and maintain cybersecurity best practices. * Support disaster recovery planning, business continuity testing, and security validation activities. * Evaluate emerging cybersecurity threats and recommend operational improvements. * Participate in cybersecurity awareness initiatives by assisting with user education and promoting security best practices. * Coordinate with vendors regarding cybersecurity products, updates, and support activities. * Participate in cybersecurity projects, technology implementations, and operational improvement initiatives. Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. **Minimum Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a closely related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Three years of experience supporting cybersecurity, network administration, systems administration, or enterprise technology infrastructure. * Experience supporting enterprise security technologies, endpoint protection, identity management, or security monitoring solutions. * Demonstrated analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting K–12 technology environments. * Experience administering enterprise security technologies such as Palo Alto Networks, Cortex, Microsoft Defender, Cisco Secure Email, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, or comparable technologies. * Experience with vulnerability management, SIEM platforms, endpoint detection and response (EDR), and security monitoring tools. * Experience supporting cloud security and hybrid infrastructure environments. * Industry certifications such as Security\+, CySA\+, Palo Alto, Microsoft Security, or equivalent. **Physical Requirements:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, talk or hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Overview of Benefits

jobs.title: Principal DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description: **About the EcoStruxure Building Data Platform** The EcoStruxure Building Data Platform is Schneider Electric's independent data layer for collecting, contextualizing, storing, and analyzing building operational data at scale. The platform ingests and processes real\-time telemetry from connected building systems using cloud\-native technologies hosted in Microsoft Azure. It provides the foundation for analytics, digital services, applications, and customer integrations across Schneider Electric's building ecosystem. **Role Overview** ----------------- We are seeking a **Principal DevSecOps Engineer** to own the implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the security posture of the EcoStruxure Building Data Platform. This role serves as the hands\-on security leader embedded within the engineering organization. The successful candidate will lead security tooling, security automation, vulnerability remediation coordination, software supply chain security, Secure SDLC implementation, release security readiness, and cloud security enablement across the platform. The Principal DevSecOps Engineer is accountable for the implementation and operational execution of product security controls. jobs.title: Junior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Location Note:** This a hybrid role for our Wakefield, MA office (In\-office one day per week, plus additional in\-person trainings and workshops as needed) **The Purpose of Your Role:** The Junior Data Engineer is part of the development team responsible for building, maintaining, enhancing, and integrating Sentinel’s data pipelines, data services, and connected systems. In this role, you will learn and contribute across the data engineering lifecycle: understanding requirements, documenting technical approaches, preparing test plans, writing and reviewing code, validating data quality, troubleshooting pipeline issues, and supporting releases. Working with guidance from experienced engineers, you will help turn data from APIs, databases, files, and other systems into secure, reliable, and well\-documented datasets that support Sentinel’s applications, reporting, and business decisions. You will contribute to engineering decisions within a defined scope and grow your ownership of our data platforms and practices over time. You also will support our business teams with business intelligence insights. **What you'll bring to Sentinel:** * A commitment to building secure, maintainable, testable, and observable data systems. * A growth mindset and willingness to learn from experienced engineers, analysts, and business partners. * Foundational programming skills for data processing, automation, and integration work. * Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and data transformation concepts. * Familiarity with Python or another programming language used for scripting and data engineering. * An understanding of how data quality, lineage, documentation, and governance contribute to trusted data. * Curiosity about how AI can responsibly improve engineering productivity, testing, documentation, and data quality. **What you'll be responsible for:*** Work with Business Analysts, Data Analysts, Software Engineers, and peers to understand requirements and deliver data solutions you are proud of. * Build, maintain, and enhance batch data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows under the guidance of senior engineers. * Write SQL and scripts to extract, transform, validate, and load data from APIs, databases, files, and other sources. * Help design and maintain well\-defined datasets, tables, views, and data models for downstream applications, reporting, and analytics. * Implement data quality checks, reconciliation steps, logging, and monitoring to help ensure data is accurate, complete, timely, and available. * Troubleshoot pipeline and data issues, communicate blockers clearly, and escalate risks with useful diagnostic information. * Help modernize legacy data processes and move them toward secure, automated, cloud\-based solutions that follow our CI. * Contribute to code reviews, automated tests, build pipelines, documentation, runbooks, and other practices that strengthen our development and data operations. * Support safe releases, backfills, and reprocessing by validating results and documenting changes. **About you:** We are looking for smart and innovative thinkers to drive our business and clients forward—someone with self\-motivation, drive, determination, and the strength of character to challenge the status quo. We strive to surround ourselves with team members who are proud of their work and look for people who are willing to embrace change. **What you need to have:** **Preferred qualifications:*** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field—or equivalent experience. * Academic, internship, project, or professional experience working with SQL, Python, databases, data analysis, or software development. * Understanding of relational database concepts, data modeling fundamentals, and common ETL/ELT patterns. * Experience or coursework using SQL to query, join, aggregate, and validate data. * Familiarity with structured data formats and integrations, including CSV, JSON, and REST APIs. * Foundational knowledge of AWS or another cloud platform, including storage, compute, and access\-control concepts. * Familiarity with version control, pull requests, automated testing, and build or deployment pipelines. * Ability to work in a hybrid work environment, with one day in the office. * Authorized to work in the US without current or future sponsorship. Salary Range: $85,000\-$93,000 At Sentinel, compensation is calibrated to your geographic location to reflect local market conditions; the posted salary range may vary based on where you live. **Nice to haves:*** Experience with git, build pipelines, auth, frontend testing. **What you’ll be part of:** Joining our company means becoming part of something special. We're driven by a mission to excel in our industry and within our team, supported by people who truly care about our organization. Sentinel was recently recognized by The Boston Globe as a Top Place to Work in 2020 and 2023\. In 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024, Sentinel earned a Top Workplace USA Award from Energage. So even if you don’t meet every single requirement, please consider applying if you like what you see. Our priority is to find talented individuals who enrich our team culture, contribute with enthusiasm, and are passionate about what they do. Sentinel is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes everyone to our team. If you need reasonable adjustments at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know. **Some of our Benefits:** PTO (vacation, sick, personal time bank) FTO (Flexible time off for vacation, sick and personal time) after 2 years of service 12 Paid Holidays (10 stated and 2 floating holidays) 2 Community Volunteer Days 5 Summer Half Days Medical, Dental, Vision Life Insurance LTD \& STD Retirement Plan with 4% Employer Match Parental Leave**See What We Stand For:** https://www.sentinelgroup.com/About\-Us/Join\-Our\-Team **Who we are:** Sentinel Group proudly serves nearly 5,000 clients throughout the U.S. For 35\+ years, we’ve remained devoted to positively impacting the lives of our people, our clients and our communities. With a 9\-year average associate tenure among our 265 professionals, our team’s commitment to excellent service has positioned Sentinel as the only provider who makes benefits EASY: easy for your people; easy for your business; and easy for you. jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Site Reliability \& Infrastructure Engineering team. We run entirely on the cloud, and this team owns the reliability and health of the applications running on top of it — designing the signals that tell us when something's wrong, and building the systems that keep ServiceTitan running better, faster, and cheaper as we scale. We make a huge impact on thousands of companies in the U.S. and abroad by enabling them to be more efficient and effective at running their business. Our Site Reliability and Infrastructure Engineering team centralizes the concerns of measurement and guidance so every engineer can improve availability and efficiency in their own area of the ServiceTitan cloud. We have a cultural foundation built on diversity, inclusion, and innovation, and we want you and your ideas to thrive at ServiceTitan. Come join us. **What You'll Do** * Participate in an on\-call rotation, using runbooks and playbooks to diagnose and resolve production issues (e.g., adjusting Horizontal Pod Autoscaler rules in response to load). * Design, build, and maintain observability dashboards and alerting grounded in Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). * Operate and improve our Kubernetes\-based compute platform, which runs the large majority of our infrastructure. * Work across cloud networking and infrastructure (Azure/AWS) to support reliable, scalable systems. * Investigate and resolve production incidents, including root\-cause analysis and follow\-up remediation work. * Build and operate AI agents and automation that take on manual, repetitive SRE work directly — not just tools that assist a human doing the work. * Partner with product engineering teams to review architecture and infrastructure decisions before they ship. * Write and maintain runbooks and documentation so on\-call knowledge is shared across the team, not siloed with one person. * Help define non\-functional requirements — scalability, availability, performance — for new systems as they're designed. * Collaborate across engineering teams to adopt best practices in reliability and observability. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and help teams ship changes safely and quickly. **What You'll Bring** * Kubernetes (must\-have): strong, hands\-on understanding of Kubernetes as a system. * AI\-native SRE practice (must\-have): hands\-on, personal experience using AI tools and agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Workspace, Cursor, or custom agents built on Claude/MCP servers) to diagnose, automate, and resolve infrastructure and reliability work. + ***Agentic depth:*** You've built or operated agents that autonomously monitor infrastructure and take action (e.g., an agent that watches system load and scales, remediates, or escalates without a human in the loop) — not just general AI coding assistance. You can speak concretely to how these agents are actually built and operated (MCP protocol, what a harness is, how to differentiate agent\-design strategies rather than just naming tools), to context management (e.g., progressive\-disclosure strategies for surfacing the right information without dumping everything into context), and to securing agent actions (scoping authorization, guardrails, what's available in the AI infra ecosystem to enforce it). + ***SRE application:***That agentic work is pointed at infrastructure and reliability problems specifically — you use AI to move at a materially faster pace in the SRE domain, not as a general\-purpose coding aid. * SRE principles: practical experience with SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets — able to speak to how you've defined and monitored these on real systems, not just definitions. * Cloud engineering \& networking: solid grounding in AWS or Azure, including networking fundamentals (subnetting, IP addressing). * Observability: deep experience with at least one modern observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Elasticsearch) and the ability to translate that understanding across tools. * CI/CD: strong understanding of a CI/CD system — GitHub Actions preferred, but TeamCity, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI experience is acceptable. * Programming: strong programming skills with the ability to build web applications — ideally with solid working knowledge of .NET and ASP.NET. We're also open to strong Python (Flask, FastAPI) or Java (Spring) backgrounds. The coding assessment will be tailored to whichever language/framework you're most comfortable in. * Experience with distributed systems and their common failure modes (retries, timeouts, cascading failures). * Strong production troubleshooting skills — comfortable diagnosing issues under pressure. * 8\-10\+ years of relevant hands\-on experience. * **Nice\-to\-have:** agentic systems depth beyond the gate above. Can speak concretely to how AI agents are actually built and operated — e.g., the MCP protocol and what a harne stem to enforce that. **About You** You're someone who enjoys being directly accountable for the reliability of a business\-critical, large\-scale enterprise system. You're comfortable guiding and making decisions with limited information, and capable of operating within the trade\-offs between solving for immediate needs versus bigger\-scale solutions. You feel rewarded by developing an operability culture in a quickly growing and changing environment, and you're comfortable owning a wide and diverse set of problem areas. **Be Human With Us:** Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us. **Use of AI Technology:** We use technology, including automated and AI\-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. **What We Offer:** When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: * **Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work**: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer\-nominated awards, and more. * **Holistic health and wellness benefits:** Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical. * **Support for Titans at all stages of life:** Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more. At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. For candidates in the United States, the good faith salary ranges estimate for this role is Zone 1: $147,600 USD \- $221,400 USD Applicable for: CA, CT, DC, MD, MA, NJ, NY, VA, and WA Zone 2: $137,900 USD \- $206,900 USD Applicable for: All other US locations. International Compensation for candidates residing outside the United States will vary by location and will be discussed during the hiring process. Actual compensation within a range is determined by factors including relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and performance. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package includes an annual bonus, equity, and a holistic suite of benefits.

jobs.title: Plant Operator II
jobs.description: Description: **GENERAL** **STATEMENT** **OF** **DUTIES:** Working alone and/or with other plant operators, the Plant Operator II will serve as an experienced and fully qualified senior operator for the Company’s Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) plant site. The position is responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of plant systems with little to no direct supervision. This position is expected to demonstrate advanced knowledge of LNG plant operations, process systems, equipment, safety requirements, and standard operating procedures (SOP). The Plant Operator II requires a well\-rounded individual that independently performs routine operations, recognizes, and responds to abnormal operating conditions, assists in troubleshooting equipment and process issues, and supports plant maintenance and commissioning activities. As a senior operator, the Plant Operator II ma provide training, operational guidance, and technical support to less experienced Plant Operators while working closely with the Plan Manager, engineering, maintenance, and technical support personnel. **PRIMARY** **DUTIES** **AND** **RESPONSIBILITIES:** *Stabilis Solutions* *retains* *the* *right* *to* *modify* *or* *change* *the* *duties or* *essential* *functions* *of the job* *at any* *time.* * Independently conducts daily plant operations with little to no direct supervision including, control room, monitoring, field inspections, process adjustments, and equipment operations. * Performs LNG truck loading activities and coordinates loading operations in accordance with established procedures. * Coordinates with Plant Manager, maintenance personnel, engineering, vendors, and technical support during troubleshooting and equipment repair. * Maintains and services cryogenic pumping systems, mechanical piping, valves, and pressure relief systems. * Ensures all company and customer safety and environmental procedures are followed. * Exercises independent judgement within established operating procedures to maintain safe and reliable plant operation and escalates conditions exceeding established operating limits or authority. * Completes systems and facility operations training and certification sessions as assigned. * Completes job site specific training as needed. * Identifies components on a piping and instrumentation diagram (P\&ID) and locate the items at the plant. * Reads, understands, and comprehends service and owner manuals, written SOPs, and other company documentation. * Reviews P\&IDs, electrical schematics, loop diagrams, equipment manuals, and other technical documentation to support plant operation and troubleshooting * Takes direction from plant supervisor, off\-site engineers, and technical support staff to successfully solve problems. * Independently performs first\-level troubleshooting and diagnosis of plant equipment, process, instrumentation, and control system issues and coordinates additional technical support when required. * Follows system commissioning activities and conducts periodic monitoring and inspection of systems. * Responds to emergency shutdowns as required. * Serves as senior plant operator and operational resource for less experienced Plant Operators * Provides training, coaching, and technical guidance to Plant Operator I personnel regarding plant operations, safety procedures, equipment operation, SOPs, and emergency response. * Maintains plant housekeeping, safety, environmental, and regulatory compliance standards and compliant work practices. * Conducts thorough shift turnover with incoming personnel, communicating plant status, equipment availability, active maintenance, abnormal conditions, outstanding work, alarms, operational limitations, and other relevant information. * Monitors LNG systems in an outdoor environment, sometimes in adverse weather. * Proficient in computer skills, including Microsoft Office suite software, and the ability to make simple mathematical computations. * Must be able to monitor systems via computer screens. * Ability to follow written and oral instructions. * Ability to multi\-task and prioritize. * Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with other Stabilis employees and customers. * Ability to read ladder type electrical schematics and loop diagrams. * Ability to read, understand and comprehend service manuals, owner's manuals, written procedures, and other company documentation. * Ability to use and maintain personal protective equipment (i.e., safety toe boots, hard hat, flame retardant clothing, ear/eye protection, etc.). * Ability to independently operate the LNG facility under normal operating conditions. * Ability to recognize and appropriately respond to abnormal operating conditions. * Competently perform plant startups, shutdowns, equipment changeovers, and emergency response procedures. * Ability to troubleshoot process and equipment issues using P\&IDs, operating trends, alarm, schematics, manuals, and other technical resourc  multiple operational and maintenance issues during changing plant conditions. * Must be able to lift to 50 pounds. * Ability to pass a background check, drug screening, and occupational medical exam. * Ability to obtain Texas Railroad Commission certificate within 30 days (training assistance will be provided). * Experience with the following: Instrument Air Systems, Valve Actuators (Pneumatic, Motorized, Solenoid), Positional Feedback Systems, Fixed and Variable Speed Motors, Heaters, Pumps, Compressors, Vacuum and/or Refrigeration Systems, Pressure Relief Valves * Must successfully complete the Company’s Plant Operator II qualification requirements, including demonstrated competency in plant operations, LNG loading, startup/shutdown procedures, emergency response, troubleshooting, equipment isolation, and applicable safety procedures. Requirements: * High school diploma or GED. * Must possess a valid driver’s license. * Minimum four years’ experience working and performing maintenance in a petroleum or chemical plant environment; LNG and/or cryogenic plant experience a plus. * A combination of relevant experience demonstrated plant competency, and successful completion of the Company’s Plant Operator I qualification program may be considered in lieu of the experience requirement. * Experience handling gas cylinders and pressure regulators a plus. * Must have good knowledge of mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic theory and application and be able to learn and use manuals and other resources to apply that knowledge in the requirements of the job. * Experience with cryogenic refrigeration, gas processing, and/or steam. * Exhibit a high level of comfort, awareness, and competence when working safely on energized equipment. * Ability to perform work without supervision and to think clearly under unexpected circumstances. * Ability to understand and analyze complex systems. **WORKING ENVIRONMENT:** * Activities involve standing, sitting, stooping, kneeling, climbing, lifting, carrying, transferring objects, reaching, pushing, and pulling. May need to lift to 50 pounds. * Control Room and Field Environment: The majority of the work is performed inside the control room in a comfortable environment. However, the need to perform work outside is also necessary where the climate and/or temperature may be uncomfortable. * Work schedules vary and are typically 12\-hour shifts 24/7\. Schedules rotate so operators work some weekends and some nights. * Office equipment will be used including copiers/printers, telephones, keyboards, and computers. Skills and activities require fine motor dexterity, good vision, good hearing, and clear speaking. * Non\-smoking and drug free workplace. **DRUG\-FREE WORKPLACE STATEMENT:** Stabilis Solutions, Inc. is a drug\-free workplace that provides employment opportunities in compliance with all pertinent federal, state, and local laws. Our values promote employee participation in the delivery of quality services to our clients and customers. Employees are subject to pre\-employment and random drug screens. Medical evaluations are also required. **EQUITY IN THE WORKPLACE \& EEO STATEMENT:** Stabilis provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. **WORK SCHEDULE:** The Plant Operator position is a full\-time position with extended work hours (12\-hour days) as well as some weekend work. 7 Days on, 7 Days off; alternating day and night shifts (5am\-5pm, 5pm\-5am).

jobs.title: Oracle Database Administration Supervisor I
jobs.description: Job Summary \- Why you’ll love this position **Location**: Office of State Courts Administrator, Jefferson City, MO **The salary reflected represents the base pay for this position and does not include any differential for time\-of\-service pay for state tenure.** **Why you'll love this position:** A position with the Office of State Courts Administrator provides you the opportunity to work with a variety of exceptional, hardworking people and to gain a valuable and rewarding career. It takes many types of talent to advance the mission of the Missouri Judiciary and to keep operations running smoothly. We have opportunities for individuals seeking meaningful work in providing administrative, business and information technology services to the Missouri courts. We are recruiting to fill a Oracle Database Administration Supervisor I position to supervise Oracle Database Administration staff in all areas, set priorites for staff, ensuring those priorities align with orginzational goals. This role also works as a Senior Oracle Database Administrator and performs installation and configuguration of the database software, research and planning of new releases and upgrades, and supporting the deployed products. They perform hands\-on database administration including the maintenance, backup, recovery, tuning and monitoring of all databases. This role requires a proactive approach to risk management, particularly concerning information security risks, and ensures optimal database performance through tuning and maintenance. In addition they are able to work as the highest level support engineer with knowledge and ability to respond to on\-call situations. Responsibilities \- What you’ll do * Trains, supervises, mentors, evaluates and motivates assigned staff * Determines and defines work assignments, delegates work related to the efficient operation of all OSCA computer systems analysis and design or other information technology specialties * Confers with management relative to strategic planning, long term priorities and agency goals; implements data\-gathering and programming techniques; directs feasibility studies; recommends computer information technology solutions; and manages project implementation * Communicates with vendors on hardware and software developments, and directs or conducts the research, recommendation, and preparation of requests for proposals or bid specifications for hardware and software purchases * Supervises the development and application of standards and procedures necessary to develop, install, and maintain efficient computer information technology systems. * Supervises and participates in computer systems disaster recovery plan maintenance and implementation. * Manages and maintains all organizational Oracle Windows, Linux, and Exadata Systems that utilize technologies including RAC, ASM, Active Data Guard, and RMAN to complete and validate backups, monitor performance and troubleshooting errors * Develops and executes database strategies to ensure data integrity and availability, including backup, restore, restart and recovery routines (and if appropriate, disaster recovery); collaborates with relevant specialist teams in the wider organization * Collaborates with cross\-functional teams to develop and implement database solutions to support business needs * Monitors database security to ensure data is protected and complies with data privacy regulations, in conjunction with the wider security team * Monitors performance, service\-level adherence and trends to alert management, development and operations teams about runtime performance problems * Creates and maintains database documentation, including data standards, procedures and definitions * Plans and executes database installs, updates and migrations to new hosts, working closely with technical teams to ensure minimal downtime and impact on users * Collaborates with vendors to resolve database\-related issues and implement new features Qualifications \- All you need for success **Minimum qualifications:** Bachelor's degree with at least 15 semester hours in computer science, computer information systems, or closely related areas and 7 years of professional and technical computer information systems experience, including 2 years of experience as an Oracle Database Administrator, and 2 years of experience as a Senior Oracle Database Administrator, and at least 1 year of supervisory experience; Or 2 years of experience as a Senior Oracle Database Administrator with the Office of State Courts Administrator. Additional experience above the minimum stated may be substituted on a year for year basis for the required education. Job Details \- More reasons to love this position The State of Missouri offers an excellent benefits package that includes a defined pension plan, generous amounts of leave and holiday time, and eligibility for health insurance coverage. Your total compensation is more than the dollars you receive in your paycheck. More information regarding employment and benefits can be found here: OSCA Benefits. To review an interactive total compensation calculator, click the following link: Compensation Calculator Contact Details \- If you have questions or require any accommodations to participate in the application or interview process please contact: Please send inquiries regarding this position or questions regarding employment with the Office of State Courts Administrator to: OSCAHumanResources@courts.mo.gov The State of Missouri is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to developing and maintaining a talented workforce.

jobs.title: Salesforce DevOps Architect
jobs.description: Overview: We are seeking an experienced **Salesforce DevOps Architect** to design, implement, and manage scalable CI/CD processes across our Salesforce environments. This role will be responsible for improving deployment reliability, release velocity, automated testing, environment management, and platform governance using Salesforce DX and the Microsoft Azure DevOps tool suite. The ideal candidate has hands\-on Salesforce development experience combined with strong knowledge of Azure DevOps, source\-driven development, release automation, and enterprise change\-management practices. Contributions: **Responsibilities include:*** Design, build, and maintain Salesforce CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps Pipelines. * Manage Salesforce source code and branching strategies using Azure Repos and Git. * Automate Salesforce metadata validation, deployment, testing, and promotion across development, integration, UAT, staging, and production environments. * Use Salesforce CLI, Salesforce DX, Metadata API, and related tools to support source\-driven development. * Develop and maintain YAML\-based build and release pipelines. * Establish pull\-request standards, approval processes, quality gates, and automated code\-review checks. * Integrate Apex tests, code\-coverage validation, static code analysis, security scanning, and deployment validation into CI/CD pipelines. * Coordinate releases across multiple Salesforce development teams and environments. * Manage deployment dependencies, destructive changes, profiles, permission sets, custom metadata, and environment\-specific configuration. * Create and maintain release plans, deployment runbooks, rollback procedures, and technical documentation. * Monitor pipeline performance, troubleshoot deployment failures, and identify opportunities to improve release reliability. * Support sandbox strategy, environment refreshes, source synchronization, and release\-branch management. * Apply secure credential\-management practices using Azure Key Vault, service connections, certificates, and connected apps. * Partner with Salesforce architects, developers, testers, product owners, and security teams to implement consistent DevOps standards. * Provide release metrics and reporting through Azure Boards, dashboards, and pipeline analytics. Qualifications: **Required Qualifications*** 4\+ years of experience working with the Salesforce platform. * 2\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce DevOps, release engineering, or CI/CD experience. * Strong experience with the Microsoft Azure DevOps suite, including: + Azure Pipelines + Azure Repos + Azure Boards + Azure Artifacts + Azure Test Plans or comparable testing tools * Experience creating and maintaining YAML\-based Azure DevOps pipelines. * Proficiency with Git, pull requests, branching strategies, merge conflict resolution, and code\-review workflows. * Hands\-on experience with Salesforce CLI, Salesforce DX project structure, scratch orgs or sandboxes, and Salesforce Metadata API. * Experience deploying Apex, Lightning Web Components, Aura components, Flows, permission sets, custom metadata, and other Salesforce configuration. * Understanding of Salesforce deployment dependencies and common metadata deployment limitations. * Experience incorporating Apex testing and code\-coverage requirements into automated pipelines. * Ability to troubleshoot Salesforce validation, authentication, dependency, and deployment failures. * Experience working within Agile delivery teams and structured release\-management processes. * Strong communication, documentation, and cross\-functional collaboration skills. **Preferred Qualifications*** Salesforce Platform Developer I, Platform Developer II, or Salesforce Administrator certification. * Microsoft Azure or Azure DevOps certification. * Experience with unlocked packages, second\-generation packaging, or modular Salesforce architecture. * Experience with static\-analysis tools such as Salesforce Code Analyzer, PMD, SonarQube, Checkmarx, or comparable products. * Experience with automated testing tools such as Provar, Selenium, AccelQ, Copado Robotic Testing, or Playwright. * Familiarity with Copado, Gearset, Flosum, AutoRABIT, or other Salesforce DevOps platforms. * Experience supporting Salesforce Experience Cloud, Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, OmniStudio, or industry clouds. * Knowledge of Azure Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID, service principals, and enterprise secrets management. * Experience supporting multiple Salesforce teams working concurrently within a shared release train. * Familiarity with ITIL, change\-control, separation\-of\-duties, and regulated\-environment requirements. About **steampunk**: Steampunk relies on several factors to determine salary, including but not limited to geographic location, contractual requirements, education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience. The projected compensation range for this position is $80,000 to $175,000\. The estimate displayed represents a typical annual salary range for this position. Annual salary is just one aspect of Steampunk’s total compensation package for employees. Learn more about additional Steampunk benefits here. **Identity Statement** As part of the application process, you are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. Through our **Human\-Centered delivery methodology**, we are fundamentally changing the expectations our Federal clients have for true shared accountability in solving their toughest mission challenges. If you want to learn more about our story, visit http://www.steampunk.com. *We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Steampunk participates in the E\-Verify program.*

jobs.title: Project Manager II
jobs.description: **Project Manager II** **At Sure Steel, Inc., we are more than just a construction company – we are builders of success, integrity, and innovation. We have established ourselves as a trusted leader in the steel fabrication and construction industry. Our commitment to excellence, safety, and customer satisfaction has earned us a reputation for delivering top\-quality projects on time and within budget. Our team is dedicated to delivering innovative solutions to meet the unique needs of each project, ensuring safety, efficiency, and client satisfaction.** -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **This is a Full\-time position reporting to our offices in South Weber, UT, Sanger, TX, and Charolette, NC** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Position Overview** --------------------- The Project Manager II is responsible for independently managing construction projects from planning through closeout. This role oversees all phases of the project lifecycle, including budgeting, scheduling, execution, and client communication.The Project Manager II serves as the primary point of contact for stakeholders and leads project teams to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with quality standards.This position requires a higher level of autonomy and leadership compared to Project Manager I, including ownership of moderately complex projects and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.**Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Project Planning \& Management** * Develop and manage project plans, schedules, budgets, and resource allocations * Lead preconstruction efforts, including scope review, estimating support, and procurement planning * Ensure alignment between project scope, contract documents, and deliverables ### **Project Execution \& Oversight** * Manage daily project operations, including subcontractor coordination and field activities * Oversee project progress, ensuring adherence to schedules, budgets, and quality standards * Conduct site visits and inspections to monitor performance and ensure compliance with safety requirements ### **Financial \& Cost Management** * Develop and manage project budgets, forecasts, and cost controls * Review and approve invoices, change orders, and project expenditures * Identify and mitigate cost risks to maintain financial performance ### **Stakeholder \& Client Management** * Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, architects, engineers, and subcontractors * Lead project meetings and provide regular updates on progress, risks, and performance * Build and maintain strong client and vendor relationships ### **Team Leadership \& Coordination** * Lead and coordinate cross\-functional project teams * Delegate tasks and provide guidance to junior staff and project engineers * Support mentoring and development of Project Manager I and team members ### **Risk Management \& Issue Resolution** * Identify project risks and proactively implement mitigation strategies * Resolve project issues, conflicts, and delays to maintain project momentum * Ensure compliance with contracts, building codes, and safety regulations ### **Documentation \& Reporting** * Maintain all project documentation including contracts, drawings, schedules, and reports * Track project performance metrics and provide accurate reporting to leadership * Manage change orders, RFIs, and project communications **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience) * 4–7\+ years of construction project management experience * Demonstrated ability to manage projects independently from start to finish * Strong knowledge of construction processes, contracts, and project delivery methods * Experience managing subcontractors, budgets, and schedules * Strong leadership, communication, and problem\-solving skills * Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously * Willingness to travel up to 25% as needed **Skills \& Competencies** -------------------------- * Advanced project planning and scheduling * Budgeting and cost control expertise * Strong leadership and team management * Effective stakeholder communication * Risk management and decision\-making * Proficiency with construction/project management software **Sure Steel, Inc. is an equal opportunity organization. We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote without regard to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.**

jobs.title: Field Service Technician
jobs.description: ### **Make an Impact with Healthcare Technology Jobs That Matter** At Swisslog Healthcare, Field Service Technicians are critical to our customer care and support initiatives. Our Field Service techs are on the front\-line, interfacing with our customers on a daily basis, keeping their systems up and running, ensuring optimal system performance, and improving patient safety, which in turn allows doctors and nurses to focus on critical patient care in hospitals across North America. Field Service Technicians perform all Customer Support duties and responsibilities relating to Swisslog products, including preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, warranty service, emergency service, on\-call service, start\-up of current systems, operator maintenance and user training, and promotion of company products and services as required. This individual will be based in Los Angeles, California , supporting our Transport Automation customers throughout the greater LA metro and surrounding areas. ### **Short Facts** * Los Angeles, CA, United States * Field Service * Permanent Position ### **Responsibilities** Make an impact Perform all Customer Support Duties and Responsibilities relating to Swisslog Healthcare's Transport Automation systems including: * Provide scheduled preventive maintenance services to contract customers in assigned area. * Provide on\-demand corrective, 24/7 emergency, and paid services to customers in assigned area as required. * Provide start\-up services on Translogic Systems as assigned. * Assist with start\-up services on new Swisslog products as required, working closely with the assigned Installation Specialists. * Report product quality issues to assigned Senior Field Service Engineer and/or Customer Care Manager and file quality reports as directed/required. * Train Swisslog customers on system and light maintenance operations. * Promote parts orders, provide recommended parts lists to clients and recommend inventory stocking levels to customers as required. * Conduct periodic customer care visits to monitor product performance and customer satisfaction. * Maintain accountability/inventory of assigned spare parts (crash kit) and customers’ consignment inventories when inventories are contractually maintained by Swisslog Healthcare. * Assist all customers within assigned area with parts orders, consumables, repair and return of defective parts, and requests for information pertaining to their systems. * Advise Customer Care Manager of any problems or opportunities that arise within their area of responsibility. * Ensure that required administrative paperwork, Service Work Orders, Expense Reports and Downtime Reports, and start\-up logs are properly filled out and processed in a timely manner. * Communicate and share information with sales personnel and support personnel as it relates to their assigned customer base. * Exercise proper care and accountability of all assigned company property, be mindful in spending company’s money and resources responsibly, and exercise proper care and responsibility when working with customers’ property and/or facilities. * Maintain a clean and professional appearance at all times when working with customers. * Adhere to and strictly enforce all company safety policies and procedures. * Attend required training programs to keep current on system updates. * Position may require some travel as well as holiday and weekend work. ### **Application Requirements** What you need to succeed * Vocational school, related military experience, or job experience equivalent. * 1\-3 years field service experience with electro\-mechanical products. * Successful candidates will have an effective communication style that builds customer's trust and satisfaction. * Ability to read blue prints, schematics and wiring diagrams to extract necessary technical information. * Exceptional interpersonal skills (customer service skills) and communication skills. * PC Computer software and hardware literate/Windows Application experience. * Basic computer networking skills. * Must be a self\-starter, well organized, and be able to work independently without supervision. Desirable, but not Essential: * Experience working in a mission\-critical, on\-call environment. Experience with 24/7 on\-call availability is ideal. * Associate's Degree from a Technical or Vocational School. Eligibility Requirements: * Ability and willingness to travel 30 to 70% of the time for technical support and training purposes. * Ability and willingness to work on\-call hours including weekend, night, and/or holiday work. * Ability and willingness to lift, lower and carry objects up to 50 lbs., work from heights, climb ladders, and work in confined spaces. * Must have a valid driver’s license and excellent driving record. * Must reside in or very near to the Los Angeles, California metropolitan area. * Must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer. Unfortunately, Swisslog Healthcare is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position, either now or in the future. If you will require sponsorship to work in the US at any time, please do not apply for this position. Compensation: Base salary range for this position is $62,000 \- $72,000, plus overtime and on\-call pay, plus vehicle benefit and fuel card. Salary will be commensurate with experience and skillset. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical / dental / vision insurance, tuition reimbursement, disability, 401k matching (up to 8%) Flexible Working Options Great Team Spirit Grow with Us! Latest Technology Learn \& Grow Meaningful Tasks Retirement Plans ### **Equal Opportunity Employer** Swisslog Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, status as a protected veteran, or any other applicable status protected by federal, state or local law. Federal law requires employers to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete the application or to perform your job, please contact Human Resources at jobs.healthcare.us@swisslog\-healthcare.com.

jobs.title: Field Operations & Project Coordinator
jobs.description: Field Operations \& Project Coordinator Construction, Technology \& Future Leadership Development Track Build Technology. Work Hands\-On. Lead Projects. Develop the Skills to Run Them. Synergy Fiber is seeking motivated, hands\-on individuals who want more than a traditional desk job. This position is ideal for people with professional aspirations who enjoy working with their hands, solving problems, and learning new skills. It combines technology, construction, project coordination, customer interaction, and career development into a unique opportunity that offers long\-term growth in both the technology and building trades industries. This role can be tailored to your strengths and experience. Much of what we do is taught through hands\-on training and mentorship. Candidates with trade school training, associate degrees, bachelor's degrees, military experience, or relevant industry experience may all be excellent fits. This is a true hybrid role that bridges both the office and project management side of the business with the construction and field operations side. You will gain exposure to: * Field Operations * Construction Project Delivery * Telecommunications * Network Infrastructure * Customer Communication * Sales Support * Project Management * Technology Design * Automation and AI Tools Unlike a traditional office\-based project management position, this role combines hands\-on field experience with project coordination, customer communication, and leadership development. Approximately 50% of your time will be spent in the field working alongside installation crews, contractors, customers, and project stakeholders. This position may require up to 40% travel, depending on project assignments and business needs. Travel may include company vehicle travel and occasional air travel. A valid driver's license, willingness to travel, and the ability to adapt to changing priorities are required. Our goal is to develop future hands\-on Project Managers, Operations Leaders, Designers, Estimators, Sales Engineers, and Technology Leaders within Synergy Fiber. This role requires individuals who are willing to learn every aspect of installation work while also developing the skills needed to coordinate projects, manage teams, communicate with customers, and oversee subcontractors. This position sits at the intersection of field operations and project management. Successful candidates enjoy learning, solving problems, and helping move projects from initial sale through successful completion. Many leaders within Synergy Fiber work in similar hybrid roles. Some are more installation\-focused, while others spend more time on project management and customer coordination, but all maintain exposure to both sides of the business. Candidates must be comfortable using modern business tools, including Microsoft 365, Outlook, Excel, Word, Teams, and emerging AI technologies. Why This Opportunity Stands Out This is not a typical entry\-level office position. You'll gain exposure to: * Microsoft 365 and modern business systems * Project Coordination \& Leadership * Installation of camera, access control, and wireless systems * Telecommunications \& Structured Cabling * Network Infrastructure \& Wi\-Fi Deployment * Smart Building Technologies * Low\-Voltage Installation * Access Control \& Surveillance Systems * Estimating \& Project Planning * Customer \& Stakeholder Management * Sales Support \& Business Development * Technology Automation \& AI Applications * Design \& Engineering Processes * Future BICSI Certification \& RCDD Career Development You'll learn how technology systems are sold, designed, managed, installed, and supported while helping shape the future of project delivery through innovation and automation. What You'll Do Support Real\-World Projects * Learn Bluebeam, Microsoft 365, project management platforms, and other business tools. * Assist with planning, execution, and closeout of telecommunications and technology projects. * Coordinate with customers, contractors, vendors, and internal teams. * Track schedules, budgets, risks, and project milestones. * Participate in customer meetings and project reviews. * Help ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and to Synergy Fiber quality standards. Gain Hands\-On Field Experience * Work directly alongside field technicians, foremen, and construction teams. * Learn construction sequencing, installation methods, and project workflows. * Assist with installations and field activities. * Help solve field issues and support project execution. * Attend jobsite meetings, site surveys, and project walkthroughs. * Develop a practical understanding of how projects move from design to completion. Build Technical \& Design Expertise * Learn to interpret construction drawings, floor plans, risers, and specifications. * Support estimating, design reviews, and solution development. * Gain knowledge of structured cabling, telecommunications, networking, Wi\-Fi, surveillance, access control, and smart building technologies. * Develop the foundation for future industry certifications and technical leadership opportunities. Drive Technology \& Innovation * Help implement AI\-powered project management and operational tools. * Assist with reporting, dashboards, and workflow automation initiatives. * Participate in process improvement projects across the business. * Help modernize how projects are managed, tracked, and delivered. Who We're Looking For This role may be a great fit for: * Military veterans * Trade school graduates * Associate or bachelor's degree graduates, including recent graduates * Field technicians * Low\-voltage installers * Telecom technicians * Electricians * Construction professionals * Facilities and maintenance personnel * General contractors * Foremen seeking leadership opportunities * Individuals with strong mechanical and contracting aptitude who are eager to learn Experience with Microsoft Office, Excel, email, project management software, and AI tools is preferred. Low\-voltage or telecommunications experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with project management experience are encouraged to apply. Candidates interested in learning project management and developing leadership skills are also encouraged to apply. We are willing to train the right individual. Education \& Experience A four\-year degree is not required. Preferred qualifications include one or more of the following: * Trade school education * Associate degree * Bachelor's degree * Technical certification programs * Military technical training * Apprenticeship programs * Relevant industry coursework Equivalent hands\-on industry experience will be strongly considered. We value real\-world experience, professionalism, technical curiosity, mechanical aptitude, contracting aptitude, and a willingness to learn. Location Requirements This position is based in Ann Arbor, Michigan. Candidates should reside within approximately 40 minutes of the Ann Arbor area to allow for efficient travel between our office, customer locations, and project sites. What Makes Someone Successful * Strong work ethic * Reliability and professionalism * Mechanical and contracting aptitude * Strong communication skills * Problem\-solving mindset * Technical curiosity * Customer\-focused attitude * Ability to work both in the field and in an office environment * Desire to learn and grow * Interest in leadership and project management * Positive attitude and willingness to take ownership Career Growth Opportunities This role is designed as a launchpad for long\-term career development. Potential career paths include: * Project Coordinator * Project Manager * Senior Project Manager * Estimator * Telecommunications Designer * RCDD Certified Designer * Operations Manager * Design Services Manager Join Synergy Fiber If you're looking for a career that combines construction, technology, project coordination, customer interaction, field experience, and leadership development, this is an opportunity to build valuable skills while helping create the connected buildings of tomorrow. This role provides extensive exposure to both technology and the skilled trades, creating a long\-term career path that remains highly valuable in an increasingly automated world. Learn. Build. Lead. Grow. With Synergy Fiber.

jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist
jobs.description: At T\-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package \- this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth\-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year\-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees! \*\* This is not a remote position. T\-Mobile is a hybrid work environment requiring work in the office three (3\) days per week. The successful candidate will be located in either Seattle, Washington or Overland Park, Kansas areas.\*\* Job Overview This role drives technical innovation across the data science function, applying advanced analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to solve complex business challenges. It partners with technical and non\-technical stakeholders to develop modeling solutions that support critical operations. Success is measured by effective implementation, adoption of emerging technologies, and delivery of actionable insights that strengthen data\-driven decision\-making and advance team capabilities.**Job Responsibilities**: * Extract, prepare, and model large, complex data sets to develop advanced analytics and machine learning solutions * Identify and evaluate new technologies to enhance data integration and quantitative analytics capabilities * Own the implementation and standardization of advanced analytics and modeling toolkits for data science teams * Collaborate with data engineering to shape data management strategies, architecture, governance, and infrastructure * Provide senior\-level guidance on data science methodologies and approaches to technical teams * Communicate insights and technical information to business leaders through verbal, written, and visual means Also responsible for other duties/projects as assigned by business management as needed * **Required** **Education:** Bachelor's Degree plus 7 years of related work experience OR Advanced degree with 5 years of related experience . Acceptable areas of study include Quantitative Discipline (math, statistics, economics, computer science, physics, engineering) * **Required Experience** * 7\-10 years Industry experience in predictive modeling, data science, and analysis in an ML engineer or data scientist role building and deploying ML models or hands on experience developing deep learning models * 4\-7 years Experience writing and speaking about technical concepts to business, technical, and lay audiences and giving data\-driven presentations * 7\-10 years Experience articulating and translating business questions and using statistical techniques to arrive at an answer using available data * 4\-7 years Experience with statistical methods and advanced modeling techniques. For example\- SVM, Random Forest, graph models, Bayesian inference, NLP, Computer Vision, neural networks * 4\-7 years Experience with big data architecture and pipeline, Hadoop, Hive, Spark, Kafka, etc. * 7\-10 years Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python) * 4\-7 years Experience in data visualization 7\-10 years Extended experience working with relational database using SQL * **Preferred Experience** * 4\-7 years Experience in telecom industry **Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**: * Advanced Analytics * Critical Thinking * Data Science * Data Visualization * Generative AI * Large Language Model (LLM) * Machine Learning (ML) Statistical Analysis * **Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**: * Data Bricks * Deep Learning * XGBoost * LGBM * PySpark * Reinforced Learning \#LI\-Corporate * At least 18 years of age * Legally authorized to work in the United States **Travel**: Travel Required (Yes/No): No **DOT Regulated**: DOT Regulated Position (Yes/No): No Safety Sensitive Position (Yes/No): No Total Target Cash Earnings Opportunity: $152,880 \- $275,760 National Base Pay Range: $127,400 \- $229,800 The Total Target Cash Earnings Opportunity represents the expected total cash compensation for this role at target performance, combining base salary and annual incentive opportunity. Actual earnings may be higher or lower depending on individual performance and overall company results. The base pay range reflects the compensation component of this opportunity. The candidate’s actual pay will be based on various factors, such as work location, qualifications, and experience, so the actual starting pay will vary within this range. To find the pay range for this role based on hiring location, click here. At T\-Mobile, employees in regular, non\-temporary roles are eligible for an annual bonus or periodic sales incentive or bonus, based on their role. Corporate employees are eligible for a year\-end bonus based on individual and/or company performance and which is set at a percentage of the employee’s eligible earnings in the prior year. Certain positions in Customer Care are eligible for monthly bonuses based on individual and/or team performance. The incentive component included in the Total Target Cash Earnings Opportunity reflects target performance. Actual earnings included in the Total Target Cash Earnings Opportunity reflect target performance; actual payouts may vary. At T\-Mobile, our benefits exemplify the spirit of One Team, Together! A big part of how we care for one another is working to ensure our benefits evolve to meet the needs of our team members. Full and part\-time employees have access to the same benefits when eligible. We cover all of the bases, offering medical, dental and vision insurance, a flexible spending account, 401(k), employee stock grants, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off and up to 12 paid holidays \- which total about 4 weeks for new full\-time employees and about 2\.5 weeks for new part\-time employees annually \- paid parental and family leave, family building benefits, back\-up care, enhanced family support, childcare subsidy, tuition assistance, college coaching, short\- and long\-term disability, voluntary AD\&D coverage, voluntary accident coverage, voluntary life insurance, voluntary disability insurance, and voluntary long\-term care insurance. We don't stop there \- eligible employees can also receive mobile service \& home internet discounts, pet insurance, and access to commuter and transit programs! To learn about T\-Mobile’s amazing benefits, check out *www.t\-mobilebenefits.com**.* Never stop growing!### As part of the T\-Mobile team, you know the Un\-carrier doesn’t have a corporate ladder–it’s more like a jungle gym of possibilities! We love helping our employees grow in their careers, because it’s that shared drive to aim high that drives our business and our culture forward. By applying for this career opportunity, you’re living our values while investing in your career growth–and we applaud it. You’re unstoppable!### T\-Mobile USA, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All decisions concerning the employment relationship will be made without regard to age, race, ethnicity, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, national origin, religious affiliation, marital status, citizenship status, veteran status, the presence of any physical or mental disability, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Discrimination, retaliation or harassment based upon any of these factors is wholly inconsistent with how we do business and will not be tolerated.### Talent comes in all forms at the Un\-carrier. If you are an individual with a disability and need reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know by emailing ApplicantAccommodation@t\-mobile.com or calling 1\-844\-873\-9500\. Please note, this contact channel is not a means to apply for or inquire about a position and we are unable to respond to non\-accommodation related requests.

quality and security; apply them to eliminate recurring incidents and manual tasks, reducing toil and improving resolution times. * Site Reliability Engineering — apply SRE practices including scripting. * Hands\-on experience with an HPC workload scheduler such as Slurm (or equivalent, e.g. PBS/LSF/Grid Engine). * Hands\-on cloud experience is critical — experience with a major public analytical, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work independently on well\-defined problems and ask the right questions on ambiguous ones. * Good communication, collaboration, and documentation skills. * Willingness and availability to participate in a shared on\-call/escalation rotation. **Preferred Qualifications:** * AWS depth — hands\-on with core services (e.g., EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, EKS/ECS, CloudFormation/CDK, CloudWatch); AWS certification a plus. * Experience with parallel/clustered filesystems (e.g., Lustre, BeeGFS, GPFS/Spectrum Scale, Panasas, or VAST) and high\-speed interconnects. * Experience supporting large\-scale HPC compute/storage environments and visualization services. * Kubernetes at scale (Helm, autoscaling, networking/ingress, namespace/resource governance). * Depth in Python and Bash automation; Perl or PowerShell a plus. * Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, ELK/OpenSearch, Splunk). * Cloud security
