jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description: The Project Engineer applies technical, administrative, and project management knowledge to support the successful execution of sewer rehabilitation and infrastructure projects. Utilizes construction plans, specifications, schedules, contract documents, field data, and company software systems to assist Project Managers in planning, coordinating, tracking, and executing project work. Serves as a key link between field operations, project management, subcontractors, vendors, clients, and internal support departments to help ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, on schedule, and within budget. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** Include the following. Other duties may be assigned. **Pre\-Construction Tasks:** * Review and understand project plans, specifications, bid documents, permits, and contract requirements. * Assist Project Managers with project startup activities, including job setup in ERP and project management systems. * Attend pre\-bid, pre\-construction meetings and assist with documenting and distributing meeting minutes. * Prepare and track submittals, requests for information, permits, utility notifications, and project documentation. * Assist with development and tracking of project schedules, work plans, and project budgets. * Coordinate material procurement activities and prepare purchase orders. * Prepare subcontract agreements, work orders and verify subcontractor compliance documentation. **Project Management Tasks:** * Maintain a working knowledge of project scope, contract requirements, and client expectations. * Monitor project costs, quantities, production data, and budget performance. * Assist with forecasting project costs and identifying potential budget variances. * Track change orders and assist with preparation, pricing, documentation, and submission. * Support project cost reviews and status reporting. * Participate in project progress and scheduling meetings. * Maintain accurate project records, correspondence, and electronic project files. * Support preparation and submission of client pay applications, project deliverables, warranty documentation, and closeout records. **Technical and Field Support Tasks:** * Perform quantity tracking and production analysis. * Support development of as\-built documentation and project record drawings. * Assist with coordinating material deliveries and subcontractor activities. * Develop a working knowledge of rehabilitation methods, including cured\-in\-place pipe, manhole rehabilitation, cleaning, CCTV, point repairs, grouting, and related technologies. * Operate computer systems proficiently, including B2W, Bluebeam, Microsoft Office, Microsoft Project, Spectrum, WinCan, GIS applications, and other systems as needed. **Financial, Administrative, and Safety Tasks:** * Miscellaneous administrative support for Estimators/Project Managers, General Superintendent, Site Supervisors, Business Development Managers and General Manager. * Answer main office phone, organize and distribute mail and send overnight packages per project team, as required * Review vendor and subcontractor invoices for accuracy and proper coding. * Assist Project Managers with job cost management, reporting, and contract administration. * Maintain organized records of project expenditures, subcontracts, purchase orders, and contractual correspondence. * Understand and support Abel Recon safety policies and procedures. * Promote safe work practices among project team members and subcontractors. * Participate in safety meetings, audits, investigations, and corrective action activities as requested. * Assist in maintaining compliance with applicable regulations and client\-specific safety requirements. **EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE** * High school diploma or GED required. * Associate's or bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Engineering Technology, Business Management, or a related field preferred. * Minimum of one year of construction industry experience preferred. * Experience working with construction plans, specifications, and contract documents preferred. * Utility rehabilitation, municipal infrastructure, underground utility, or heavy civil construction experience preferred. * Strong computer skills required.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, ML Developer Experience
jobs.description: **Required skills** * Engineering * Engineering **About Anyscale:** At Anyscale, we're on a mission to democratize distributed computing and make it accessible to software developers of all skill levels. We're commercializing Ray, a popular open\-source project that's creating an ecosystem of libraries for scalable machine learning. Companies like OpenAI, Uber, Spotify, Instacart, Cruise, and many more, have Ray in their tech stacks to accelerate the progress of AI applications out into the real world. With Anyscale, we're building the best place to run Ray, so that any developer or data scientist can scale an ML application from their laptop to the cluster without needing to be a distributed systems expert. Proud to be backed by Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, and Addition with $250\+ million raised to date. **About the role** Anyscale is looking for a Software Engineer to join the ML Developer Experience (MLDevX) team. MLDevX owns the experience layer of the Anyscale platform: the interfaces through which users and coding agents discover, configure, run, observe, debug, and productionize AI workloads. Every user journey crosses this layer through the CLI, SDKs, APIs, UI, Workspaces, MCP, or the workflows and integrations built on top of them. Together, these form the user’s primary interface into Anyscale, turning distributed computing from a systems problem back into a coding problem. We build the common contracts, tools, control\-plane services, and architecture that power these surfaces. You will work across the stack from developer tooling to cloud infrastructure and the Ray runtime. Manage long\-running operations and make failures across jobs, tasks, actors, nodes, and GPUs easier to diagnose. The systems you build must scale with the platform, remain predictable through failures, and be intuitive for developers, programmable for applications, and operable by coding agents. This is a high impact individual\-contributor role with end\-to\-end ownership. You will work directly with users and field teams to identify high leverage problems, shape the product and technical design, and build and operate the solution. The scope spans the AI workload loop \- data preparation, fine\-tuning and post\-training, serving, evaluation, and iteration as well as the developer loop: code, submit, monitor, debug, optimize, and re\-submit. We are looking for someone with strong product judgment, a willingness to understand the user base, and the technical depth to build high quality software for everyone from a developer learning Ray for the first time to an AI\-native company or enterprise running production workloads at scale. **A snapshot of projects you may work on** ------------------------------------------ * Build the next generation of developer tooling and MLOps capabilities on Ray, designed for both developers and coding agents. * Develop an agent\-first CLI and cohesive SDK, API, and MCP surfaces with self\-discovery, structured errors, dry\-run support, and consistent behavior across platform resources. * Work across the Anyscale Workspaces stack to improve the path from local code to distributed execution, including environments, dependencies, images, authentication, workload submission, and debugging. * Build cohesive experience, tools and frameworks for the AI development lifecycle, including data preparation, fine\-tuning and post\-training, evaluation, production serving, dataset management, experiment tracking, and lineage. * Build the path from a trained model to a reliable production endpoint, including model registration, deployment workflows, performance benchmarking, and LLM\-specific service metrics. * Surface observability across the CLI, SDK, UI, and agent\-facing interfaces so users can diagnose failures across jobs, tasks, actors, nodes, and GPUs. * Design open integrations using durable standards such as OpenAI\-compatible APIs and OpenTelemetry, along with stable Jobs and Services interfaces for external orchestrators. * Design and operate the highly available backend services and platform architecture that power these capabilities across serverless and bring\-your\-own\-cloud environments. * Work closely with users and field teams to scope, ship, and iterate on the product, and collaborate with distributed systems and machine learning experts to push the boundaries of AI infrastructure. **We'd love to hear from you if you have** ------------------------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience * 5\+ years of experience writing high\-quality production code * A solid background in algorithms, data structures, and system design * Experience working with modern machine learning tooling — PyTorch, MLflow, data catalogs, and similar * Hands\-on experience building and operating highly available services in production * Strong product instincts and a track record of shipping developer\-facing tools that people choose to use **Bonus points if you have** ---------------------------- * Experience building and maintaining open\-source projects * Experience building and operating machine learning infrastructure in production * Experience building highly available serving systems * Experience using Ray Anyscale Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Candidates are evaluated without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, disability, national origin, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal or state law. Anyscale Inc. is an E\-Verify company and you may review the Notice of E\-Verify Participation and the Right to Work posters in English and Spanish.

jobs.title: Manager, Solutions Engineering
jobs.description: **About Factory** ----------------- Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself. We build the platform for self\-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T\-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously \- getting smarter with every cycle. In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world\-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake). **About the Role** ------------------ Factory is hiring a Solutions Engineering Manager to build the Mid\-Market Solutions Engineering team. Our Mid\-Market Solutions Engineers own the full customer lifecycle, pre\-sales and post\-sales: discovery, demos, proofs of concept, security and architecture reviews, pilot delivery, and the ongoing adoption and expansion of Factory once a customer is live. You will help build out the team, define how it runs, and own both the technical win and the production outcome for our fastest\-growing mid\-market accounts. You will hire and coach the people who do this work, set the standard for how it is done, and stay close enough to the accounts to do it yourself when it matters. You will work directly with Mid\-Market Sales leadership, and closely with Product and Engineering. This is a hands\-on, zero\-to\-one leadership role at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Engineering. It suits someone who combines real technical fluency, strong people leadership, and sound judgment under deal pressure. **What you will do and achieve** -------------------------------- * Build the Mid\-Market Solutions Engineering team: define the hiring profile, recruit and close the founding Solutions Engineers, and grow the team with the Mid\-Market pipeline * Design and iterate the team's operating playbook across the full lifecycle: discovery, pilot scoping, success metrics, security and compliance reviews, production rollout, and ongoing adoption and expansion * Own the team's technical win rate, time\-to\-technical\-win, pilot\-to\-production conversion, and post\-sales adoption and expansion; report them to GTM leadership and use them to coach the team * Partner with Sales leadership and Account Executives to run high\-quality technical discovery, demos, and proofs of concept that tie directly to customer outcomes * Carry accounts directly while the team ramps, and serve as the escalation point for complex evaluations, at\-risk deployments, and high\-stakes mid\-market deals, including CTO, VP Engineering, and Security stakeholders * Onboard, coach, and develop Solutions Engineers; set clear expectations, career paths, and performance standards, and shorten ramp time with structured enablement * Act as the voice of the field internally, feeding customer and prospect insight back to Product and Engineering **Qualifications** ------------------ You do not need to meet every requirement to be a strong candidate. If this role excites you and you have related experience, we encourage you to apply. * 2\+ years leading Solutions Engineering, Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or customer engineering teams in enterprise software, spanning pre\-sales and post\-sales, including at least one team you built or scaled from a small starting point * A strong hiring track record: you know how to source, assess, and close senior technical customer\-facing talent * A strong technical foundation and fluency in modern software development workflows, developer tooling, CI/CD, and AI coding tools * Proven ability to partner with Sales while protecting technical integrity and customer trust * Comfort in high\-pressure, customer\-facing environments; you can take over a stalled evaluation or a struggling deployment and move it forward * Operational discipline: you track technical win rates and pilot outcomes and run a team on the numbers, not on anecdotes * Executive presence and clear communication with developers, architects, and CTOs alike * A builder mindset: you thrive in a fast\-moving startup and create structure where little exists **Nice to have** ---------------- * Hands\-on experience with agentic coding tools, LLM\-based products, or developer platform sales * Background as a software engineer or in a technical consulting role * Experience standing up a new team or function for a high\-growth company **This is an in\-office position (5 days/week) in San Francisco.** Expect travel to customer sites as needed.
